1.title: Grammar Auction: universities and qualifications
1.stage: SB matni (The MIT factor) tekshirilgandan keyin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Oliy ta'lim mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini (adapt to, drop out of, play a key role, prestige → prestigious, the number of … has, adaptability imlosi) topish va tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar universitetlar, gap year va kasbiy ta'lim haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'drop out OF university') +50 oladi. Imlo xatosida to'g'ri so'z harfma-harf aytiladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: She enrolled on a two-year vocational course in engineering.
items.why: enrol ON a course (British English) — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: Many graduates find it difficult to adapt with the demands of the workplace.
items.fix: Many graduates find it difficult to adapt to the demands of the workplace.
items.why: adapt TO sth — 'with' emas.

items.s: Practical skills are at a premium in today's job market.
items.why: be at a premium — 'juda qadrli, kamyob'; ibora to'g'ri ishlatilgan.

items.s: He dropped out university after his first year.
items.fix: He dropped out of university after his first year.
items.why: drop out OF sth — 'of' tushib qolmasin.

items.s: About a quarter of the city's workforce is employed in the technology sector.
items.why: a quarter of + jamlovchi ot (workforce) → birlik fe'l ham to'g'ri: is employed.

items.s: Innovation plays key role in the growth of any modern economy.
items.fix: Innovation plays a key role in the growth of any modern economy.
items.why: play A key role in — birikmada artikl shart.

items.s: Few universities can match the number of companies founded by MIT alumni.
items.why: alumni — ko'plik; 'founded by' — passiv sifatdosh, to'g'ri.

items.s: Many students regard it as the most prestige university in the country.
items.fix: Many students regard it as the most prestigious university in the country.
items.why: Ot oldida sifat kerak: prestige (ot) → prestigious (sifat).

items.s: Degree apprentices are paid a salary while they study part-time.
items.why: Passiv 'are paid' + while + Present Simple — to'g'ri.

items.s: Employers now value adaptibility as highly as academic grades.
items.fix: Employers now value adaptability as highly as academic grades.
items.why: Imlo: adapt + -ability → adaptability. Imtihonda imlo xatosi — 0 ball.

items.s: Working abroad for a year took her out of her comfort zone.
items.why: out of one's comfort zone — egalik olmoshi egaga mos (her).

items.s: The number of students taking vocational courses have risen sharply.
items.fix: The number of students taking vocational courses has risen sharply.
items.why: The number of … — birlik: has risen (A number of … — ko'plik).

1.title: Board Game: T/F/NG, notes and short answers
1.stage: Practice 1 tahlilidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida (20 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: T/F/NG, note completion va short-answer strategiyasini (FALSE va NOT GIVEN farqi, so'z chegarasi, bo'shliq so'z turkumi, savol so'zi, imlo) og'zaki takrorlash, paraphrase qilish va oliy ta'lim mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani tushuntiradi, paraphrase aytadi, so'zni harflaydi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; paraphrase va gapirish kataklarida ma'nosi to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa yoki o'yinchi 10 soniyada boshlamasa — oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: T/F/NG: what does NOT GIVEN mean?
squares.a: The passage has no information about this exact claim.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'prestigious'
squares.a: e.g. highly respected / well-regarded / elite

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: what makes a university prestigious?
squares.a: e.g. famous alumni, world-class research, top rankings…

squares.t: Note completion: where must your answer come from?
squares.a: From the passage — copy the exact words, spelled correctly.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'rarely'
squares.a: seldom / hardly ever / not often

squares.t: Give the word: former students of a university.
squares.a: alumni (singular: alumnus)

squares.t: T/F/NG: the passage says the opposite. Answer?
squares.a: FALSE

squares.t: Short answer: 'What proportion…?' — what kind of answer?
squares.a: A fraction or percentage, e.g. a third / 40%.

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: would you take a gap year? Why (not)?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because it would give me time to decide what to study.

squares.t: Notes gap: 'to ___ a new type of engine'. Which word class?
squares.a: a verb (e.g. design / develop / test)

squares.t: Notes gap: 'the ___ of the new library'. Which word class?
squares.a: a noun (e.g. design / size / cost)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'vocational training'
squares.a: e.g. job-related training / preparation for a specific trade

squares.t: The topic is in the text, but the claim is not. Answer?
squares.a: NOT GIVEN

squares.t: Spell it: adaptability
squares.a: A-D-A-P-T-A-B-I-L-I-T-Y

squares.t: Short answer: 'In which part of the building…?' — answer type?
squares.a: A place, e.g. the basement / the main hall

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'drop out of university'
squares.a: e.g. leave university without finishing the degree

squares.t: Referencing: what does 'This…' at the start of a sentence refer to?
squares.a: An idea or thing in the previous sentence — find it before you answer.

squares.t: Text: 'only a few'; statement: 'most'. Answer?
squares.a: FALSE (the quantity contradicts)

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: practical skills or academic knowledge?
squares.a: e.g. Both matter, but employers increasingly value hands-on skills…

squares.t: Is 'enviroment' acceptable if the meaning is clear?
squares.a: No — misspelt answers score 0: environment.

squares.t: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'a research laboratory' OK?
squares.a: No — 3 words. Write 'research laboratory'.

squares.t: Use 'take something for granted' about education.
squares.a: e.g. Many students take free textbooks for granted.

squares.t: Paraphrase the sentence: 'Many graduates start their own firms.'
squares.a: e.g. A large number of former students set up their own businesses.

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: should university education be free?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — it gives students from poorer families equal opportunities…

1.title: Dominoes: higher-education paraphrases
1.stage: 'Uch savol turi birga' bosqichidan keyin — paraphrase isitmasi (12 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Oliy ta'lim so'z va iboralarini (prestigious, alumni, enrol on, drop out of, be at a premium, under the auspices of…) IELTS uslubidagi paraphrase bilan ulash — T/F/NG va notes'da matndagi sinonimni tanish ko'nikmasi.
rules: Juftlik yoki 3 kishilik guruhlarga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z/ibora qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrase bilan bir xil ma'noda — toping va ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Har ulashda ibora va uning paraphrase'i ovoz chiqarib aytiladi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi.
Qo'shimcha topshiriq: har guruh 2 ta juftlik bilan bittadan TRUE va FALSE da'vo tuzib, boshqa guruhga beradi.

pairs: sign up for a course of study
all the people who work in a country
a new idea, method or invention
give new energy and strength to
be scarce and therefore highly valued
assume it will always be there
a student working towards a first degree
someone who refuses to follow convention
the ability to adjust to new conditions
a year out before starting university

1.title: Taboo: getting higher qualifications
1.stage: Kirish bosqichida (SB 1-mashq bilan birga) lug'atni faollashtirish uchun (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Unit 1 lug'atini (prestigious, vocational, alumni, maverick, adaptability, drop out, gap year…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol orqali tushuntirish — paraphrase ko'nikmasini og'zaki mashq qilish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball va keyingi karta olinadi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish va so'zni harflash mumkin emas; imo-ishora mumkin.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

1.title: Find someone who… has taken an online course
1.stage: Workbook matnidan (The University of Life) oldin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Oliy ta'lim, gap year, ko'ngillilik va onlayn o'qish haqidagi tajribalar bo'yicha to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…?, Would you…?, Are you planning to…?) va qo'shimcha savol bilan suhbatni davom ettirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever done voluntary work for a charity?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Why? What did you learn?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; savollar faqat inglizcha.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has taken an online course in the last year.
items.q: Have you taken an online course in the last year?

items.t: …would consider taking a gap year before university.
items.q: Would you consider taking a gap year before university?

items.t: …has done voluntary work for a charity.
items.q: Have you ever done voluntary work for a charity?

items.t: …knows exactly which discipline he or she wants to study.
items.q: Do you know exactly which discipline you want to study?

items.t: …has visited a university campus abroad.
items.q: Have you ever visited a university campus abroad?

items.t: …believes practical skills matter more than grades.
items.q: Do you believe practical skills matter more than grades?

items.t: …has a relative who studied at a prestigious university.
items.q: Do you have a relative who studied at a prestigious university?

items.t: …has stepped out of his or her comfort zone this year.
items.q: Have you stepped out of your comfort zone this year?

items.t: …prefers lectures to online lessons.
items.q: Do you prefer lectures to online lessons?

items.t: …is planning to apply for a scholarship.
items.q: Are you planning to apply for a scholarship?

items.t: …has read an English article about education this month.
items.q: Have you read an English article about education this month?

items.t: …can explain the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN.
items.q: Can you explain the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN?

1.title: Speaking cards: universities and qualifications
1.stage: Kirish (SB 1-mashq) o'rniga yoki dars oxirida Speaking Part 1/3 mashqi (12 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Oliy ta'lim, universitet nufuzi, gap year va kasbiy ta'lim bo'yicha IELTS Speaking Part 1 (qisqa javob) va Part 3 (fikr + sabab + misol) savollariga javob berish; Unit 1 lug'atini ishlatish.
rules: Juftliklarga kartalar dastasini teskari qilib bering. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: Part 1 savollariga 2–3 gap, Part 3 savollariga fikr + sabab + misol (kamida 4 gap).
Tinglovchi darsdagi so'zlarni (prestigious, vocational, hands-on, adaptability, alumni…) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Are you studying or working at the moment? What do you enjoy about it?
Is there a well-known university in your city? What is it famous for?
Would you like to study abroad one day? Where, and why?
Do you prefer studying alone or with other people? Why?
What subject would you most like to study at university?
What makes a university prestigious, in your opinion?
Should university education be free for everyone? Why or why not?
Is a university degree still necessary for a successful career?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of taking a gap year?
Why do some young people choose vocational training instead of university?
How has technology changed the way students learn at university?
Are lectures still an effective way to teach large groups? Why?
Should universities focus more on practical, hands-on skills?
Why do employers value adaptability so highly nowadays?
Should young people be encouraged to do voluntary work? Why?
What innovations might change higher education in the next twenty years?

1.title: Sentence Race: question-type rules and paraphrases
1.stage: Kahoot va uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Uch savol turi qoidalarini (T/F/NG, notes, short answers, so'z chegarasi), paraphrase ta'rifini, mavzuga oid gaplarni va ehtiyotkor da'vo gaplarini (may not be, It could be argued that) to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Qoida gapini o'zbekcha to'g'ri izohlasa — yana +1 bonus.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Short-answer questions follow the order of the passage.
Notes do not always follow the order of the text.
If the text says the opposite, the answer is FALSE.
NOT GIVEN means the claim cannot be checked in the text.
Never write more words than the instructions allow.
A gap year gave her the confidence to return to education.
Paraphrasing means expressing the same idea in different words.
Some students drop out of university because of high fees.
Lectures may not be the most effective way to learn.
It could be argued that university is not for everyone.

1.title: Quiz Board: T/F/NG, notes and higher education
1.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Darsni o'yin shaklida takrorlash: uch savol turi qoidalari, paraphrase va FALSE tuzog'i, Unit 1 lug'ati hamda 'Say it!' og'zaki topshiriqlari.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 bo'lim × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' savollariga jamoadan bitta o'quvchi javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: The statement agrees with the passage. TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN?
In note completion, where must your words come from?
NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'research centre' OK? And 'a research centre'?
The topic is in the passage, but the specific claim is not. Answer?
'What proportion of students…?' Is '3,000' a good answer? Why?
qs.a: No — it needs a fraction or percentage, e.g. a third.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'seldom'
Paraphrase: 'enrol on a course'
qs.a: sign up for / join a course

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'free of charge'
qs.a: at no cost / for free / without paying

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'The number of students has doubled.'
qs.a: e.g. Student numbers have risen by 100%.

qs.q: Text: 'Few graduates found jobs.' Statement: 'Most graduates found jobs.' Answer?
A student studying for a first degree
Adjective: connected with training for a particular job or trade
All the people who work in a country or company
A person who thinks independently and ignores the usual rules
An idiom: to be rare and very valuable
Name two things that make a university prestigious.
Say one advantage of taking a gap year.
qs.a: e.g. It gives you time to decide what to study.

qs.q: Spell 'adaptability' and use it in a sentence.
Explain the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN in one sentence.
qs.a: FALSE: the text contradicts it; NOT GIVEN: the text doesn't say.

qs.q: Speak for 30 seconds: university or vocational training — which is better?
qs.a: Open answer: a clear opinion + two reasons.

2.title: Grammar Auction: applications and volunteering
2.stage: 'Section 1 — Band 7 talablari' bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
2.goal: Ishga ariza, ro'yxatdan o'tish va ko'ngillilik mavzusidagi gaplarda tipik xatolarni (available for, apply for, work as a …, experience — sanalmaydi, each + fe'l -s, sanada tartib son) topish va tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar graduate fair, ariza va ko'ngillilik haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'available FOR an interview') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: I'd like to register with several companies at the graduate fair.
items.why: register WITH + tashkilot — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: When would you be available to an interview next week?
items.fix: When would you be available for an interview next week?
items.why: available FOR + ot (an interview) — 'to' emas.

items.s: She is a full-time student, so she can only work in the evenings.
items.why: full-time — ot oldida chiziqcha bilan sifat; mantiq to'g'ri.

items.s: She applied to a paid internship at a big engineering firm.
items.fix: She applied for a paid internship at a big engineering firm.
items.why: apply FOR + ish/lavozim; apply TO + tashkilot.

items.s: He has been volunteering for a local charity since last summer.
items.why: since + vaqt nuqtasi → Present Perfect Continuous.

items.s: I have worked as tutor for children with learning difficulties.
items.fix: I have worked as a tutor for children with learning difficulties.
items.why: Kasb oldida artikl: work as A tutor.

items.s: Please fill in the application form and return it by Friday.
items.why: fill in a form — to'g'ri birikma; 'it' formaga ishora qiladi.

items.s: She has a lot of experiences of working with disadvantaged teenagers.
items.fix: She has a lot of experience of working with disadvantaged teenagers.
items.why: experience (tajriba) — sanalmaydi; experiences = voqealar, taassurotlar.

items.s: How are you fixed for Thursday at half past four?
items.why: How are you fixed for …? — 'vaqtingiz bormi?' degan norasmiy ibora.

items.s: Each volunteer receive a certificate after twenty hours of work.
items.fix: Each volunteer receives a certificate after twenty hours of work.
items.why: Each + birlik ot → fe'l -s oladi: receives.

items.s: I'm quite an outgoing person, so I enjoy working in a team.
items.why: quite an + sifat + ot — to'g'ri so'z tartibi.

items.s: My date of birth is the thirty-one of May.
items.fix: My date of birth is the thirty-first of May.
items.why: Sanada tartib son: thirty-first (31st), 'thirty-one' emas.

2.title: Board Game: Section 1 form completion
2.stage: WB (Care for the Community) tekshirilgach yoki keyingi dars boshida (20 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
2.goal: Section 1 strategiyasini (harflash, raqam va sana aytish, bo'shliqni oldindan taxmin qilish, tuzatish va tuzoq, ikki javobli bo'shliq, so'z chegarasi) og'zaki mashq qilish va ish/ko'ngillilik mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi. 'Heard:' kataklarini chap tomondagi o'yinchi ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, o'yinchi faqat eshitib javob beradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; harflash va raqamlar harfma-harf tekshiriladi, gapirish kataklarida mazmunli har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Spell your surname in English letters.
squares.a: e.g. R-A-S-H-I-D-O-V-A (letter by letter)

squares.t: How do British speakers often say 0 in a phone number?
squares.a: 'oh' (e.g. oh-seven-one…)

squares.t: Say 44 the way it is said in a phone number.
squares.a: double four

squares.t: Say this date aloud: 22/3
squares.a: the twenty-second of March / March the twenty-second

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: have you ever done voluntary work?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, I helped at a charity event for children…

squares.t: Gap: 'Nationality: ___'. What kind of word will you hear?
squares.a: A nationality adjective, e.g. Uzbek / Kazakh

squares.t: What does 'Fire away!' mean in a conversation?
squares.a: Go ahead — ask your questions.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'I'm free on Tuesday.'
squares.a: e.g. I'm available on Tuesday. / Tuesday suits me.

squares.t: What does 'all one word' mean in an email address?
squares.a: No spaces or dots between the parts.

squares.t: Say this email aloud: ali_07@mail.uz
squares.a: a-l-i underscore oh seven at mail dot u-z

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'recruitment'
squares.a: hiring / taking on new staff

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: are you an outgoing person? Give an example.
squares.a: e.g. Yes, I love meeting new people — last month I…

squares.t: Heard: 'Is that Reid, R-E-I-D?' — 'No, R-E-A-D.' Write?
squares.a: Read

squares.t: What is a distractor in Section 1?
squares.a: Information that sounds like the answer but is corrected or rejected.

squares.t: Heard: 'Tuesday's difficult — could we say Thursday?' Day?
squares.a: Thursday

squares.t: Form: 'Job title: Assistant ___'. Heard: 'I'm an assistant manager.' Write?
squares.a: manager ('Assistant' is already on the form)

squares.t: Gap: 'Interests: ___ and ___'. What if you write only one?
squares.a: 0 marks — both parts are needed.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a rewarding job'
squares.a: e.g. a fulfilling job / a job that gives you satisfaction

squares.t: Form: 'Email: ___@qmail.com'. Do you write '@qmail.com' too?
squares.a: No — only the missing part, e.g. tomas88.

squares.t: Heard: 'Two mornings suit me, or three at a push.' Form: 'Up to ___ mornings'.
squares.a: three (the maximum, not 'two')

squares.t: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER: is '3 evenings a week' OK?

3.title: Grammar Auction: colour and language collocations
3.stage: SB 'Learning color words' tahlilidan keyin, WB dan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
3.goal: Dars birikmalari (distinguish between, be exposed to, capitalise on, beyond the means of, come down to) va Band 5–6 xatolarini (predlog, artikl, so'z shakli, moslashuv, bog'lovchi) topib tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Ustoz gaplarni tartib bilan o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi.
Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi (predlog, artikl, so'z shakli, fe'l moslashuvi yoki bog'lovchi)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO gapni sotib olgan jamoa tikkan pulini yo'qotadi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib aniq tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: faqat bitta so'z o'zgartiriladi yoki olib tashlanadi, masalan 'exposed with' → 'exposed to'.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.why: Umumiy ma'nodagi ko'plik otdan oldin 'the' qo'yilmaydi.

items.why: connotations of + ot — to'g'ri birikma.

items.fix: Colour adjectives in English are overwhelmingly placed before the noun.
items.why: Fe'lni (placed) ravish aniqlaydi: overwhelmingly.

items.fix: The number of basic colour words varies from language to language.

items.fix: Although the paragraph mentions Queen Victoria, its main idea is how the dye reached the shops.

3.title: Board Game: headings, summaries and TWO letters
3.stage: Practice 1 va Practice 2 oralig'ida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
3.goal: Matching headings, Summary completion va Choose TWO letters strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash; paraphrase qilish va rang/til o'rganish mavzusida 20–30 soniya gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: strategiya savoliga javob beradi, paraphrase aytadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Paraphrase kataklarida katakdagi so'zlarni takrorlash mumkin emas — ma'noni boshqa so'zlar bilan aytish shart.
Guruh javob kalitidan tekshiradi; javob noto'g'ri yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'unfamiliar objects'
squares.a: novel objects / things they had never seen before

squares.t: Choose TWO letters: how many letters do you write?
squares.a: Exactly two — a third letter costs you marks.

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: your favourite colour and why.
squares.a: e.g. I love deep blue because it makes me feel calm and focused.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'performed much worse'
squares.a: e.g. did far less well / scored considerably lower

squares.t: Heading 'A tentative answer' — what does the paragraph do?
squares.a: It puts forward a possible explanation or hypothesis.

squares.t: Summary gap: 'despite ___' — what word type do you need?
squares.a: A noun or noun phrase (or an -ing form).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'sort objects by colour'
squares.a: e.g. group items into colour categories

squares.t: Say three words in a text that signal a hypothesis.
squares.a: e.g. hypothesised, suggested, proposed, might, theory

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: which English colour words were hard for you?
squares.a: e.g. blue vs green — in Uzbek 'ko'k choy' is green tea!

squares.t: What is the 'detail trap' in matching headings?
squares.a: A heading matches one word or detail in the paragraph, not its main idea.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'he made money from his invention'
squares.a: e.g. he capitalised on / profited from his discovery

squares.t: Summary completion: can you change the form of a word you copy?
squares.a: No — copy it exactly as it appears in the passage.

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: does colour affect your mood?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — yellow walls make me feel more cheerful and energetic.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'distinguish between'.
squares.a: e.g. Some people can't distinguish between red and green.

squares.t: Choose TWO letters: name the three kinds of wrong option.
squares.a: Contradicts the text; not in the text; true but not an answer.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'as predicted'
squares.a: e.g. as expected / unsurprisingly / in line with the theory

squares.t: Heading 'Putting the idea to the test' — what is in the paragraph?
squares.a: An experiment or study that tests the hypothesis.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'beyond the means of'.
squares.a: e.g. A new car is beyond the means of most students.

squares.t: Why do you read the headings before the passage?
squares.a: They map the whole text and help you locate the other answers.

squares.t: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'a rare purple dye' acceptable?
squares.a: No — that is four words. Copy only one or two words from the passage.

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: should children learn two languages from birth?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — early exposure helps them acquire both naturally.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the new dye was a turning point for fashion'
squares.a: e.g. the new colouring revolutionised the clothing industry

squares.t: Time plan: split 20 minutes across the three question types.
squares.a: Headings 8, summary 5, TWO letters 5, checking 2 minutes.

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: why was purple once worn only by the rich?
squares.a: e.g. The dye was rare and costly, so ordinary people couldn't afford it.

4.title: Grammar Auction: colour, exhibitions and shopping

4.goal: Mavzu birikmalari (preference for, part with, spend on, stimulate the appetite, turnover of customers) va Band 5–6 xatolarini (predlog, -ed/-ing sifat, ko'plik, make + fe'l) topib tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Ustoz gaplarni tartib bilan o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi.
Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi (predlog, -ed/-ing sifat, ko'plik yoki fe'l shakli)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO gapni sotib olgan jamoa tikkan pulini yo'qotadi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib aniq tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: faqat bitta so'z o'zgartiriladi yoki olib tashlanadi, masalan 'part from their cash' → 'part with their cash'.

5.title: Grammar Auction: writing about medical research
5.stage: Savol turlari kombinatsiyasi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
5.goal: Tibbiy tadqiqot va sog'liq mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: birikma (conduct a trial), sanalmaydigan ot (evidence), affect/effect, ega-kesim mosligi, predlog (depend on), ortiqcha qat'iy da'vo (proves → suggests).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (bular dori sinovlari, platsebo va jismoniy faollik haqidagi akademik gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: made a trial → conducted a trial, evidences → evidence, affect → effect).
'proves' gapiga alohida to'xtaling: kichik tadqiqot hech narsani isbotlamaydi. Y/N/NG da ham muallifning ishonch darajasi (may, suggests, proves) javobni hal qiladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The trial was designed to gauge the effectiveness of the new drug.
items.why: gauge the effectiveness of — to'g'ri birikma; effectiveness — ot.

items.s: Researchers made a clinical trial with 500 volunteers.
items.fix: Researchers conducted a clinical trial with 500 volunteers.
items.why: Birikma: conduct / carry out a trial; 'make a trial' deyilmaydi.

items.s: Scientists have found new evidences that walking protects the heart.
items.fix: Scientists have found new evidence that walking protects the heart.
items.why: evidence — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

items.s: Sedentary office workers are more likely to develop back problems.
items.why: be more likely to + fe'l — to'g'ri; sedentary — kam harakatli.

items.s: The drug had a positive affect on patients' mood.
items.fix: The drug had a positive effect on patients' mood.
items.why: Bu yerda ot kerak: effect (ta'sir); affect — fe'l.

items.s: Regular exercise may slow down cognitive decline in old age.
items.why: may — ehtiyotkor da'vo (hedging); cognitive decline — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: The results of the study was published in a leading journal.
items.fix: The results of the study were published in a leading journal.
items.why: Ega — results (ko'plik), 'study' emas → were.

items.s: The findings challenge the assumption that the placebo effect is short-lived.
items.why: challenge an assumption — to'g'ri birikma; findings (ko'plik) → challenge.

items.s: The company's future depended of the success of a single drug.
items.fix: The company's future depended on the success of a single drug.
items.why: depend ON — 'of' emas.

items.s: Neither the patients nor the doctors knew who had received the real drug.
items.why: neither … nor — to'g'ri; ikki tomonlama yashirin (double-blind) sinov.

items.s: This small study proves that exercise reduces anxiety.
items.fix: This small study suggests that exercise reduces anxiety.
items.why: Kichik tadqiqot isbotlamaydi: akademik uslubda 'suggests' (hedging).

items.s: Patients who were warned about side effects were more likely to report them.
items.why: warn about — to'g'ri predlog; them = side effects (nocebo effekti).

rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.

5.title: Speaking cards: medicine, placebos and exercise

5.goal: Sog'liq, tibbiy tadqiqot va jismoniy faollik bo'yicha Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga hedging va dars lug'ati bilan javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: Part 1 savoliga 2–3 gap, Part 3 savoliga 4–5 gap (fikr + sabab + misol).
Javobda kamida bitta hedging iborasi (may, tend to, it seems that) yoki dars so'zi (evidence, side effect, sedentary…) bo'lishi kerak.
Tinglovchi har bir hedging iborasi va dars so'zi uchun +1 ball beradi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

5.title: Sentence Race: writers' claims and hedged statements
5.stage: Xulosa va vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
5.goal: Muallif da'vosi va ehtiyotkor (hedged) gaplarda so'z tartibini tiklash: it is hardly surprising that, the evidence suggests that, challenge the assumption.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Bonus +1: jamoa gapdagi muallif fikri yoki hedging so'zini (hardly surprising, suggests, may, claims) ko'rsatsa.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: It is hardly surprising that the company hid the results.
The evidence suggests that walking may protect the brain.
Many scientists challenge the assumption that placebos are harmless.
With so much money invested, the stakes could hardly be higher.
The writer claims that the placebo response lasts longer than expected.
Unpublished trials give a misleading picture of a drug's effectiveness.
Sitting for long periods may increase the risk of heart disease.
NOT GIVEN means the writer makes no such claim.
Setting an unrealistic goal may discourage the least active people.

6.title: Grammar Auction: injuries, physiotherapy and painkillers
6.stage: Tahlil bosqichida, xato sabablari (imlo, so'z chegarasi) ko'rilgandan keyin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
6.goal: Jarohat, fizioterapiya va dorilar mavzusidagi gaplarda tipik xatolarni topish: recipe/prescription, during/for, has gone, the number of … is, imlo (painful), prevent + ot. Imlo xatosi listening javobida ham ball olib qo'yadi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (bular fizioterapiya, sport jarohatlari va og'riq qoldiruvchi dorilar haqidagi gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: recipe → prescription, during two weeks → for two weeks).
Imlo xatosiga alohida to'xtaling (painfull → painful): listening javob varag'ida bitta harf xatosi ham javobni noto'g'ri qiladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The physiotherapist assessed the damage to my ankle joint.
items.why: assess the damage to — to'g'ri birikma (evaluate = assess).

items.s: The doctor wrote me a recipe for a strong painkiller.
items.fix: The doctor wrote me a prescription for a strong painkiller.
items.why: Dori retsepti — prescription; recipe — ovqat retsepti (soxta do'st).

items.s: Athletes who stick to their rehabilitation plan usually recover faster.
items.why: stick to a plan — rejaga amal qilmoq; to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: She sprained her ankle, so she can't play tennis during two weeks.
items.fix: She sprained her ankle, so she can't play tennis for two weeks.
items.why: Davomiylik: for + muddat (for two weeks); during + ot (during the match).

items.s: Taking painkillers for too long can lead to dependency.
items.why: lead to + ot — to'g'ri; dependency — qaramlik.

items.s: The swelling around his knee has went down.
items.fix: The swelling around his knee has gone down.
items.why: Present perfect: has + V3 (gone), V2 (went) emas.

items.s: Poor posture at a desk often causes stiffness in the neck.
items.why: cause stiffness in the neck — to'g'ri birikma; poor posture — noto'g'ri qomat.

items.s: The number of sports injuries are rising among teenagers.
items.fix: The number of sports injuries is rising among teenagers.
items.why: The number of … — birlik → is (lekin: a number of … → are).

items.s: Too much rest can be counter-productive after a minor injury.
items.why: counter-productive — kutilganining teskarisini beradigan; to'g'ri ishlatilgan.

items.s: My shoulder is still very painfull after the match.
items.fix: My shoulder is still very painful after the match.
items.why: Imlo: -ful qo'shimchasi bitta 'l' bilan (painful).

items.s: A qualified trainer oversees each patient's sessions in the gym.
items.why: oversee = supervise; each + birlik ot (patient's) — to'g'ri.

items.s: A proper warm-up helps prevent from injuries.
items.fix: A proper warm-up helps prevent injuries.
items.why: prevent + ot ('from' kerak emas); lekin prevent sb FROM doing sth.

7.title: Grammar Auction: posters, pigments and adverts
7.stage: Workbook matni (Photography in advertising) tekshirilgandan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
7.goal: Plakat, bo'yoq va reklama mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini (predlog, as … as, kelishuv, ideal for) topish va tuzatish; exert an influence on, in stark contrast to, share the spotlight with iboralarini mashq qilish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar plakatlar, bo'yoqlar va reklama fotografiyasi haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'share the spotlight WITH, to emas') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

7.title: Board Game: tables, flow charts and T/F/NG

rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase aytadi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; paraphrase va gapirish kataklarida ma'nosi to'g'ri boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.

Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

8.title: Grammar Auction: ancient art and lectures
8.stage: 'Skript bilan tahlil'dan keyin: so'z shakli, ko'plik va predlog xatolari (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
8.goal: Qadimgi san'at mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini (year-old, kelishuv, so'z turkumi, dispute va help tuzilmasi, asr oldidan 'the') topish va tuzatish — note completion'da so'z shakliga e'tibor.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar g'or san'ati, bo'yoqlar va vitraj haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'durable — sifat, durability — ot') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Archaeologists discovered a 20,000-years-old painted stone.
items.fix: Archaeologists discovered a 20,000-year-old painted stone.
items.why: Sifat vazifasidagi birikmada ot birlikda: 20,000-year-old.

items.s: The rock was crushed and ground into a fine powder.
items.why: grind — ground — ground: passiv 'was ground' to'g'ri.

items.s: Early artists mixed the pigment with animal fat or plant sap.
items.why: mix A with B — to'g'ri birikma; o'tmish haqida — Past Simple.

items.s: Many of the paintings has been preserved inside dry caves.
items.fix: Many of the paintings have been preserved inside dry caves.
items.why: Many of the paintings — ko'plik, shuning uchun 'have been'.

items.s: Rock is far more durability than bark.
items.fix: Rock is far more durable than bark.
items.why: is + more … than — sifat kerak: durable (durability — ot).

items.s: Dot painting has taken off internationally since the 1970s.
items.why: take off — ommalashmoq; 'since' bilan Present Perfect.

items.s: The lecturer disputes with this theory about magic.
items.fix: The lecturer disputes this theory about magic.
items.why: dispute (fe'l) to'ldiruvchini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oladi, 'with' kerak emas.

items.s: Wild animals are a recurring theme in cave art.
items.why: a recurring theme — takrorlanuvchi mavzu, to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: Selling paintings helps keeping the culture alive.
items.fix: Selling paintings helps keep the culture alive.
items.why: help + (to) fe'l; -ing shakli emas.

items.s: Stained-glass windows helped people who could not read to follow famous stories.
items.why: help + kishi + (to) fe'l; people who … — aniqlovchi ergash gap, to'g'ri.

items.s: Medieval craftsmen used a hot iron to crack the glass.
items.why: use sth to do sth — maqsad ma'nosi to'g'ri.

items.s: Stained glass became a major art form in Europe in twelfth century.
items.fix: Stained glass became a major art form in Europe in the twelfth century.
items.why: Asr nomi bilan 'the' shart: in the twelfth century.

8.title: Board Game: Section 4 note completion
8.stage: Workbook Track 7 tekshiruvidan keyin yoki keyingi darsda Section 4 strategiyasini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
8.goal: Section 4 formati, bo'shliq turini oldindan aytish, o'tish iboralari, raqam va zamon tuzoqlari, so'z chegarasi va imloni og'zaki takrorlash; qadimgi san'at mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase aytadi, so'zni harflab aytadi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; paraphrase va gapirish kataklarida ma'nosi to'g'ri boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Gap' kataklarida so'z turi va ma'lumot turi ikkalasi aytilishi kerak.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: How many speakers are there in Section 4?
squares.a: One — a lecturer giving an academic talk.

squares.t: Is there a break in the middle of Section 4?
squares.a: No — all 10 questions come in one recording.

squares.t: What should you read first in the preparation time?
squares.a: The title and the headings of the notes.

squares.t: Gap: 'a range of ___'. What kind of word?
squares.a: A plural noun, e.g. tools / objects.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'protected from'.
squares.a: e.g. sheltered from / not destroyed by

squares.t: Say a phrase a lecturer uses to start a new section.
squares.a: e.g. Let's move on to… / OK, onto… / Now, turning to…

squares.t: Gap: 'first made about ___ ago'. What do you expect?
squares.a: A number + a time word, e.g. 12,000 years.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: a famous old building or artwork in Uzbekistan.
squares.a: e.g. The Registan in Samarkand is famous for its blue tiles…

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the main purpose'.
squares.a: e.g. the key function / the chief aim

squares.t: Spell aloud: ochre.
squares.a: O-C-H-R-E

squares.t: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. Is '30,000 years' OK?
squares.a: Yes — a number plus one word.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'plentiful'.
squares.a: e.g. readily available / abundant / easy to find

squares.t: You hear two numbers for one gap. What should you do?
squares.a: Check which one fits the notes — the first one is often a trap.

squares.t: Gap: 'made from ___'. What type of information?
squares.a: A material or substance, e.g. clay / charcoal.

squares.t: Notes: 'in the past'. Lecturer: 'Nowadays X, but traditionally Y.' Answer?
squares.a: Y — the past method, not today's method.

squares.t: Explain 'binder' in your own words.
squares.a: A substance that holds pigment together, e.g. sap or egg.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: why did ancient people paint on rocks?
squares.a: e.g. To tell stories, record hunts and pass on beliefs.

squares.t: Speaker gives a theory, then doubts it. Notes: 'possibly ___'. Write what?
squares.a: The theory itself — the notes say 'possibly'.

squares.t: You heard 'bright colours' but wrote 'bright colour'. Is it right?
squares.a: No — the plural -s must be kept.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'suddenly became very popular'.
squares.a: e.g. took off / caught on

squares.t: Why is Section 4 often the hardest part of the test?
squares.a: Academic topic, dense language, one speaker and no break.

squares.t: Name three natural materials early artists used to make paint.
squares.a: e.g. ochre, charcoal, chalk, clay

squares.t: Signpost: 'So, how have things changed?' What comes next?
squares.a: The modern period — how the art is made or used today.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should ancient rock art be open to tourists?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, with limits: tourism brings money, but touching damages it.

8.title: Dominoes: notes wording ↔ lecture paraphrase
8.stage: 'Sinf mashqi' bosqichida, Track 19 oldidan: ma'ruzadagi paraphrase'larga tayyorlanish (12 daqiqa)
8.goal: Notes'dagi so'zni ma'ruzachi aytadigan paraphrase bilan ulash (protected from = sheltered from, main function = key purpose, plentiful = readily available) — Section 4 da javob joyini eshitib qolish ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida notes'dagi ibora yozilgan; ma'ruzachi xuddi shu fikrni qanday aytishi mumkin — shu paraphrase qaysi toshning chap tomonida, toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Har bir iboraning faqat bitta to'g'ri paraphrase'i bor.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'In the notes: durable — the lecturer says: able to last for a very long time'. Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: able to last for a very long time
a subject that appears again and again
the first inhabitants of a land
something tourists buy to remember a trip

8.title: Taboo: rock art, paints and crafts
8.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' savolidan keyin: qadimgi san'at so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
8.goal: Qadimgi san'at, bo'yoq tayyorlash va hunarmandchilik so'zlarini (ochre, binder, canvas, carve, kiln, indigenous) inglizcha ta'rif bilan tushuntirish — ma'ruzadagi paraphrase'larni eshitishga tayyorgarlik.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas; 'It's a material that…', 'You use it to…' kabi ta'rif iboralarini ishlating.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

8.title: Find someone who… has seen ancient rock art
8.stage: Student's Book va Workbook tinglashlari orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
8.goal: Qadimgi san'at, muzeylar, hunarmandchilik va ma'ruza tinglash tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Do you think…?) va qo'shimcha savol bilan suhbatni davom ettirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever seen ancient rock carvings?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Where was it? What did it look like?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 ta qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollar grammatikasini tekshiradi.

8.title: Speaking cards: ancient art, museums and crafts
8.stage: Jony Academy mashqidan keyin, 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida — Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa)
8.goal: Qadimgi san'at, muzeylar va hunarmandchilik mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga Band 7 uslubida javob berish; darsdagi so'zlarni (preserve, durable, significance, keep a culture alive, take off) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi (examiner rolida).
Part 1 kartasiga 2–3 gap bilan, 'Part 3' deb boshlangan kartaga fikr + sabab + misol bilan kamida 4 gap bilan javob beriladi.
Examiner javobdagi dars so'z va iboralarini sanaydi: har biri +1 ball; qo'shimcha savol ('Can you give an example?') berishi mumkin.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

8.title: Sentence Race: Section 4 tips and lecture language
8.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
8.goal: Section 4 maslahatlari, ma'ruzachining o'tish iboralari va qadimgi san'at haqidagi gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Maslahat: katta harfli so'z gap boshida, nuqtali so'z oxirida turadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gap maslahat bo'lsa (masalan: 'Don't write a number until…'), jamoa uni o'zbekcha izohlasa +1 bonus.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Read the headings of the notes before the recording starts.
Let's move on to the way the paint was made.

Your answer must not go over the word limit.

To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

9.title: Grammar Auction: Units 1–4 topic sentences
9.stage: 'Olti sabab' bosqichidan keyin 2-sabab (to'g'ri topib, xato yozish) mavzusini davom ettirish uchun yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa)
9.goal: Unit 1–4 mavzularidagi (ta'lim, rang, sog'liq, san'at) gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini topish: predlog (drop out of, hinge on, distinguish between … and), artikl, kelishuv, effect / affect.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar Unit 1–4 mavzularida: ta'lim, rang, sog'liq, san'at). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?

9.title: Find someone who… changed a correct answer

9.goal: Have you ever…? / Did you…? / Do you…? / Would you…? savollarini to'g'ri tuzib, mock tajribasi va Unit 1–4 mavzulari (ta'lim, rang, sog'liq, san'at) haqida suhbatlashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi (Have you ever…? / Did you…? / Do you…? / Would you…?) va sinfdoshidan so'raydi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Why? What happened?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; hamma savol va javob faqat inglizcha.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq 2 javobni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

9.title: Speaking cards: Units 1–4 and the mock experience
9.stage: Mockda Speaking yo'q — 'Ikki haftalik reja' dan keyin yoki keyingi darsda Part 1/3 mashqi (12 daqiqa)
9.goal: Unit 1–4 mavzularida (ta'lim, rang, sog'liq, san'at) va mock tajribasi haqida IELTS Speaking Part 1 (qisqa) va Part 3 (fikr + sabab + misol) javoblarini mashq qilish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. A o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
B o'quvchi javob beradi: Part 1 uslubidagi savolga 2–3 gap, Part 3 uslubidagi savolga 4–5 gap (fikr + sabab + misol).
A o'quvchi javobdagi Unit 1–4 so'zlarini (vocational, sedentary, vibrant, exert an influence on…) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball; sabab va misol berilsa yana +1.
Har 3 kartadan keyin rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 eng yaxshi javobni sinfga aytdiradi.

9.title: Sentence Race: exam rules and Units 1–4 facts

rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf — gap boshi, nuqta — gap oxiri) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, +1 ball oladi va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Qoida haqidagi gapni (masalan, so'z chegarasi) to'g'ri tergan jamoa uni o'zbekcha qisqa izohlasa — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

9.title: Quiz Board: Mock 1 review — Units 1–4
9.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takrorga
9.goal: Savol turlari qoidalari, xom ball → band, olti xato sababi va Unit 1–4 paraphrase'larini jamoaviy o'yinda takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 bo'lim × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Why wrong? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Score & band' savollarida doskadagi jadvaldan foydalanish mumkin).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' bo'limida javob namunadan farq qilishi mumkin — ma'no va grammatika to'g'ri bo'lsa ball beriladi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.
materials: Xom ball → band jadvali (Listening va Academic Reading) doskada

qs.q: The text says the opposite of the statement. TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN?
Which Reading task asks about the writer's views or claims?
Summary completion with a box of words A–I: what do you write?
Listening form: the speaker says 'Tuesday', then corrects it to 'Thursday'. Your answer?
Reading, Choose TWO letters (A–E): name the three typical kinds of wrong option.
qs.a: Opposite to the text; not in the text; true but not the answer

qs.q: How many questions are there in Reading and in Listening?

Reading: 27 correct answers. Which band?
26 correct answers: which band in Listening and in Academic Reading?
Listening 29/40. How many more correct answers do you need for 7.0?

qs.q: Passage 3: your last five answers are blank. Which cause?

You wrote D, then changed it to A without evidence. D was right. Which cause?

qs.q: What is the cure for cause 3 (no time) in Reading?

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'prestigious'.
Make a sentence with 'drop out of'.

10.title: Grammar Auction: archaeology and negative affixes
10.stage: Inkor affikslari sinf mashqidan keyin, Student's Book matnidan oldin (15 daqiqa)
10.goal: Arxeologiya va inson evolyutsiyasi mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: inkor affikslari (in-/im-/ir-/un-/dis-), evidence (sanalmaydigan ot), remains + were, each + birlik fe'l.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar qazishmalar, qadimgi odamlar va topilmalar haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'hospitable → IN-hospitable, un- emas') +50 oladi.
Ustoz eslatadi: sentence completion'da affiks yoki -s tushib qolsa javob 0 ball — shuning uchun imlo ham muhim.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: There is still no clear evidence that these early farmers kept goats.
items.why: evidence that + gap — to'g'ri; evidence sanalmaydigan ot (a/an yo'q).

items.s: The team found many evidences of early farming at the site.
items.fix: The team found a lot of evidence of early farming at the site.
items.why: evidence — sanalmaydigan ot: 'evidences' emas, 'a lot of / much evidence'.

items.s: Early farmers avoided the unhospitable plateau and settled in the river valleys.
items.fix: Early farmers avoided the inhospitable plateau and settled in the river valleys.
items.why: hospitable ning inkori in- bilan: inhospitable (un- emas).

items.s: Testing every bone fragment from the cave would be impractical and expensive.
items.why: practical → impractical (p dan oldin im-); would be + sifat.

items.s: Mammoths gradually dissappeared from the region as the climate grew warmer.
items.fix: Mammoths gradually disappeared from the region as the climate grew warmer.
items.why: dis- + appear: bitta s, ikkita p — disappeared.

items.s: The number of wild horses on the plains plummeted during the long drought.
items.why: the number of … — birlik ega; plummet — keskin kamaymoq (o'tgan zamon -ed).

items.s: The remains of a young hunter was discovered in a limestone cave.
items.fix: The remains of a young hunter were discovered in a limestone cave.
items.why: remains (qoldiqlar) doim ko'plik: were discovered.

items.s: Warm, well-made clothing may have given our ancestors the edge over their rivals.
items.why: give sb the edge over — ustunlik bermoq; may have + V3 — o'tmish haqida taxmin.

items.s: Each species have its own way of surviving a harsh climate.
items.fix: Each species has its own way of surviving a harsh climate.
items.why: each + birlik fe'l: has ('species' shakli birlik va ko'plikda bir xil).

items.s: These fragile artefacts are irreplaceable, so they are rarely lent to other museums.
items.why: r dan oldin ir-: irreplaceable; lend → lent (passiv).

items.s: The site was so unaccessible that supplies had to be carried in by hand.
items.fix: The site was so inaccessible that supplies had to be carried in by hand.
items.why: accessible ning inkori in- bilan: inaccessible.

items.s: Some scientists speculate that a sudden change in climate caused the extinction of the mammoths.
items.why: speculate that + gap — dalilsiz taxmin qilmoq; extinction — ot.

10.title: Board Game: Passage 2 — three tasks, one text
10.stage: Practice 1 dan keyin, Practice 2 o'rniga yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
10.goal: Matching information, sentence completion va matching features qoidalari, ma'lumot turi signal so'zlari, inkor affikslari, paraphrase va arxeologiya mavzusida gapirishni og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, affiks qo'shadi, paraphrase qiladi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi (ustozda javoblar kaliti bor). Ochiq topshiriqda javob namunadan farq qilishi mumkin — ma'no va grammatika to'g'ri bo'lsa qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi; affiks topshirig'ida so'zni harflab ham aytadi (imlo tekshiriladi).
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Matching information: are the questions in passage order?
squares.a: No — they can come in any order.

squares.t: Sentence completion: are the sentences in passage order?
squares.a: Yes — always in the order of the passage.

squares.t: Add a negative prefix: hospitable
squares.a: inhospitable

squares.t: Add a negative prefix: appear
squares.a: disappear

squares.t: Matching features: when do you choose 'None of the above'?
squares.a: When no person on the list makes that claim.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'died out'.
squares.a: e.g. became extinct / disappeared completely

squares.t: 'A comparison of…': what must the paragraph contain?
squares.a: At least two things compared (signals: whereas, on the other hand, unlike).

squares.t: Add a negative prefix: practical
squares.a: impractical

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: Would you like to work as an archaeologist? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — every excavation is like solving a mystery, but it needs patience.

squares.t: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS: is 'the oldest stone tools' acceptable?
squares.a: No — four words; 'oldest stone tools' may fit if the grammar works.

squares.t: Name three signal words for 'evidence for' questions.
squares.a: e.g. show, suggest, indicate, prove, reveal

squares.t: Add negative prefixes: stable / logical
squares.a: unstable / illogical

squares.t: One researcher is quoted in three paragraphs. What do you do?
squares.a: Underline every mention and read around each one before you choose.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'excavate'.
squares.a: e.g. dig up / uncover by careful digging

squares.t: What is the difference between 'an example' and 'evidence'?
squares.a: An example illustrates a point (for instance); evidence supports a claim (shows that).

squares.t: Make 'worth' negative with a suffix and use it in a sentence.
squares.a: worthless — e.g. The old coins turned out to be worthless.

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: What can scientists learn from ancient bones?
squares.a: e.g. Lab tests can reveal a person's age, diet, illnesses and even migration routes.

squares.t: Why is matching information often best left until last?
squares.a: It is not in order; by then you know what each paragraph says.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The population fell very sharply.'
squares.a: e.g. The population plummeted / dropped dramatically.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'give sb the edge'.
squares.a: e.g. Fire gave early humans the edge over large predators.

squares.t: Which prefix means 'wrongly'? Add it to 'direct'.
squares.a: mis- → misdirect

squares.t: Sentence completion: why must you copy the word form exactly?
squares.a: A lost prefix or suffix changes the meaning: stable ≠ unstable.

squares.t: Speak for 40 seconds: Is studying the distant past worth the money?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — it explains who we are, although present problems may be more urgent.

squares.t: Passage 2, 20 minutes: how would you divide the time between the tasks?
squares.a: e.g. map 2, sentences 5, features 5, matching information 6, check 2
