10.title: Speaking cards: history, museums and our ancestors
10.stage: Xulosa oldidan yoki keyingi darsda IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 mashqi (12 daqiqa)
10.goal: Tarix, arxeologiya va muzeylar mavzusida Part 1 va Part 3 javoblari; taxmin iboralari (may have, might, it is possible that) va ancestor, evidence, artefact, speculate so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. A o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
B o'quvchi javob beradi: Part 1 uslubidagi savolga 2–3 gap, Part 3 uslubidagi savolga 4–5 gap (fikr + sabab + misol).
A o'quvchi javobdagi mavzu so'zlari (ancestor, evidence, artefact, remains…) va taxmin iboralarini (may have, might, it is possible that) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Har 3 kartadan keyin rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 eng yaxshi javobni sinfga aytdiradi.

cards: Do you enjoy visiting museums? Why or why not?
Which historical place in your region would you recommend to a foreign visitor, and why?
Did you enjoy history lessons at school? What made them interesting or boring?
How much do you know about your family's history? Who told you about it?
Why are people so interested in how the first humans lived?
Should governments spend public money on archaeological research? Why or why not?
Who should own ancient artefacts: the country where they were found or the museum that holds them?
How can modern technology help us learn more about the distant past?
Does tourism help or harm ancient sites such as those in Samarkand and Khiva?
Why do you think some animals survived the last Ice Age while others died out?
If you could turn the clock back to any period of history, which would you choose and why?
How can museums make history more interesting for teenagers?
Would you rather work at an excavation site or in a laboratory? Why?
How might people in 5,000 years' time interpret the objects we leave behind?

10.title: Sentence Race: task rules and evidence sentences
10.stage: 'Uch savol turi birga' tushuntirilgandan keyin qoidalarni mustahkamlash (8 daqiqa)
10.goal: Uch savol turining qoidalari va dalil, sabab, taxmin gaplarida (suggest that, because, may have, forced … to) hamda inkor affiksli so'zlarda (impractical, unstable) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf — gap boshi, nuqta — gap oxiri) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, +1 ball oladi va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Qo'shimcha +1: jamoa gapning vazifasini aytadi (qoida, dalil, sabab, taxmin yoki izoh) — masalan, 'suggest that' → evidence, 'because' → reason.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Matching information questions do not follow the order of the passage.
Sentence completion answers always appear in passage order.
Underline all the places where a researcher is quoted.
Choose 'None of the above' if no one on the list makes the claim.
Burnt animal bones suggest that early humans cooked their food.
Harsh winters may have caused their numbers to plummet.
Radiocarbon dating can reveal when an ancient person died.
The settlement was abandoned because its wells had dried up.
Digging up the entire ancient city would be impractical.
An unstable climate forced early humans to move to new regions.

10.title: Quiz Board: matching information, features and affixes
10.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar keyingi darsga yoki takrorga
10.goal: Uch savol turi qoidalari, ma'lumot turi signal so'zlari (comparison, reason, example, evidence), inkor affikslari va mavzu paraphrase'larini jamoaviy o'yinda takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 bo'lim × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Information type 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. Affiks savollarida so'z harflab aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' bo'limida javob namunadan farq qilishi mumkin — ma'no va grammatika to'g'ri bo'lsa ball beriladi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Which of today's three tasks always follows the order of the passage?
Matching information: can one paragraph letter be used twice?
qs.a: Yes, if the NB says you may use any letter more than once.

qs.q: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS: is 'a small bone needle' acceptable?
qs.a: No — four words; e.g. 'bone needle' may fit.

qs.q: Matching features: in what order do the names in the box usually appear in the text?
qs.a: In the same order as in the box

qs.q: Best order for today's three tasks, and why?
qs.a: Sentences → features → matching information (unordered task last)

qs.q: 'for instance', 'such as' signal which type of information?
'because', 'due to', 'led to' signal which type?
'whereas', 'on the other hand', 'unlike' signal which type?
'Copper tools in the graves show that the villagers traded with distant regions.' Which type?
'Next season, the team plans to survey the northern valley.' Which type?
qs.a: a reference to a future plan

qs.q: Negative of 'appear'?
Negative of 'hospitable'?
Negatives of 'replaceable' and 'logical'?
Which verb means 'to fall suddenly and very steeply'?
Which suffix makes 'worth' negative, and which prefix means 'wrongly'?
Paraphrase: 'died out'.
Paraphrase: 'excavate'.
qs.a: e.g. dig up / uncover by careful digging

qs.q: Make a sentence with 'ancestor'.
qs.a: e.g. Our ancestors survived by hunting and gathering.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'The evidence strongly suggests that they ate fish.'
qs.a: e.g. There are clear signs that fish was part of their diet.

qs.q: In 30 seconds: why leave matching information until last?
qs.a: It is not in order; after the other tasks you already know the text.

11.title: Grammar Auction: fossils, sequencers and word forms
11.stage: Student's Book (Track 26–27) javoblari tekshirilgandan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
11.goal: Fosil hosil bo'lishi va neolit davri mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini topish: so'z turkumi (mud/muddy, erode/erosion), ko'plik (minerals), sequencer'lar (while/during, until), predlog.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar fosillar, arxeologiya va neolit davri haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'soft and ___ — sifat kerak: muddy').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa). Ustoz eslatadi: javob varag'ida ham so'z turkumi yoki ko'plik -s xatosi ballni yo'qotadi.

items.s: As soon as the fish dies, it sinks to the ocean floor.
items.why: as soon as + Present Simple: jarayonning birinchi bosqichi to'g'ri ifodalangan.

items.s: Over time, minerals in the water gradually replaces the bone.
items.fix: Over time, minerals in the water gradually replace the bone.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (minerals) — fe'l -s siz: replace. Diagrammada ham -s siz fe'l ko'plik ot kerakligini bildiradi.

items.s: Once the body is buried in mud, scavengers can no longer reach it.
items.why: once = '...gach/...dan keyin'; Present Simple bilan jarayon bosqichi to'g'ri.

items.s: During the fish lies on the seabed, it is slowly covered by sediment.
items.fix: While the fish lies on the seabed, it is slowly covered by sediment.
items.why: during + ot (during that time); to'liq gapdan (ega + fe'l) oldin 'while' kerak.

items.s: Layers of sediment build up until they will turn into hard rock.
items.fix: Layers of sediment build up until they turn into hard rock.
items.why: until dan keyin 'will' ishlatilmaydi: until they turn into rock.

items.s: Neolithic farmers learnt to domesticate sheep and goats.
items.why: domesticate + hayvon — to'g'ri birikma; 'learnt' — britancha shakl.

items.s: In shallow water, the seabed is often soft and mud.
items.fix: In shallow water, the seabed is often soft and muddy.
items.why: 'soft and ___' — ikkala so'z ham sifat bo'lishi kerak: muddy.

items.s: Meanwhile, erosion slowly wears away the rock above the fossil.
items.why: meanwhile = 'shu vaqtning o'zida'; wear away — to'g'ri phrasal verb.

items.s: Visitors can clearly see the effects of erode on the cliffs.
items.fix: Visitors can clearly see the effects of erosion on the cliffs.
items.why: 'the effects of ___' — ot kerak: erosion (erode — fe'l).

items.s: Over thousands of years, stone tools became more sophisticated.
items.why: sophisticated — sifat; 'became more sophisticated' — to'g'ri qiyoslash.

items.s: Aziz became interested on fossils long before his first museum visit.
items.fix: Aziz became interested in fossils long before his first museum visit.
items.why: interested IN — 'on' emas.

items.s: Eventually, the rock containing the fossil rises above sea level.
items.why: eventually = 'oxir-oqibat'; rise (o'zi ko'tariladi) — to'ldiruvchisiz to'g'ri ishlatilgan.

11.title: Board Game: Section 3 — MCQ, diagrams and notes
11.stage: Workbook (Track 8–9) tekshirilgandan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida: Section 3 strategiyasini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
11.goal: Section 3 strategiyasi (MCQ tuzog'i, diagram va notes uchun so'z turini oldindan aytish, word limit), sequencer'lar, mavzu paraphrase'lari va fosil/arxeologiya mavzusida Speaking Part 1/3 javoblari.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi. Kalit varag'i guruhdagi bitta 'hakam'da turadi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: strategiya savoliga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Hakam javobni kalit bilan solishtiradi (ochiq savollarda 'e.g.' — faqat namuna). Javob noto'g'ri yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Gapirish kataklarida kamida bitta sequencer (once, until, eventually, meanwhile) to'g'ri ishlatilsa — qo'shimcha 1 qadam oldinga.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Section 3: who usually speaks, and about what?
squares.a: Up to four people, e.g. students and a tutor, discussing an assignment or project.

squares.t: Name three sequencers that show the next stage of a process.
squares.a: e.g. as soon as, once, until, eventually, meanwhile

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'people who move from place to place'.
squares.a: nomadic people / nomads

squares.t: MCQ: what do you underline in the question stem?
squares.a: The key idea (e.g. WHY, MAIN, FIRST, AGREE) — not the options.

squares.t: Predict the word type: 'The seabed is soft and ___.'
squares.a: An adjective, e.g. muddy.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The trip is fully booked.'
squares.a: e.g. There are no places left on the trip.

squares.t: Part 1: Have you ever seen a fossil? Talk for 20 seconds.
squares.a: e.g. Yes, I saw some fossil shells in a museum; they were millions of years old.

squares.t: Why can all three MCQ options be mentioned in the recording?
squares.a: Speakers mention wrong options too, then reject or correct them.

squares.t: Say it differently: 'much earlier than that'.
squares.a: well before then / long before that

squares.t: Diagram labelling: what should you study before the audio?
squares.a: The title, the stages and the arrows; predict the word type for each gap.

squares.t: Finish the sentence: 'Once the fish is buried, …'
squares.a: e.g. …predators can no longer reach it.

squares.t: Correct: 'Minerals slowly replaces the bone.'
squares.a: Minerals slowly replace the bone. (plural subject, no -s)

squares.t: What does 'meanwhile' mean? Use it in a sentence.
squares.a: At the same time; e.g. Meanwhile, erosion wears the rock away.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'to domesticate animals'.
squares.a: to tame animals and keep them for farming

squares.t: Note completion: how do dates like '8,000 years ago' help you?
squares.a: They are signposts: they show which gap the speaker has reached.

squares.t: Part 1: Have you visited an ancient site, e.g. Afrosiyob in Samarkand?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, I visited Afrosiyob and saw its famous wall paintings.

squares.t: Correct: 'Layers build up until they will become rock.'
squares.a: …until they become rock. (no 'will' after 'until')

squares.t: A speaker says 'I'd always assumed…'. What usually follows?
squares.a: A correction: the real fact comes next, so wait for it.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a permanent settlement'.
squares.a: e.g. a place where people live all year round

squares.t: Explain in 3 steps how a fish becomes a fossil (use sequencers).
squares.a: e.g. It dies and sinks; once it is buried, minerals replace the bone; eventually it is exposed.

squares.t: ONE WORD ONLY: is 'the erosion' an acceptable answer?
squares.a: No — the article counts as a word; write 'erosion'.

squares.t: Part 3: Why is it important to protect ancient sites?
squares.a: e.g. They show how our ancestors lived, and once damaged, they are lost forever.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'They took to farming quickly.'
squares.a: They adapted to farming quickly / soon got good at it.

squares.t: Part 3: Should museums let visitors touch real fossils? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Only under supervision: touching makes learning memorable but risks damage.

11.title: Dominoes: fossils, the Neolithic and sequencers ↔ paraphrases
11.stage: 'Sinf mashqi' (sequencers ma'nosi) dan keyin, Student's Book audiosidan oldin: paraphrase isitish (12 daqiqa)
11.goal: Section 3 da javob so'zma-so'z emas, paraphrase bilan aytiladi: sequencer'lar (as soon as, meanwhile, eventually) va mavzu iboralarini (nomadic tribes, stay put, a chance discovery) ma'nodoshi bilan ulash.
rules: Har juftlik yoki 3 kishilik guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi iboraning paraphrase'i qaysi toshning chap tomonida turganini toping va ulang (masalan: 'fully booked' → 'with no places left').
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring: har ulanishda ma'no bir xil, so'zlar esa boshqa — xuddi audioda eshitiladigan paraphrase kabi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi.
Qo'shimcha topshiriq: har guruh 3 ta iborani tanlab, fosil yoki neolit davri haqida bittadan gap tuzadi.

pairs: in the end, after a long time
groups that moved from place to place
places where people lived all year round
to remain in the same place
to take to a new lifestyle
to adapt quickly to a new way of life
the gradual wearing away of rock
an object its owner values highly

11.title: Taboo: fossils, archaeology and the Stone Age
11.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' (ruins, shipwreck, amber, fossil rasmlari) dan keyin: mavzu so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa)
11.goal: Fosillar, arxeologiya va neolit davri so'zlarini (sediment, erosion, settlement, nomadic, domesticate…) inglizcha ta'rif, misol va jarayon orqali tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Ta'rif, misol yoki jarayon bosqichidan foydalanish mumkin (masalan: 'It happens when wind and water slowly…').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

11.title: Find someone who… has seen a real fossil
11.stage: Workbook (Track 8–9) va Jony Academy mashqi orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
11.goal: Tarix, arxeologiya, o'qish loyihalari va taqdimotlar bo'yicha C1 darajadagi savollarni (Have you ever…? / Would you…?) to'g'ri tuzish va javobni kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (Have you ever…? / Would you…? / Do you…?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va kamida bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Where? What was it like?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni sinfga paraphrase qilib aytib beradi.

items.t: …has seen a real fossil with their own eyes.
items.q: Have you ever seen a real fossil with your own eyes?

items.t: …has visited an archaeological site, e.g. Afrosiyob.

items.t: …has given a presentation with a partner this year.
items.q: Have you given a presentation with a partner this year?

items.t: …would consider a career in archaeology.
items.q: Would you consider a career in archaeology?

items.t: …has a prized possession that is over 50 years old.
items.q: Do you have a prized possession that is over 50 years old?

items.t: …has had to catch up on schoolwork after being ill.
items.q: Have you ever had to catch up on schoolwork after being ill?

items.t: …has watched a documentary about dinosaurs recently.
items.q: Have you watched a documentary about dinosaurs recently?

items.t: …has lived in the same house since they were born.
items.q: Have you lived in the same house since you were born?

items.t: …has taken to a new hobby surprisingly quickly.
items.q: Have you ever taken to a new hobby surprisingly quickly?

items.t: …has changed their mind during a group discussion.
items.q: Have you ever changed your mind during a group discussion?

items.t: …has drawn a diagram to explain a process.
items.q: Have you ever drawn a diagram to explain a process?

items.t: …knows roughly how old the city of Samarkand is.
items.q: Do you know roughly how old the city of Samarkand is?

11.title: Speaking cards: the distant past, museums and group projects
11.stage: 'Skript bilan tahlil' dan keyin, 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida — Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (12 daqiqa)
11.goal: Tarix, fosillar, arxeologiya va o'quv loyihalari bo'yicha IELTS Speaking Part 1 (qisqa) va Part 3 (fikr + sabab + misol) javoblari; mavzu so'zlari va sequencer'larni ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying; juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi karta olib, savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi Part 1 savoliga 20–30 soniya, Part 3 savoliga 40–60 soniya javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol.
Javobda kamida bitta mavzu so'zi (fossil, settlement, nomadic, archaeologist…) yoki sequencer to'g'ri ishlatilsa — +1 ball.
Tinglovchi javobni bitta gap bilan paraphrase qiladi (Section 3 dagi kabi) — ma'no to'g'ri bo'lsa unga ham +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy visiting museums? What kind of exhibits interest you most?
Have you ever found something old or unusual in the ground? What was it?

What can fossils tell us about life on Earth millions of years ago?

11.title: Sentence Race: processes, sequencers and Section 3 tips
11.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
11.goal: Jarayonni sequencer'lar bilan tasvirlaydigan gaplar (once, until) va Section 3 maslahatlarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni kesib, har birini alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf gap boshini, vergul va nuqta esa qism oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Tayyor bo'lgach, jamoa qo'lini ko'taradi va gapni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi — to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: jamoa gapdagi sequencer yoki strategiya maslahatini o'zbekcha tushuntirib bersa.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Once the fish is buried, predators can no longer reach it.
The skeleton stays hidden until erosion exposes it.
Study the arrows before the recording starts.
Sequencers help you move from one label to the next.
Farming allowed people to stay put all year round.
Archaeologists study objects that people left behind long ago.
An option you hear may still be wrong.
Speakers may correct themselves, so wait for the final fact.
An article counts as a word, so leave it out.

11.title: Quiz Board: Section 3, fossils and the Neolithic
11.stage: Keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida yoki takror darsida: Section 3 qoidalari va mavzu so'zlarini takrorlash (15 daqiqa)
11.goal: Section 3 qoidalari (MCQ tuzog'i, diagram, notes, word limit), paraphrase, fosil/arxeologiya so'zlari va sequencer'lar bilan gapirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (Section 3 rules, Paraphrase it, Topic words, Say it!) va 100–500 ballar.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' ning 200–500 ballik savollarida javob to'liq gap bilan bo'lishi shart; jarayon haqidagi javobda sequencer to'g'ri ishlatiladi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Who usually speaks in IELTS Listening Section 3?
qs.a: Students, often with a tutor (up to 4 speakers)

qs.q: MCQ: should you underline the key idea in the stem or in the options?

In a process diagram, which words tell you the speaker is moving to the next label?
qs.a: Sequencers: once, as soon as, until, eventually

qs.q: Today's 3-word phrase meaning 'much earlier than that'.
Two-word phrase meaning 'to remain in one place' (stay …).
A tour with no places left is 'f… b…' (two words).
Phrase for 'something found by accident' (a c… discovery).
Phrasal verb with 'take': to start liking or doing something new quickly and easily.

qs.q: The preserved remains of an ancient plant or animal in rock.

12.title: Grammar Auction: edtech, smart cities and digital life
12.stage: Workbook matni (How Green is your PlanIT Valley?) tekshirilgandan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: Ta'lim texnologiyasi, aqlli shahar va raqamli hayot mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini topish: predlog (sceptical about, cater to), so'z shakli (prohibitively), iboralar (in vain, from scratch), kelishuv.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar onlayn ta'lim, aqlli shaharlar va raqamli hayot haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'sceptical ABOUT, to emas').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Online videos are a useful supplement to classroom teaching.
items.why: a supplement TO sth — to'g'ri predlog; 'useful supplement' — tabiiy birikma.

items.s: Many residents are sceptical to the idea of a smart city.
items.fix: Many residents are sceptical about the idea of a smart city.
items.why: sceptical ABOUT (yoki OF) — 'to' emas.

items.s: With the new software, each student can learn at his or her own pace.
items.why: at one's own pace — to'g'ri ibora; 'his or her' birlikdagi 'each student' ga mos.

items.s: One-to-one tutoring is prohibitive expensive for most families.
items.fix: One-to-one tutoring is prohibitively expensive for most families.
items.why: Sifatni ravish aniqlaydi: prohibitively expensive.

items.s: The government plans to overhaul the national curriculum.
items.why: overhaul — 'tubdan qayta qurmoq'; plan to + fe'l — to'g'ri.

items.s: All our attempts to fix the old laptop were in vein.
items.fix: All our attempts to fix the old laptop were in vain.
items.why: Ibora — 'in vain' (bekorga); 'vein' — qon tomiri.

items.s: Critics argue that rote learning is an outdated technique.
items.why: argue that + gap; outdated — sifat, to'g'ri ishlatilgan.

items.s: The new city is being built from the scratch in the desert.
items.fix: The new city is being built from scratch in the desert.
items.why: 'from scratch' (noldan) iborasida artikl yo'q.

items.s: Many apps gloss over the risks of sharing personal data.
items.why: gloss over sth — 'yuzaki o'tib ketmoq'; ko'plik ega (apps) + fe'l to'g'ri.

items.s: The new banking app mainly caters young users.
items.fix: The new banking app mainly caters to young users.
items.why: cater TO (yoki FOR) sb — predlogsiz ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: The results of the survey was far from credible.
items.fix: The results of the survey were far from credible.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (the results) — fe'l ham ko'plik: were.

items.s: She has long been a strong advocate of flipped classrooms.
items.why: an advocate OF (yoki FOR) sth — to'g'ri; has long been — Present Perfect.

12.title: Board Game: Passage 3 — MCQ, Yes/No/Not Given, endings
12.stage: Practice 1 tahlilidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida: uch savol turi strategiyasini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
12.goal: Passage 3 strategiyasi (MCQ tuzog'i, reference savoli, Y/N/NG — yozuvchi da'vosi, sentence endings), mavzu paraphrase'lari va texnologiya/ta'lim mavzusida Speaking Part 1/3 javoblari.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi. Kalit varag'i guruhdagi bitta 'hakam'da turadi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: strategiya savoliga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Hakam javobni kalit bilan solishtiradi (ochiq savollarda 'e.g.' — faqat namuna). Javob noto'g'ri yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Gapirish kataklarida hedging (It seems…, It is likely that…, I'd argue…) ishlatilsa — qo'shimcha 1 qadam oldinga.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Y/N/NG: does it test facts or the writer's claims?
squares.a: The writer's claims and opinions.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'outdated'.
squares.a: old-fashioned / no longer useful

squares.t: Part 1: Do you use any apps to study? Which ones?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, I use Quizlet for vocabulary and YouTube for maths.

squares.t: What is the difference between NO and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: NO: the writer's claim contradicts it; NOT GIVEN: the writer makes no claim about it.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The report glosses over the costs.'
squares.a: The report deals with the costs too briefly / hardly mentions them.

squares.t: Endings A–G for questions 11–14: how many endings are extra?
squares.a: Three; the extra endings are traps, often taken from the text.

squares.t: One word (a…): 'someone who publicly supports an idea'.
squares.a: an advocate

squares.t: Reference question (e.g. 'this change'): where is the answer?
squares.a: Before or after the word — read 2–3 sentences around it.

squares.t: Part 3: Can online videos replace teachers? Why or why not?
squares.a: e.g. Not fully: videos explain well, but teachers motivate and give feedback.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Our efforts were in vain.'
squares.a: Our efforts had no result / were useless.

squares.t: Why do wrong MCQ options often use words from the text?
squares.a: They are traps: they reuse text words but refer to another person, time or idea.

squares.t: Correct: 'He is sceptical to smart cities.'
squares.a: He is sceptical about (or of) smart cities.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'They built the city from scratch.'
squares.a: They built a completely new city, starting with nothing.

squares.t: A critic is quoted in the text. Is this the writer's own view?
squares.a: Not necessarily — Y/N/NG tests only what the writer claims.

squares.t: Part 1: Would you like to work from home in the future?
squares.a: e.g. Partly — I'd save time on the commute, but I'd miss my colleagues.

squares.t: What does 'anything but' mean? Give an example.
squares.a: not at all; e.g. The lesson was anything but boring.

squares.t: Sentence endings: what two things must the full sentence be?
squares.a: Grammatically correct and true according to the passage.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'prohibitively expensive'.
squares.a: far too costly for most people to afford

squares.t: Part 3: What are the advantages of a smart city?
squares.a: e.g. Smart traffic lights reduce jams and sensors save energy.

squares.t: No sentence in the text proves YES or NO. What is the answer?
squares.a: Probably NOT GIVEN.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Many pupils grapple with algebra.'
squares.a: e.g. Many pupils struggle to understand algebra / find it very hard.

squares.t: Part 3: Is memorising facts still important in the internet age?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — basic knowledge helps us judge what we read online.

squares.t: How should you divide 20 minutes between the three tasks?
squares.a: About: MCQ 7, Y/N/NG 6, endings 5, checking and transfer 2 minutes.

squares.t: Part 3: Should schools replace paper books with tablets?
squares.a: e.g. Not completely: tablets are easy to update, but paper helps concentration.

12.title: Dominoes: edtech and digital-life paraphrases
12.stage: 'Sinf mashqi' (reference so'zlar) dan keyin, Student's Book matnidan oldin: paraphrase isitish (12 daqiqa)
12.goal: Passage 3 da savol va matn bir xil so'z bilan emas, paraphrase bilan bog'lanadi: mavzu iboralarini (gloss over, in vain, from scratch, prohibitively expensive…) ma'nodoshi bilan ulash.
rules: Har juftlik yoki 3 kishilik guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi iboraning paraphrase'i qaysi toshning chap tomonida turganini toping va ulang (masalan: 'in vain' → 'without any success').
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring: har ulanishda ma'no bir xil, so'zlar esa boshqa — xuddi savol va matn orasidagi paraphrase kabi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi.
Qo'shimcha topshiriq: har guruh 3 ta iborani tanlab, onlayn ta'lim yoki aqlli shahar haqida bittadan gap tuzadi.

pairs: as fast or as slowly as they wish
to deal with them too briefly

12.title: Taboo: technology in education and digital life
12.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' savollaridan keyin: ta'lim texnologiyasi va raqamli hayot so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa)
12.goal: Ta'limdagi texnologiya, aqlli shahar va raqamli hayot so'zlarini (curriculum, pace, sceptical, commute, search engine…) inglizcha ta'rif va misol orqali tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Ta'rif, misol yoki qarama-qarshi ma'nodan foydalanish mumkin (masalan: 'The opposite of trusting…').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

12.title: Find someone who… has taken an online course
12.stage: Practice 1 va Practice 2 orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
12.goal: Onlayn ta'lim, raqamli xotira va masofaviy ish bo'yicha C1 darajadagi savollarni (Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Are you…?) to'g'ri tuzish va javobni kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (zamonni to'g'ri tanlash: this year → Present Perfect, habit → Present Simple).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va kamida bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Which one? Why? Was it useful?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni sinfga paraphrase qilib aytib beradi.

items.t: …has taken an online course this year.
items.q: Have you taken an online course this year?

items.t: …has learnt something new from a YouTube video this week.
items.q: Have you learnt anything new from a YouTube video this week?

items.t: …can recite a friend's phone number from memory.
items.q: Can you recite a friend's phone number from memory?

items.t: …has used an AI tool to check their writing.
items.q: Have you ever used an AI tool to check your writing?

items.t: …has attended a lesson by video call.
items.q: Have you ever attended a lesson by video call?

items.t: …prefers reading long texts on paper rather than on a screen.
items.q: Do you prefer reading long texts on paper rather than on a screen?

items.t: …is sceptical about learning only online.
items.q: Are you sceptical about learning only online?

items.t: …has built something from scratch, e.g. a website.
items.q: Have you ever built something from scratch, such as a website?

items.t: …would like to work from home in the future.
items.q: Would you like to work from home in the future?

items.t: …has tried in vain to fix a broken gadget.
items.q: Have you ever tried in vain to fix a broken gadget?

items.t: …takes photos of the board instead of taking notes.
items.q: Do you take photos of the board instead of taking notes?

items.t: …has paid for something with a phone app this month.
items.q: Have you paid for anything with a phone app this month?

12.title: Speaking cards: technology, learning and the digital society
12.stage: Practice 2 tahlilidan keyin, 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida — Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (12 daqiqa)
12.goal: Ta'limdagi texnologiya, aqlli shahar, raqamli xotira va masofaviy ish bo'yicha IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 javoblari; fikrni hedging bilan (It seems…, I'd argue…) va mavzu so'zlari bilan ifodalash.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying; juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi karta olib, savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi Part 1 savoliga 20–30 soniya, Part 3 savoliga 40–60 soniya javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol.
Javobda mavzu so'zi (pace, curriculum, sceptical, outdated…) yoki hedging ibora (It seems…, It is likely that…) to'g'ri ishlatilsa — +1 ball.
Javobdan keyin tinglovchi bitta da'vo aytadi (masalan: 'You said online lessons are cheaper'). Javob bergan o'quvchi YES / NO / NOT GIVEN deb baholaydi; to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: How often do you use technology when you study? Give an example.
Do you think online lessons are as effective as face-to-face ones? Why?
What would your ideal school of the future look like?
Should every lesson be tailored to each student's pace? Is that realistic?
Some people say computers will replace teachers. Do you agree?
Would you like to live in a smart city? What would you expect it to offer?
What are the risks of storing all our personal information online?
Do you rely on your phone to remember things? Is that a problem?
Is it still worth memorising facts when you can search for anything?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of working from home?
Do you prefer reading on paper or on a screen? Why?
How has technology changed the way young people in Uzbekistan communicate?
Why are some older people sceptical about new technology?
Which invention of the last twenty years has changed daily life the most?

12.title: Sentence Race: writers' claims and hedged statements
12.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
12.goal: Passage 3 strategiyasi va texnologiya mavzusidagi hedged da'volar (may, doubt that) hamda paraphrase qilingan gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni kesib, har birini alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf gap boshini, vergul va nuqta esa qism oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Tayyor bo'lgach, jamoa qo'lini ko'taradi va gapni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi — to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: jamoa gapni boshqa so'zlar bilan paraphrase qilib aytsa (masalan: 'in vain' → 'without success').
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Wrong options often repeat words from the passage.
A quoted opinion may not belong to the writer.
Three of the seven endings will not be used.
The writer doubts that the project will ever be finished.
Critics are sceptical about building a city from scratch.
Pupils can replay the video until they understand it.
The cost of a smart city is difficult to predict.
Remote work saves time but can make people feel lonely.
Many people rely on their phones to remember phone numbers.

12.title: Quiz Board: Passage 3 and the IT society
12.stage: Keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida yoki takror darsida: Passage 3 qoidalari va mavzu so'zlarini takrorlash (15 daqiqa)
12.goal: Passage 3 qoidalari (MCQ, reference, Y/N/NG, sentence endings), paraphrase, ta'lim texnologiyasi so'zlari va hedging bilan gapirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (Passage 3 rules, Paraphrase it, Topic words, Say it!) va 100–500 ballar.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Topic words 400').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' ning 200–500 ballik savollarida javob to'liq gap bilan bo'lishi shart; 400 ballik savolda hedging (It seems…, It is unlikely that…) kutiladi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Do Y/N/NG questions test facts or the writer's claims?
Do the MCQ questions follow the order of the text?
qs.a: Yes, they follow the text order

qs.q: The topic is mentioned, but the writer makes no claim about it. Answer?
A question asks what 'this' refers to. Where do you look for the answer?
qs.a: 2–3 sentences before and after the word

qs.q: Why do unused sentence endings often appear in the text too?
qs.a: As traps: they refer to another person or idea

qs.q: One word from today's lesson meaning 'old-fashioned'.
Two-word phrase (in …) meaning 'without any success'.
Two-word phrase meaning 'starting with nothing' (from …).
Two words meaning 'far too costly for most people' (p… expensive).
Phrasal verb (g… over): 'to deal with something too briefly, skipping details'.
The subjects and content that a school or course teaches (c…).
The speed at which someone learns or works (p…).
Adjective (s…): doubtful that something is true or will work.
A person who publicly supports an idea or cause (a…).
Noun: the quality of being only average, not very good.
Name two apps or websites you use for learning.
Give one advantage of online lessons in one sentence.
qs.a: e.g. You can learn at your own pace.

qs.q: Make a sentence with 'anything but'.
qs.a: e.g. The new app is anything but easy to use.

qs.q: Give a hedged opinion: will robots replace teachers?
qs.a: e.g. It seems unlikely that robots will fully replace teachers.

qs.q: Explain NO vs NOT GIVEN in one sentence.
qs.a: NO: the writer claims the opposite; NG: the writer makes no claim.

13.title: Grammar Auction: animation, banking and technology
13.stage: 'Skript bilan tahlil'dan keyin: ko'plik, so'z turi va birikma xatolari (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
13.goal: Animatsiya, internet-banking va texnologiya tarixi mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini topish: ko'plik -s, so'z turi (loyal/loyalty), reluctant to, catch on. Note completion'da ham aynan shu xatolar ball olib qo'yadi.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar animatsiya, bank va texnologiya tarixi haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'reluctant TO pay, for paying emas') +50 oladi.

Oxirida ustoz so'raydi: 'Qaysi xatolar note completion javobida ham 0 ball beradi?' (ko'plik, so'z turi) — to'g'ri javob +50. Eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Early cartoons were made from thousands of hand-drawn frames.
items.why: frames — ko'plik; hand-drawn — defisli sifat (bitta so'z).

items.s: Many customers were reluctant for paying bills online in the 1990s.
items.fix: Many customers were reluctant to pay bills online in the 1990s.
items.why: reluctant + to + fe'l ('for + -ing' emas).

items.s: The rise in online thefts testifies to the risks of internet banking.
items.why: testify to + ot — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: Each frames of the film took several hours to produce.
items.fix: Each frame of the film took several hours to produce.
items.why: each + birlikdagi ot: each frame.

items.s: The film earned in excess of one billion dollars worldwide.
items.why: in excess of = more than; raqamdan oldin keladi.

items.s: The idea of paying by phone quickly caught up in other countries.
items.fix: The idea of paying by phone quickly caught on in other countries.
items.why: catch on — ommalashmoq; catch up — yetib olmoq (boshqa ma'no).

items.s: Online banking really took off when smartphones became widespread.
items.why: take off (took off) — keskin rivojlanmoq, ommalashmoq.

items.s: Most account holder now check their statements on their phones.
items.fix: Most account holders now check their statements on their phones.
items.why: most + ko'plikdagi ot: account holders.

items.s: Lifelike movement enhanced the appeal of the main character.
items.why: enhance the appeal of — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: The simulation of crowds made the battle scenes more believe.
items.fix: The simulation of crowds made the battle scenes more believable.
items.why: make + ot + sifat: believable (believe — fe'l).

items.s: Computer animation has broken new ground in the simulation of human skin.
items.why: break new ground (broken — V3) — yangi yo'l ochmoq.

items.s: Online banking has increased customer loyal to banks.
items.fix: Online banking has increased customer loyalty to banks.
items.why: increase + ot kerak: loyalty (loyal — sifat).

13.title: Board Game: Section 4 note completion
13.stage: Workbook Track 10 tekshiruvidan keyin yoki keyingi darsda: Section 4 strategiyasini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
13.goal: Section 4 note completion strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash: so'z turini bashorat qilish, NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER, signal iboralar, raqam distraktorlari; IT mavzusida paraphrase va Speaking javoblari.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: so'z turini bashorat qiladi, paraphrase aytadi, qoidani tushuntiradi yoki savolga 2–3 gap bilan javob beradi.
Guruh ustozning javob kalitidan tekshiradi. Javob xato yoki umuman yo'q bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Say it' va 'Talk' kataklarida javob kamida 20 soniya davom etishi kerak; guruhdan bittasi vaqtni o'lchaydi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Section 4: how many speakers, and is there a pause in the middle?
squares.a: One speaker (a lecture) and no pause — so read all the notes before it starts.

squares.t: Predict the word type: 'produced hundreds of ___ by hand'
squares.a: A plural noun (e.g. sketches / frames).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'more than 6 billion dollars'
squares.a: in excess of / over 6 billion dollars

squares.t: Predict the answer type: 'Cost: about £___'
squares.a: A number (an amount of money).

squares.t: Is 'hand-drawn' one word or two for the word limit?
squares.a: One word — a hyphenated word counts as one.

squares.t: Say it: What cartoon did you love as a child? Why?
squares.a: e.g. I loved Tom and Jerry because the characters were so expressive.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'believable characters'
squares.a: convincing / credible / realistic characters

squares.t: Limit: TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. Is '4.5 million' OK?
squares.a: Yes — a number plus one word is allowed.

squares.t: What does 'A second aspect…' tell you in a lecture?
squares.a: The speaker is moving on to the next point in the notes.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Internet banking took off.'
squares.a: Internet banking grew rapidly / became very popular.

squares.t: Notes: 'cards and ___'. Why not write 'cards and apps' as your answer?
squares.a: 'Cards' is already in the notes — write only the missing word: apps.

squares.t: Predict: 'customers needed a ___ to log in'
squares.a: A singular countable noun (after 'a'), e.g. password.

squares.t: Say it: Do you use a banking app? What for?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, I use it to pay bills and send money to friends in seconds.

squares.t: Name two signal phrases that introduce a new point.
squares.a: e.g. Firstly… / A further challenge… / Moving on to… / And lastly…

squares.t: Speaker: 'cost 2 million to make… earned 40 million'. Notes: 'Earnings: $___'?
squares.a: 40 million — 2 million was the cost, not the earnings.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'People were reluctant to shop online.'
squares.a: People were unwilling / hesitant to buy things online.

squares.t: Singular or plural? 'one of the main ___ of online banking'
squares.a: Plural noun ('one of the' + plural), e.g. advantages.

squares.t: Say it: How has technology changed shopping in your city?
squares.a: e.g. Most shops accept QR payments now, so people rarely carry cash.

squares.t: What is a distractor in a lecture? Give an example.
squares.a: Information that seems to fit the gap but is wrong, e.g. 'You might expect X… in fact, Y.'

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The idea soon caught on.'
squares.a: The idea quickly became popular / widely used.

squares.t: Your answer has three words, but the limit is two. What do you do?
squares.a: Remove words already in the notes or extra describing words; the correct answer always fits.

squares.t: Notes ask for a METHOD. Speaker: 'We used motion capture to make faces look real.'
squares.a: motion capture — the method, not the result (faces that look real).

squares.t: Say it: Will cash disappear in Uzbekistan? Give two reasons.
squares.a: e.g. Probably — payment apps are fast, and even small shops accept cards.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: the most important invention of the last 50 years.
squares.a: e.g. The smartphone — it is a bank, a camera and a map in one device.

13.title: Dominoes: notes wording ↔ lecture paraphrase
13.stage: 'Sinf mashqi' bosqichida, CD2 Track 1 dan oldin: ma'ruzadagi paraphrase'larga tayyorlanish (12 daqiqa)
13.goal: Notes'dagi ifodani ma'ruzachi aytishi mumkin bo'lgan paraphrase bilan bog'lash (in excess of = more than, reluctant = unwilling, caught on = became popular) — Section 4 da 'so'zni emas, ma'noni tinglash'.
rules: Har juftlik/guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida notes'dagi ifoda yozilgan (masalan: 'the idea caught on').
Shu ifodaning paraphrase'i (masalan: 'the concept became popular') chap tomonida yozilgan toshni toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('Notes: … — Speaker: …'); ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

a sharp rise in online thefts

Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.

rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you paid for anything with a QR code this week?).

rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Shaxsiy savolga (Part 1) 2–3 gap, fikr so'raydigan savolga (Part 3) 4–5 gap bilan javob beriladi: fikr + sabab + misol.

Dars so'zlari (catch on, take off, reluctant, convincing, transaction…) ishlatilsa — har biri +1 ball.

rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning kesilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Tayyor bo'lgach, jamoa gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi. Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Maslahat gapini (masalan: 'Hyphenated words count as one word.') to'g'ri tergan jamoa uning ma'nosini o'zbekcha tushuntirsa +1 qo'shimcha ball.

sentences: Read all the notes before the lecture begins.

13.title: Quiz Board: note completion and IT society

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').

To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa, ball ularga).
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many speakers are there in Listening Section 4?

Notes: 'Earnings: over $___'. You hear 'over 40 million dollars'. What do you write?

qs.a: Check what each number refers to (e.g. cost vs earnings)

14.title: Grammar Auction: bees, wolves and ecosystems
14.stage: 'Nega 0 ball?' mashqidan keyin: ko'plik, predlog, so'z turi xatolari (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
14.goal: Tabiat va ekotizim mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini topish: species/specie, depend on, affect/effect, extinct (sifat), the number of + has, ravish shakli. Sentence completion'da ham shunday xatolar 0 ball beradi.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar changlatuvchilar, yirtqichlar va ekotizimlar haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'depend ON, from emas') +50 oladi.
Oxirida ustoz so'raydi: 'Qaysi xatolar sentence completion javobida ham 0 ball beradi?' (ko'plik, imlo, so'z shakli) — to'g'ri javob +50. Eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib.

items.s: Bees are the best-known pollinators, but many other insects also carry pollen.
items.why: best-known — defisli sifat; also — fe'l oldida.

items.s: There are more than 300 specie of hummingbird in the Americas.
items.fix: There are more than 300 species of hummingbird in the Americas.
items.why: species — birlik va ko'plikda bir xil; 'specie' bu ma'noda yo'q.

items.s: The disappearance of a single insect species can have far-reaching consequences.
items.why: far-reaching consequences — to'g'ri birikma; a single species — birlik (species shakli o'zgarmaydi).

items.s: Many farmers depend from honeybees to pollinate their crops.
items.fix: Many farmers depend on honeybees to pollinate their crops.
items.why: depend ON — 'from' emas.

items.s: Some wildflowers thrive in poor, dry soil.
items.why: thrive in + sharoit — yaxshi o'smoq; to'g'ri ishlatilgan.

items.s: Removing one predator can effect the whole ecosystem.
items.fix: Removing one predator can affect the whole ecosystem.
items.why: affect — fe'l (ta'sir qilmoq); effect — ot (ta'sir).

items.s: Planting native flowers along field edges could bolster insect populations.
items.why: bolster populations — sonini ko'paytirmoq; could + V1.

items.s: The dodo was extincted by the late 17th century.
items.fix: The dodo was extinct by the late 17th century.
items.why: extinct — sifat; 'extincted' degan fe'l shakli yo'q.

items.s: Ravens and foxes feed on the carcasses that wolves leave behind.
items.why: feed on — bilan oziqlanmoq; carcasses — ko'plik.

items.s: The number of wild bees have fallen sharply in Europe.
items.fix: The number of wild bees has fallen sharply in Europe.
items.why: 'The number of …' — birlik ega: has fallen.

items.s: The biodiversity of the region has declined dramatical since the 1970s.
items.fix: The biodiversity of the region has declined dramatically since the 1970s.
items.why: Fe'lni ravish aniqlaydi: dramatically.

items.s: A species that seems unimportant in isolation may support dozens of others.
items.why: in isolation — alohida olganda; seems — birlik ega bilan.

14.title: Board Game: headings, sentences and TWO letters
14.stage: Practice 1 tahlilidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida: uch savol turi strategiyasini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
14.goal: Matching headings, sentence completion (NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS) va Choose TWO letters strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash; tabiat mavzusida paraphrase va Speaking javoblari.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savol turi qoidasini tushuntiradi, paraphrase aytadi yoki tabiat haqidagi savolga 2–3 gap bilan javob beradi.
Guruh ustozning javob kalitidan tekshiradi. Javob xato yoki umuman yo'q bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Say it' va 'Talk' kataklarida javob kamida 20 soniya davom etishi kerak; guruhdan bittasi vaqtni o'lchaydi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Say it: Name three pollinators.
squares.a: e.g. bees, butterflies and bats (also birds and beetles)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a sharp decline in bee numbers'
squares.a: a dramatic fall in the bee population

squares.t: 10 headings, 7 paragraphs. How many headings are extra?
squares.a: Three.

squares.t: How long should you spend on 7 headings in a 20-minute passage?
squares.a: About 10 minutes (then about 4 + 4 minutes, and 2 for checking).

squares.t: Explain 'habitat' in your own words.
squares.a: The natural place where an animal or plant lives.

squares.t: What do you write in the margin while doing headings?
squares.a: A 3–4 word main idea for each paragraph — a map for later questions.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'to bolster populations'
squares.a: to increase / strengthen numbers

squares.t: Sentence completion: can you change the form of words from the text?
squares.a: No — copy them exactly, with the same spelling and plural -s.

squares.t: Say it: Is there more or less wildlife near your home than 10 years ago?
squares.a: e.g. Less — new houses have replaced the fields and trees.

squares.t: Why is a heading that fits only ONE detail usually wrong?
squares.a: A heading sums up the whole paragraph, not one example.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a menace to wildlife'
squares.a: a threat / danger to wildlife

squares.t: Limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS. Is 'the young willow trees' OK?
squares.a: No — four words; check whether 'the' is really needed.

squares.t: Explain 'keystone species' in your own words.
squares.a: A species a whole ecosystem depends on; removing it changes everything.

squares.t: The gap says 'both ___'. What must you check?
squares.a: That you write BOTH things, e.g. 'birds and bats'.

squares.t: TWO letters: an option says the opposite of the text. Choose it?
squares.a: No — it contradicts the passage.

squares.t: Say it: Should wolves be brought back where they once lived? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, they restore balance, but farmers should get compensation.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'to wear down the immune system'
squares.a: to gradually weaken the body's defences

squares.t: Headings, sentences, TWO letters: which task do you do first, and why?
squares.a: Headings — they make you read the whole text and build a map.

squares.t: Gap: 'the number of ___ fell'. What kind of word is needed?
squares.a: A plural countable noun (e.g. bees / predators).

squares.t: TWO letters (Q12–13): how many marks for one correct letter?
squares.a: One mark — each correct letter scores separately.

squares.t: Say it: How can cities help bees and butterflies?
squares.a: e.g. Plant wildflowers in parks and use fewer pesticides.

squares.t: A heading repeats a word from the paragraph. Is it the answer?
squares.a: Not necessarily — Band 7 headings paraphrase; word matching is often a trap.

squares.t: Explain a chain reaction in an ecosystem with an example.
squares.a: e.g. Fewer wolves → more deer → fewer young trees → fewer birds.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: Why does biodiversity matter to humans?
squares.a: e.g. Our food, medicines and clean water depend on healthy ecosystems.

14.title: Dominoes: headings ↔ paragraph summaries
14.stage: 'Uch savol turi birga' tushuntirishidan keyin, Gold dusters matnidan oldin: sarlavha ↔ mazmun isitish (12 daqiqa)
14.goal: Abstrakt sarlavhani bo'limning bir gaplik mazmuni bilan moslashtirish (Band 7 matching headings): sarlavha so'zlari mazmunda takrorlanmaydi — g'oya moslashtiriladi, so'z emas.

Zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi. Ustoz savollar shaklini kalit bilan tekshiradi.
