Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Much of the public interest in Mars stems from science fiction.
items.why: stem FROM — kelib chiqmoq; ega birlik (much of the interest) → stems.

items.s: The success of the mission depends of international funding.
items.fix: The success of the mission depends on international funding.
items.why: depend ON — 'of' emas.

items.s: Any journey to Mars is fraught with technical difficulties.
items.why: be fraught WITH — (xavf, qiyinchilik)ka to'la; to'g'ri.

items.s: Two launch delays have risen the cost of the mission considerably.
items.fix: Two launch delays have raised the cost of the mission considerably.
items.why: rise — o'timsiz (to'ldiruvchi olmaydi); 'the cost' to'ldiruvchi → raise (raised).

items.s: The value of international collaboration in space cannot be overstated.
items.why: cannot be overstated — juda muhim; passiv shakl to'g'ri.

items.s: Astronomers have found several potentially habitat planets near other stars.
items.fix: Astronomers have found several potentially habitable planets near other stars.
items.why: Otdan oldin sifat kerak: habitable (yashashga yaroqli); habitat — ot.

items.s: The failure of one rocket engine was resulted in a two-year delay.
items.fix: The failure of one rocket engine resulted in a two-year delay.
items.why: result in — faqat faol nisbatda ishlatiladi; 'was resulted in' xato.

items.s: The volunteers had to cope with over a year of isolation in a mock spacecraft.
items.why: cope WITH; over a year of isolation — to'g'ri.

items.s: It comes as no surprise that the project attract so much attention.
items.fix: It comes as no surprise that the project attracts so much attention.
items.why: Ega birlik (the project) → attracts (-s).

items.s: Parts of the Atacama Desert provide a useful replica of the Martian surface.
items.why: a replica OF something; Parts … provide — ko'plik moslashuvi to'g'ri.

items.s: Satellites contribute for our understanding of climate change.
items.fix: Satellites contribute to our understanding of climate change.
items.why: contribute TO — 'for' emas.

items.s: A permanent settlement on Mars would have to be sustainable without supplies from Earth.
items.why: sustainable — sifat, 'be' dan keyin to'g'ri; would have to + be.

16.title: Board Game: Y/N/NG, writer's purpose and word boxes
16.stage: Keyingi dars boshida yoki takror darsida: uch savol turi strategiyasini takrorlash (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
16.goal: Passage 3 kombinatsiyasi strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash: YES / NO / NOT GIVEN (yozuvchi fikri), MCQ 'writer's purpose', summary + A–I qutisi (so'z turi, o'timli fe'l); paraphrase, fe'l + predlog va koinot mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni inglizcha bajaradi: strategiya savoliga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi, predlogni aytadi yoki 20 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi (ustozda javoblar kaliti). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Y/N/NG kataklarida faqat javob emas, sababi ham aytilishi shart (masalan: 'NO, because the text gives the reason').
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: What is the difference between YES/NO/NOT GIVEN and TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: Y/N/NG checks the writer's views or claims; T/F/NG checks facts.

squares.t: Say the meaning of 'habitable'.
squares.a: Suitable for people or other living things to live in.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'harsh environments'
squares.a: extreme conditions / hostile surroundings

squares.t: Statement: 'The cause is unknown.' The text states the cause. Y, N or NG?
squares.a: NO — the text contradicts 'unknown'.

squares.t: Complete: 'The problem stems ___ a lack of funding.'
squares.a: from

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: would you like to travel into space? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — seeing Earth from orbit would take my breath away, although…

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'an excellent replica'
squares.a: an ideal model / a very close copy

squares.t: Summary gap: 'in ___ situations'. What word class do you need?
squares.a: An adjective (e.g. extreme).

squares.t: Which words in a Y/N/NG statement should you check most carefully?
squares.a: Evaluative or comparing words: unclear, more … than, unfortunately, only.

squares.t: Word box: 'rise' or 'increase'? 'The mission will ___ our knowledge of Mars.'
squares.a: increase — 'rise' is intransitive and cannot take an object.

squares.t: Give two verbs that can describe a writer's purpose.
squares.a: e.g. explain, persuade, criticise, compare

squares.t: Part 1: Do you enjoy films or documentaries about space? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, I love documentaries about Mars because…

squares.t: Where is the answer to a 'significance' question often found?
squares.a: Often in the last sentence of the paragraph, which gives its point.

squares.t: Complete: 'The mission is fraught ___ danger.'
squares.a: with

squares.t: Why should you answer the 'writer's purpose' question last?
squares.a: You need the whole text to judge its overall aim and tone.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'long-term isolation'
squares.a: extended periods on your own

squares.t: A word box has 9 options for 5 gaps. How many are distractors?
squares.a: Four.

squares.t: Make a sentence about space with 'It comes as no surprise that…'.
squares.a: e.g. It comes as no surprise that Mars attracts so much funding.

squares.t: Statement: 'X gets more money than Y.' The text never compares them. Answer?
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — the text does not make this comparison.

squares.t: What should you do when you see 'this approach' or 'both groups'?
squares.a: Find what it refers to earlier in the text (referencing).

squares.t: Part 3: Is space exploration worth the money? Give one argument.
squares.a: e.g. Yes — satellites improve weather forecasts and GPS.

squares.t: The text explains with examples but asks readers to do nothing. Purpose?
squares.a: To explain / inform — not to persuade.

squares.t: Part 3: Should countries compete or collaborate in space? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Collaborate — costs are shared and knowledge spreads faster.

squares.t: How long should you spend on Passage 3, and how would you divide the time?
squares.a: About 20 min: map 2, Y/N/NG 5, MCQ 5, summary 5, check 3.

16.title: Dominoes: text phrases ↔ question paraphrases
16.stage: Practice 1 tahlilidan keyin — SB va WB matnlaridan so'ng (oldin o'ynalsa, javoblarni ochib qo'yadi): paraphrase takrori (12 daqiqa)
16.goal: Matndagi akademik ibora va savol yoki summary'dagi paraphrase'ni tez ulash (harsh environments = extreme conditions, long-term isolation = extended periods alone) — Y/N/NG, MCQ va summary'da javob joyini topish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi matn iborasi bilan bir xil ma'noli paraphrase qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Har iboraning faqat bitta to'g'ri juftligi bor.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('harsh environments means extreme conditions'); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; bonus: 2 ta iborani o'z gapida ishlatsa +1.

pairs: stretch human ingenuity to its limits
severely test our skill and intelligence
keep the goals going for many years
has its origins in a wish to know
a world where life could survive
places that are hard to reach

16.title: Taboo: across the universe
16.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' savolidan keyin: koinot so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
16.goal: Koinot va kosmik tadqiqot so'zlarini (atmosphere, habitable, replica, settlement, extraterrestrial, ingenuity) taqiqlangan so'zlarsiz inglizcha paraphrase qilib tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi. IELTS'dagidek paraphrase qiling: ta'rif, misol, qarama-qarshi ma'no.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish va so'zni harflab aytish mumkin emas; imo-ishora mumkin.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

16.title: Find someone who… has looked at the Moon through a telescope
16.stage: Student's Book va Workbook matnlari orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
16.goal: Koinot, fan va xalqaro hamkorlik bo'yicha tajriba va fikrlar haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Would you…? Do you think…? Could you…?) va darsdagi so'zlarni ishlatish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever looked at the Moon through a telescope?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? When? What was it like?) — javobdan bitta kalit so'zni yozib oladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi. Ustoz savollar shaklini kalit bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …has looked at the Moon through a telescope.
items.q: Have you ever looked at the Moon through a telescope?

items.t: …would travel to Mars if given the chance.
items.q: Would you travel to Mars if you were given the chance?

items.t: …has visited a planetarium or a space museum.
items.q: Have you ever visited a planetarium or a space museum?

items.t: …has watched a rocket launch live online.
items.q: Have you ever watched a rocket launch live online?

items.t: …believes that extraterrestrial life exists.
items.q: Do you believe that extraterrestrial life exists?

items.t: …has seen the Milky Way with his/her own eyes.
items.q: Have you ever seen the Milky Way with your own eyes?

items.t: …has worked on a project with students from another country.
items.q: Have you ever worked on a project with students from another country?

items.t: …can name the first person to walk on the Moon.
items.q: Can you name the first person to walk on the Moon?

items.t: …thinks governments spend too much on space research.
items.q: Do you think governments spend too much on space research?

items.t: …could cope with a year of isolation.
items.q: Could you cope with a year of isolation?

items.t: …has read a science-fiction novel this year.
items.q: Have you read a science-fiction novel this year?

items.t: …knows which Uzbek city has a famous historic observatory.
items.q: Do you know which Uzbek city has a famous historic observatory?

16.title: Speaking cards: space, science and collaboration
16.stage: Practice 2 dan keyin, Kahoot oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida — Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (12 daqiqa)
16.goal: Koinotni tadqiq qilish, xalqaro hamkorlik va Marsni o'zlashtirish bo'yicha Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga kengaytirilgan javob berish; darsdagi iboralarni (stem from, be fraught with, cannot be overstated) nutqda ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi (imtihon oluvchi roli).
Sherigi Part 1 savoliga 2–3 gap, Part 3 savoliga 4–5 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol; Part 3 da ikki tomonni ham ko'rsatadi.
Javobda darsdagi iboralardan bittasini to'g'ri ishlatsa (stem from, be fraught with, it comes as no surprise that, cannot be overstated) +1 ball.
Tinglovchi ballarni sanaydi. Rollar almashadi; 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Are you interested in space? Why or why not?
Did you learn much about the planets and stars at school?
Have you ever used a telescope or a stargazing app?
Would you like to travel into space one day? Why?
Why do you think Ulugh Beg's observatory in Samarkand is still famous today?
Is space exploration a good use of public money, or should it be spent on problems on Earth?
What are the advantages of countries working together in space research?
Do you think humans will build a permanent settlement on Mars this century?
What qualities would an astronaut need to cope with months of isolation?
How has satellite technology changed everyday life, for example maps or weather forecasts?
Should private companies be allowed to lead space exploration? Why?
Some people say we must choose between protecting Earth and exploring space. Do you agree?
Why are films about aliens and space travel so popular?
Who should be responsible for cleaning up space debris?

16.title: Sentence Race: Y/N/NG rules and academic phrases
16.stage: 'Kahoot va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
16.goal: Y/N/NG va summary qoidalari hamda akademik iboralar (stem from, be fraught with, cannot be overstated, it comes as no surprise that) bilan gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — oxiri. Keyin qo'l ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert; jamoa gapdagi qoida yoki iborani izohlab bersa yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The writer's purpose is to explain, not to persuade.
If the writer says the opposite, the answer is NO.
Always check the evaluative word in a YES/NO/NOT GIVEN statement.
Complete the summary using the list of words, A–I, below.
Building a city on Mars is fraught with difficulties.
Our interest in space stems from a desire to explore.
It comes as no surprise that space tourism is so expensive.
The importance of international collaboration cannot be overstated.
Satellites help scientists monitor the melting of Arctic ice.
Astronauts must learn to cope with long periods of isolation.

16.title: Quiz Board: Passage 3 skills and space words
16.stage: Kahoot o'rniga yoki keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida: savol turlari va koinot so'zlarini takrorlash (15 daqiqa)
16.goal: Y/N/NG, MCQ 'writer's purpose' va summary + qutisi qoidalari, paraphrase, koinot so'zlari va akademik iboralarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash; qisqa og'zaki javob berish.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 ustun × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Space words 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30 soniya, to'liq gap bilan).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Do YES/NO/NOT GIVEN questions test facts or the writer's views?
A summary has 5 gaps and a box of options A–I. How many options are NOT used?
Summary with a word box: what do you write on the answer sheet?
Word box: 'Governments plan to ___ spending on space' — rise or increase?
Text: 'Funding was cut mainly for political reasons.' Statement: 'Nobody knows why funding was cut.' Y/N/NG?
qs.a: NO — the text gives the reason

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'a remote location'
qs.a: a place that is hard to reach / isolated

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'long-term isolation'
Paraphrase: 'make the planet warmer'
qs.a: heat the planet / raise its temperature

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'the project is fraught with problems'
Paraphrase: 'it comes as no surprise that'
qs.a: it is hardly surprising that / unsurprisingly,

qs.q: The layer of gases around a planet is its …
A planet where people could live is …
Life that comes from outside the Earth is …
One noun, 13 letters, starts with 'c': working together on a shared project.
A noun meaning 'cleverness in inventing new solutions' (9 letters).
Name two planets and say one fact about each.
qs.a: e.g. Mars is red; Jupiter is the largest planet.

qs.q: Use 'stem from' in a sentence about space.
qs.a: e.g. Our love of space stems from childhood curiosity.

qs.q: Give one advantage of international collaboration in space.
qs.a: e.g. Countries share the huge costs and their knowledge.

qs.q: Explain in 20 seconds how NOT GIVEN is different from NO.
qs.a: NO: the text says the opposite; NG: the text says nothing.

qs.q: Part 3: Explore space or solve problems on Earth first? Argue both sides.
qs.a: e.g. Space tech helps Earth (GPS), but poverty is urgent…

17.title: Grammar Auction: space science and lecture language
17.stage: Workbook Track 13 tekshiruvidan keyin: kosmos mavzusidagi kollokatsiya va so'z shakli xatolari (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
17.goal: Kosmos va astronomiya mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini (predlog, phrasal verb, affect/effect, 'the number of' kelishuvi, artikl) topish va tuzatish — note completion'da so'z shakliga e'tiborni kuchaytirish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar teleskoplar, havaskor astronomlar va kosmosda salomatlik haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'wear off — ta'sir o'tadi, wear out — eskiradi') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Galileo's telescope shifted scientists' attention from the Earth to the sky.
items.why: shift attention from A to B — to'g'ri birikma; 'the Earth' artikl bilan.

items.s: Let's have a look on how amateurs help professional astronomers.
items.fix: Let's have a look at how amateurs help professional astronomers.
items.why: Signpost ibora: have a look AT, 'on' emas.

items.s: Long space missions take a heavy toll on the human body.
items.why: take a (heavy) toll on — zarar yetkazmoq; birikma to'g'ri.

items.s: The symptoms of space sickness usually wear out after a few days.
items.fix: The symptoms of space sickness usually wear off after a few days.
items.why: wear off — ta'siri o'tib ketadi; wear out — eskirib yaroqsiz bo'ladi.

items.s: Amateur astronomers keep a constant eye to the night sky.
items.fix: Amateur astronomers keep a constant eye on the night sky.
items.why: keep an eye ON — doim kuzatib turmoq; predlog faqat 'on'.

items.s: Professional astronomers care more about research data than about beautiful images.
items.why: care more about A than about B — parallel tuzilma to'g'ri.

items.s: Scientists are still struggling to mitigate the affects of cosmic radiation.
items.fix: Scientists are still struggling to mitigate the effects of cosmic radiation.
items.why: affect — fe'l, effect — ot: 'the effects of'.

items.s: Weightlessness causes astronauts to lose bone mass surprisingly quickly.
items.why: cause + kishi + to + fe'l — to'g'ri tuzilma.

items.s: The number of amateur astronomers have grown rapidly in recent years.
items.fix: The number of amateur astronomers has grown rapidly in recent years.
items.why: 'The number of' — birlik ega: has grown ('A number of' bo'lsa — have).

items.s: An amateur may notice a change in a star's brightness before a professional does.
items.why: may + fe'l; 'does' oldingi fe'lni almashtiradi — to'g'ri.

items.s: Astronauts' muscles weaken because of the lack of the gravity.
items.fix: Astronauts' muscles weaken because of the lack of gravity.
items.why: gravity — sanalmaydigan umumiy ot, oldiga 'the' qo'yilmaydi: the lack of gravity.

items.s: The first telescopes kicked off a scientific revolution in the seventeenth century.
items.why: kick off — boshlab bermoq; asr tartib son bilan: seventeenth.

17.title: Board Game: Section 4 notes, signposts and space
17.stage: Jony Academy 'Space weather' tekshiruvidan keyin yoki keyingi darsda: Section 4 strategiyasini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
17.goal: Section 4 note completion strategiyasini (sarlavhalar, bo'shliqni bashorat qilish, signpost iboralar, rad etilgan variant tuzog'i, so'z chegarasi, imlo) og'zaki takrorlash, paraphrase qilish va kosmos mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase aytadi, so'zni harflab aytadi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; paraphrase va gapirish kataklarida ma'nosi to'g'ri boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.
'Gap' kataklarida so'z turi VA ma'no toifasi ikkalasi aytilishi kerak (masalan: 'sifat — tasvir qanday ekani'). Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Section 4: how many speakers, and is there a pause in the middle?
squares.a: One speaker (an academic lecture) and no pause — all 10 questions in one go.

squares.t: Name three things an amateur astronomer might photograph.
squares.a: e.g. a solar eclipse, the Moon, a comet, a galaxy, a planet

squares.t: What should you read first in the preparation time?
squares.a: The headings of the notes — they show the plan of the lecture.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'watch closely all the time'.
squares.a: e.g. keep a constant eye on / monitor / constantly observe

squares.t: Gap: 'an ___ in orbit'. What does 'an' tell you?
squares.a: The answer begins with a vowel sound, e.g. an asteroid / an object.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: have you ever looked at the night sky through a telescope?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, once at a science museum — the craters on the Moon looked amazing.

squares.t: Gap: 'produces highly ___ images'. Which word type?
squares.a: An adjective (after 'highly'), e.g. detailed / accurate.

squares.t: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Is 'very accurate measurements' OK?
squares.a: No — that is three words. Write 'accurate measurements'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'started' (as a lecturer might say it).
squares.a: e.g. kicked off / launched / set in motion

squares.t: Say two signpost phrases that start a new section of a lecture.
squares.a: e.g. 'Let's move on to…', 'Turning now to…', 'So let's look at…'

squares.t: What does 'wear off' mean? Use it in a sentence.
squares.a: To fade gradually, e.g. The dizziness wore off after two days.

squares.t: Gap: 'bones become ___ after months in orbit'. Predict it.
squares.a: An adjective for a negative change, e.g. weaker / more fragile.

squares.t: You missed a gap and the lecturer has moved on. What do you do?
squares.a: Keep going, follow the next heading, and write a sensible guess at the end.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a lack of gravity'.
squares.a: e.g. weightlessness / zero gravity / microgravity

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: is space exploration worth the money?
squares.a: e.g. Partly — it drives new technology, but health and education should come first.

squares.t: Lecturer: 'You might expect X, but in fact it's Y.' Which one is the answer?
squares.a: Y — the idea the speaker confirms, not the one that is rejected.

squares.t: Notes: 'e.g. ___ (Mars)'. You hear two examples. How do you choose?
squares.a: Take the one linked to Mars — the word in brackets is the clue.

squares.t: Spell it: 'observatory'.
squares.a: O-B-S-E-R-V-A-T-O-R-Y

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'reduce the harm caused by radiation'.
squares.a: e.g. mitigate the effects of radiation / limit the damage

squares.t: Notes: '___ of time in space'. You hear 'long stretches of time'. Answer?
squares.a: long stretches — 'of time' is already in the notes.

squares.t: Explain 'take a toll on' and give a space example.
squares.a: To damage gradually, e.g. Long missions take a toll on astronauts' eyesight.

squares.t: Transfer: which three things are checked besides the meaning?
squares.a: Spelling, singular/plural (-s) and the word limit.

17.title: Dominoes: notes wording ↔ lecturer's paraphrase
17.stage: 'Skript bilan qayta tinglash' bosqichida: uchala ma'ruzadagi paraphrase'larni mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa)
17.goal: Konspektdagi so'zni ma'ruzachi aytadigan paraphrase bilan ulash (lack of gravity = weightlessness, symptoms disappear = the discomfort wears off) — Section 4 da javob joyini eshitib qolish ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida konspektdagi ibora yozilgan; ma'ruzachi xuddi shu fikrni qanday aytishi mumkin — shu paraphrase qaysi toshning chap tomonida, toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Har bir iboraning faqat bitta to'g'ri paraphrase'i bor.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'In the notes: bone loss — the lecturer says: a drop in skeletal density'. Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; bonus: 2 ta paraphrase'ni o'z gapida ishlatsa +1.

transformed how we see the cosmos
keep a constant eye on the heavens
people who study the stars as a hobby

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.

Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas; 'It happens when…', 'It's a place where…' kabi ma'ruzachi uslubidagi ta'riflarni ishlating.

Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 ta qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollar grammatikasini tekshiradi.

18.title: Grammar Auction: Band 7 accuracy in Task 1
18.stage: 'Coherence: bog'lovchilar' bosqichidan keyin (3–4-mashqlardan so'ng): aniqlik va bog'lovchi xatolari (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Task 1 gaplarida Band 6 belgilarini (kichik o'zgarishga 'plummet', gap boshidagi 'Also,' va 'First,', 'On contrary', ortiqcha 'it', shaxsiy baho) topib tuzatish; overview, which-clause, whereas va substitution namunalarini ko'rish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (hammasi to'qilgan grafiklar haqidagi Task 1 gaplari). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap Band 7 javobiga yaroqlimi yoki unda xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va xato turini aytgan jamoa (aniqlik / shaxsiy baho / bog'lovchi / grammatika) +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Overall, online sales rose considerably, while high-street sales declined steadily.
items.why: Overview: raqamsiz asosiy tendensiya; 'while' ikki tendensiyani solishtiradi.

items.s: Cinema attendance plummeted from 52% to 50% over the decade.
items.fix: Cinema attendance fell slightly from 52% to 50% over the decade.
items.why: Plummet — juda keskin tushish; 52% dan 50% ga (2 foiz punkt) tushish uchun noto'g'ri tafsilot.

items.s: The figure for bus journeys stood at 40 million in 2010.
items.why: stand at + raqam — bir nuqtadagi miqdor uchun aniq va neytral ibora.

items.s: On contrary, car use grew throughout the period.
items.fix: By contrast, car use grew throughout the period.
items.why: 'On contrary' — noto'g'ri ibora; farqni ko'rsatish uchun 'By contrast'.

items.s: Rail travel, which was the least popular option in 2000, doubled over the next two decades.
items.why: which-clause ikki vergul bilan: ikki faktni bitta gapda bog'laydi.

items.s: Also, cycling became more popular after 2015.
items.fix: Cycling also became more popular after 2015.
items.why: Gap boshidagi 'Also,' — so'zlashuv uslubi; 'also' fe'l oldiga olinadi.

items.s: Smartphone ownership rose steadily, whereas landline ownership fell by half.
items.why: whereas — bitta gap ichida ikki qarama-qarshi tendensiyani bog'laydi.

items.s: Landline ownership, despite its early lead, it dropped to 30%.
items.fix: Landline ownership, despite its early lead, dropped to 30%.
items.why: Ega ikki marta: 'Landline ownership' bor, 'it' ortiqcha.

items.s: Similarly, gas consumption followed a slight upward trend.
items.why: Similarly — oldingi tendensiyaga o'xshash o'zgarishni bog'laydi.

items.s: Coal use declined steadily, which is good for the environment.
items.fix: Coal use declined steadily.
items.why: Shaxsiy baho grafikda yo'q — irrelevant detail (Band 6 belgisi); o'chiriladi.

items.s: Both figures reached a peak in 2010 before falling back slightly.
items.why: Substitution: 'both figures' ikki kategoriyani takrorlamasdan bog'laydi.

items.s: First, the proportion of renters stood at 30% in 1990.
items.fix: The proportion of renters stood at 30% in 1990.
items.why: First — jarayon bosqichi uchun; grafikda 'birinchi qadam' yo'q.

18.title: Board Game: Task 1 Band 7 — accuracy and linking
18.stage: 'Progression: guruhlash' bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi Task 1 darsida: TA va CC qoidalarini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
18.goal: Task Achievement (overview, asosiy xususiyatni tanlash, aniq so'z, shaxsiy xulosasiz) va Coherence & Cohesion (guruhlash, whereas / by contrast / similarly, which-clause, substitution) qoidalarini og'zaki takrorlash va gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, gapni tuzatadi, ikki gapni bog'laydi yoki overview aytadi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; 'e.g.' bilan berilgan kataklarda ma'nosi va grammatikasi to'g'ri boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.
'Correct' kataklarida xato turi ham aytiladi (aniqlik, shaxsiy xulosa, bog'lovchi yoki grammatika). Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Task 1: is it marked on Task Response or Task Achievement?
squares.a: Task Achievement.

squares.t: Name the three things the Task 1 instructions ask you to do.
squares.a: Summarise, select the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

squares.t: Should an overview contain numbers?
squares.a: No — it gives the main trends or differences without figures.

squares.t: Correct: 'Sales plummeted from 60 to 58 units.'
squares.a: Sales fell slightly from 60 to 58 units. (precision)

squares.t: Task 1 or not? 'This is probably because people are busier now.'
squares.a: Not Task 1 — a reason or guess is not shown on the graph.

squares.t: Correct: 'On contrary, exports rose.'
squares.a: By contrast, exports rose. (wrong phrase)

squares.t: Say a neutral phrase for one figure at one point in time.
squares.a: e.g. stood at — Exports stood at $5 million in 2000.

squares.t: Where can the overview go in a Task 1 answer?
squares.a: After the introduction or at the end — but only once.

squares.t: The graph shows 'teenagers'. Can you write 'young people'?
squares.a: No — it changes the group, so the detail becomes inaccurate.

squares.t: Join with 'whereas': Imports rose. Exports fell.
squares.a: Imports rose, whereas exports fell.

squares.t: Correct: 'Also, coffee prices increased.'
squares.a: Coffee prices also increased. (too informal)

squares.t: Which suits a process diagram rather than a line graph: 'First' or 'Initially'?
squares.a: 'First' — for process stages; 'Initially' describes the start of a trend.

squares.t: Join with 'which': Bus use peaked in 2012. Bus use ended at 35 million.
squares.a: Bus use, which peaked in 2012, ended at 35 million.

squares.t: What is wrong with one paragraph per category, all in the same pattern?
squares.a: It becomes a list — little comparison and no logical grouping.

squares.t: Give a precise phrase for a rise from 20 to 80.
squares.a: e.g. quadrupled / rose fourfold / reached four times its initial level

squares.t: Correct: 'Prices oscillated to a high of 9 dollars.'
squares.a: Prices rose to a high of 9 dollars. (precision)

squares.t: Use substitution: 'Tea and coffee fell. Tea and coffee ended at 50.'
squares.a: Tea and coffee fell, and both ended at 50.

squares.t: Four lines on a graph: give two ways to group them into paragraphs.
squares.a: e.g. rising vs falling lines; the two biggest vs the two smallest.

squares.t: Correct: 'Rice exports, despite a strong start, they fell to 3%.'
squares.a: Rice exports, despite a strong start, fell to 3%. (double subject)

squares.t: What is the difference between 'however' and 'although'?
squares.a: However links two sentences; although joins two clauses in one sentence.

squares.t: Say an overview: cars up, bikes up, buses down sharply.
squares.a: e.g. Overall, car and bike use rose, whereas bus travel fell sharply.

squares.t: Why is 'Furthermore' wrong before a minor detail?
squares.a: It signals a more important addition, so it misleads the reader.

squares.t: What should the first sentence of each body paragraph do?
squares.a: Show the main idea of the group, e.g. 'The sharpest growth was in…'

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: why do many candidates get Band 6 in Task 1?
squares.a: e.g. No clear overview, irrelevant or inaccurate details, mechanical linkers.

18.title: Dominoes: precise trend words ↔ what the data shows
18.stage: 'Aniqlik: flexibility va precision' bosqichida, 1-mashqdan keyin: aniq tendensiya so'zlari (12 daqiqa)
18.goal: Tendensiya so'zini (doubled, halved, fell slightly, plummeted, fluctuated, overtook) raqamlardagi aniq o'zgarish bilan ulash; whereas, similarly va overview vazifasini bilish — 'ko'z-ko'z qiluvchi' so'z o'rniga aniq so'z tanlash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z grafikda qanday o'zgarishni bildiradi — shu tavsif qaysi toshning chap tomonida, toping va ulang.
Raqamlarga diqqat qiling: o'zgarishning yo'nalishi, kattaligi va tezligi so'zga aynan mos bo'lishi kerak. Har so'zning faqat bitta to'g'ri jufti bor.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('Tripled means it climbed from 15 to 45'); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; bonus: 2 ta so'z bilan grafik haqida to'g'ri gap tuzsa +1.

pairs: fell gradually from 80 to 40 over a decade
crashed from 90 to 10 in a single year
reached its highest point, then declined
reached its lowest point, then recovered

joins two contrasting clauses in one sentence

the main trends in 1–2 sentences, with no figures

18.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' savolidan keyin: Task 1 atamalari va tendensiya so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Task 1 atamalari va aniq tendensiya / bog'lovchi so'zlarini (overview, key feature, overtake, fluctuate, whereas, initially) inglizcha ta'riflab berish — har so'zning aniq ma'nosini his qilish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.

Imo-ishora (masalan, qo'l bilan grafik chizish) mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas; 'You use it when…', 'It's the opposite of…' kabi iboralarni ishlating.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

18.title: Find someone who… writes the overview first
18.stage: 'Shaxsiy xulosa' bosqichidan keyin, 'Coherence' oldidan harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
18.goal: Yozish odatlari, grafiklar va ichimliklar haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Do you…? Have you ever…? Would you rather…?) va natijani Task 1 uslubida solishtirib aytish (most of the class…, whereas…).

O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you usually write the overview before the body paragraphs?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (How often? How long did it take?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.

Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi. Keyin 2–3 o'quvchi natijani Task 1 uslubida aytadi: 'Most people plan their paragraphs, whereas only two write the overview first.' Ustoz savollar grammatikasini tekshiradi.

18.goal: Statistika, grafiklar, iste'mol odatlari va yozish mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga javob berish; darsdagi tendensiya so'zlarini (rose steadily, declined, overtook, whereas) og'zaki ishlatish.
