Part 1 kartasiga 2–3 gap bilan, 'Part 3' deb boshlangan kartaga fikr + sabab + misol bilan kamida 4 gap bilan javob beriladi.
Examiner javobdagi dars so'zlarini (trend, decline, overtake, whereas, by contrast, considerably) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Eslatma: Speakingda sabab va shaxsiy fikr aytish mumkin — Task 1 dan farqi aynan shu. Rollar almashadi; 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you prefer getting information from charts or from written text? Why?
What do you usually drink during the day? Has that changed in recent years?
Did you study graphs and statistics at school? Did you find them useful?
Do you enjoy writing? What kind of writing do you do most often?
How do you check your writing for mistakes before you hand it in?
Is tea or coffee more popular among your friends? Why do you think that is?
Part 3: Why do newspapers and websites use charts and graphs so often?
Part 3: Can statistics be misleading? Give an example.
Part 3: Why might bottled water have become more popular in many countries?
Part 3: How have people's eating and drinking habits in Uzbekistan changed recently?
Part 3: Is it more important to be accurate or to use impressive vocabulary? Why?
Part 3: Why do some people find it hard to summarise information briefly?
Part 3: Which jobs require people to describe data clearly?
Part 3: Should schools teach students how to read graphs critically?

18.title: Sentence Race: overview and linked Task 1 sentences
18.stage: 'Kahoot va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
18.goal: Overview, which-clause, by contrast, substitution va aniq tendensiya iboralari bilan Band 7 uslubidagi Task 1 gaplarini to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Maslahat: katta harfli so'z gap boshida, nuqtali so'z oxirida; vergulli so'z bo'lak oxirida turadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gapdagi cohesive device yoki aniq iborani ko'rsatsa (masalan: 'By contrast', which-clause, 'both') +1 bonus.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Overall, printed books became far less popular over the period.
Online shopping rose from last place to first.
Cycling, which had been the least common option, ended the period in second place.
By contrast, meat consumption fell to its lowest level in 2019.
Rice prices showed relatively little change over the decade.
Both figures stood at 45 tonnes in 2018.
Exports reached a peak of 60 tonnes in 2012.
Radio, despite its early lead, was overtaken by television.
Bike sales finished at 160 units, four times their initial level.
Each body paragraph should begin with its main idea.

18.title: Quiz Board: Task 1 — achievement and coherence
18.stage: Keyingi Task 1 darsining 'Kirish' qismida yoki takror darsida: TA, CC va aniq tilni takrorlash (15 daqiqa)
18.goal: Task 1 tuzilishi (overview, guruhlash, xulosasiz), aniq tendensiya tili, bog'lovchi va grammatika xatolarini tuzatish hamda og'zaki topshiriqlarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fix the error 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin. 'Fix the error' bo'limida xato turi ham aytilsa +50 bonus.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Task 1 is marked on Task ___, not Task Response. Complete it.
Does Task 1 need a conclusion with your opinion?
qs.a: No — an overview is enough; no opinion

qs.q: Name the two places where the overview can go.
qs.a: After the introduction or at the end

qs.q: Four lines: two rise and two fall. What is the best paragraph plan?
qs.a: Body 1: the rising lines; Body 2: the falling lines

qs.q: Band 6 and Band 7 both have an overview. What makes Band 7 different?
qs.a: A clear overview, key features highlighted, no irrelevant details

qs.q: Complete: 'Tea fell, ___ water rose.' (one word, contrast)
One verb: it moved from second place to first.
One adverb meaning 'at the beginning, before a change'.
One verb meaning 'went up and down several times'.
A phrase for a rise from 45 to 180, compared with the start.
qs.a: four times its initial level / it quadrupled

qs.q: Also, exports increased.
On contrary, prices fell.
qs.a: By contrast / In contrast, prices fell.

qs.q: Sales plummeted from 50 to 49 units.
qs.a: Sales fell slightly from 50 to 49 units.

qs.q: Rice, despite its early lead, it fell to 20%.
qs.a: Rice, despite its early lead, fell to 20%.

qs.q: Sugar use, which peaked in 2010 ended at 40 kg.
qs.a: Sugar use, which peaked in 2010, ended at 40 kg.

qs.q: Say a neutral phrase for one figure at one point in time.
Task 1 or not? 'This shows that people care more about health.'
qs.a: Not Task 1 — it is a guess, not a fact on the graph

qs.q: Say an overview: A and B rose, C fell sharply.
qs.a: e.g. Overall, A and B rose, whereas C fell sharply.

qs.q: Use substitution: 'X and Y peaked in 2010. X and Y then fell.'
qs.a: X and Y peaked in 2010, and both then fell.

qs.q: In 30 seconds: why is 'young people' wrong if the graph shows teenagers?
qs.a: It changes the group, so the detail becomes inaccurate

19.title: Grammar Auction: Task 1 introduction sentences
19.stage: 'Kirish gap: what / where / when va show' bosqichidan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Kirish gapdagi tipik xatolarni topish va tuzatish: noto'g'ri 'show' sinonimi (display), tushib qolgan 'who', between … and, 'changes in', prior to va kirish gapga izoh qo'shish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bu kirish gap Band 7 javobga yaroqlimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gap uchun: birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan VA sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan, 'display — vitrinaga qo'yish') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The tables compare the number of cinema tickets sold in four Asian cities in 2012 and 2022.
items.why: Ikki jadval — 'compare'; sales → tickets sold (noun → verb).

items.s: The bar chart displays the proportion of adults who cycle to work in three cities.
items.fix: The bar chart shows the proportion of adults who cycle to work in three cities.
items.why: display — vitrinaga qo'yish; grafik uchun 'shows' yoki 'compares'.

items.s: The line graph shows the number of people used the metro in Tashkent from 2000 to 2020.
items.fix: The line graph shows the number of people who used the metro in Tashkent from 2000 to 2020.
items.why: Ega vazifasidagi 'who' tushib qolmaydi: people WHO used the metro.

items.s: The maps show a coastal village prior to and following the construction of a new harbour.
items.why: Map kirish gapi: 'maps' saqlangan; prior to / following + ot.

items.s: The bar chart shows the amount of tea drunk per person in five countries in 2021.
items.why: Qisqartirilgan relative clause: tea (that was) drunk.

items.s: The graph shows wheat production in four regions of Uzbekistan between 1995 to 2025.
items.fix: The graph shows wheat production in four regions of Uzbekistan between 1995 and 2025.
items.why: between … and yoki from … to — ikkalasi aralashtirilmaydi.

items.s: The line graph illustrates how the number of visitors to three museums changed between 2000 and 2020.
items.why: 'illustrates how … changed' — vaqt bo'yicha o'zgarish uchun to'g'ri fe'l.

items.s: The maps show a fishing village before and after its development, which was clearly a positive change.
items.fix: The maps show a fishing village before and after its development.
items.why: Kirish gapga izoh yoki baho qo'shilmaydi — faqat what / where / when.

items.s: The bar chart shows changes in the proportion of students who walked to school in 2022.
items.fix: The bar chart shows the proportion of students who walked to school in 2022.
items.why: Bitta yil — o'zgarish yo'q; 'changes in' faqat vaqt bo'yicha o'zgarishda.

items.s: The pie charts compare household spending in two countries, namely Japan and Brazil, in 2020.
items.why: namely — davlatlarni aniq nomlaydi; ikki pie chart — 'compare'.

items.s: The plans show a town centre prior and following its redevelopment.
items.fix: The plans show a town centre prior to and following its redevelopment.
items.why: 'prior' dan keyin 'to' shart: prior to (= before).

items.s: The table compares the number of tourists visiting two national parks in 2015 and 2025.
items.why: Qisqartirilgan shakl: tourists visiting = tourists who visited.

19.title: Board Game: three steps and the introduction
19.stage: 'Namuna javob tahlili' dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Yozishdan oldingi 3 qadam (details → key features → grouping), belgilar tizimi, kirish gapni paraphrase qilish (noun → verb, relative clause, namely, predloglar, map fe'llari) va mavzu bo'yicha gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, iborani paraphrase qiladi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdan bittasi 'hakam' — javoblar varag'ini ushlab tekshiradi. Paraphrase topshiriqlarida ma'nosi bir xil boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa yoki o'yinchi 10 soniyada boshlamasa — oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: What are the three steps before you write Task 1?
squares.a: 1) notice details 2) find key features 3) group the information

squares.t: How long should these three steps take in the exam?
squares.a: No more than five minutes (ideally less).

squares.t: Which three questions does an introduction answer?
squares.a: What, where and when (sometimes who).

squares.t: Correct: The table displays the number of students.
squares.a: The table shows the number of students.

squares.t: Paraphrase with a verb: 'sales of theatre tickets'
squares.a: the number of theatre tickets sold

squares.t: Fill in: Sales rose ___ 2010 ___ 2015.
squares.a: from … to / between … and

squares.t: Give a correct verb for a line graph that shows change.
squares.a: illustrates how … changed (e.g. illustrates how sales changed)

squares.t: Correct: the number of people used buses
squares.a: the number of people who used buses

squares.t: What does '!' next to a figure mean on your question paper?
squares.a: It is an unusual figure worth mentioning.

squares.t: What does '(1)' next to a figure in a column mean?
squares.a: It is the highest figure in that column.

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: a chart or graph you saw recently.
squares.a: e.g. My fitness app showed how many steps I walked each day last week.

squares.t: Make it shorter: tourists who visit Khiva
squares.a: tourists visiting Khiva

squares.t: Make it shorter: the energy that was produced by wind
squares.a: the energy produced by wind

squares.t: Two tables (theatre / festival tickets): how do you group the body?
squares.a: One paragraph per table: P3 — theatre, P4 — festivals.

squares.t: Two maps (before / after): how do you group the body?
squares.a: P3 — the place before; P4 — what changed after.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'in 2015 and 2025'
squares.a: e.g. in two separate years, 2015 and 2025

squares.t: Add 'namely': in three cities in Uzbekistan
squares.a: e.g. in three Uzbek cities, namely Tashkent, Bukhara and Khiva

squares.t: Say it formally: 'before and after they built a stadium'
squares.a: prior to and following the construction of a stadium

squares.t: What is the difference between 'redevelop' and 'refurbish'?
squares.a: redevelop — replace old buildings with new ones; refurbish — repair and update

squares.t: A table gives ticket sales in thousands. Can you write 'the agency earned …'?
squares.a: No — it shows the number of tickets sold, not the money earned.

squares.t: A graph shows the seconds needed to finish a task. Is a lower figure better or worse?
squares.a: Better — fewer seconds means a faster result.

squares.t: What must an introduction NOT contain?
squares.a: An overview of the main trends, comments or opinions, or specific figures.

squares.t: Paraphrase: The chart shows the percentage of adults who cycle in three cities.
squares.a: e.g. The bar chart compares the proportion of adults who ride a bike in three cities.

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: how has your town changed in the last ten years?
squares.a: e.g. Several blocks of flats were constructed and the old market was redeveloped.

19.title: Dominoes: question words ↔ introduction paraphrase
19.stage: 'Kirish gap' bosqichidan keyin, relative clause mashqidan oldin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Savol gapidagi iborani kirish gapdagi paraphrase bilan moslash: noun → verb, active ↔ passive, tuzilmani o'zgartirish, vaqt va joy iboralari, prior to / following.
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora savol gapidan olingan — shu ma'noni kirish gap uslubida beradigan paraphrase'ni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Har ulanishda guruh qaysi usul ishlatilganini aytadi: noun → verb, passive, relative clause, tartib almashtirish yoki formal so'z (prior to).
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: the number of theatre tickets sold
the amount of tea that people drank
following the construction of the bridge
the percentage of children who can swim
the proportion of children able to swim
how the number of visitors changed
the number of people who own a car

19.title: Taboo: introduction and map language
19.stage: 'Kahoot va vazifa' dan oldin lug'at takrori yoki keyingi dars boshida (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Kirish gap va map / plan so'zlarini (namely, prior to, following, construct, refurbish, redevelop, the proportion of, units, modest) inglizcha ta'rif va misol bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordam: Task 1 dan misol gap aytish mumkin, so'z o'rniga 'blank' deyiladi (masalan: 'Two hotels were blank near the beach').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

19.title: Find someone who… has seen a building refurbished
19.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' savolidan keyin harakatli isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Hayotiy tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Present Perfect / Present Simple) va dars so'zlarini ishlatish: chart, units, refurbish, redevelop, plan, paraphrase.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever seen an old building in your town being refurbished?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Where? What did it show?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has made a chart or graph for a school or work project.
items.q: Have you ever made a chart or graph for a school or work project?

items.t: …always plans an essay before writing it.
items.q: Do you always plan an essay before you write it?

items.t: …has seen an old building in his/her town being refurbished.
items.q: Have you ever seen an old building in your town being refurbished?

items.t: …can name three types of graph in English.
items.q: Can you name three types of graph in English?

items.t: …has watched a new building being constructed near his/her home.
items.q: Have you ever watched a new building being constructed near your home?

items.t: …checks the units on a chart before reading the numbers.
items.q: Do you check the units on a chart before reading the numbers?

items.t: …has bought a ticket for a concert or festival online.
items.q: Have you ever bought a ticket for a concert or festival online?

items.t: …uses a fitness or budget app that shows statistics.
items.q: Do you use a fitness or budget app that shows statistics?

items.t: …has visited a city that has changed a lot in the last ten years.
items.q: Have you ever visited a city that has changed a lot in the last ten years?

items.t: …finds paraphrasing harder than writing new sentences.
items.q: Do you find paraphrasing harder than writing new sentences?

items.t: …has done a Writing Task 1 practice test with a timer.
items.q: Have you ever done a Writing Task 1 practice test with a timer?

items.t: …knows the difference between 'redevelop' and 'refurbish'.
items.q: Do you know the difference between 'redevelop' and 'refurbish'?

19.title: Speaking cards: data, tickets and changing towns
19.stage: Keyingi dars boshida yoki Speaking darsida, IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va 3 savollariga 3–4 gapli javob: statistika va grafiklar, chipta sotib olish, shaharlardagi qurilish va o'zgarishlar; darsdagi so'zlarni ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 30–40 soniya javob beradi (Part 3 savollarida — sabab va misol bilan) va darsdagi kamida 1 ta so'zni ishlatadi (construct, redevelop, refurbish, proportion, namely…).
Tinglovchi ishlatilgan dars so'zlarini sanaydi: har biri +1 ball; javobni savolni so'zma-so'z takrorlamay, paraphrase bilan boshlasa yana +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy working with numbers and statistics? Why or why not?
When did you last look at a chart or graph? What did it show?
Do you usually plan before you write something important? How?
How has your town or neighbourhood changed in the last ten years?
Which building in your city would you like to see refurbished, and why?
Is it better to redevelop old areas of a city or to keep them as they are?
How often do you go to the theatre or to concerts?
Why do you think music festivals have become so popular with young people?
Do you prefer buying tickets online or at the box office? Why?
Why do newspapers and websites often use charts instead of long texts?
Can statistics sometimes be misleading? Give an example.
How can a large construction project affect the people who live nearby?
What new facilities for tourists does your region need most?
Some people say numbers are more reliable than opinions. Do you agree?

19.title: Sentence Race: introduction sentences
19.stage: Relative clause / namely bosqichidan keyin, map kirish gapidan oldin (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Kirish gap va map gaplarida so'z tartibini tuzish: illustrates how, compare, the number of … sold, relative clause (who / that, qisqartirilgan shakl), namely, passive (were constructed).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gapda qaysi usul borligini aytsa (relative clause, qisqartirilgan shakl, namely, passive yoki 3 qadamdan biri).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The line graph illustrates how rice production changed over thirty years.
The tables compare the number of cinema tickets sold in four cities.
The bar chart shows the proportion of households that owned a car.
The chart shows the number of people who cycled to work in 2020.
The table compares the amount of tea drunk in five countries.
The plans show how Chorsu Bazaar will be redeveloped.
Only one city, namely Termez, saw ticket sales dip slightly.
Three bridges were constructed across the river.
Always check what the graph measures before you start writing.
Do not add comments to the introductory sentence.

19.title: Quiz Board: plan first, then introduce
19.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Kahoot va vazifa' o'rniga yoki undan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: 3 qadamli tahlil, kirish gap paraphrase'i, 'show' fe'llari, relative clause, predloglar va map / plan tilini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 40 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin. Paraphrase savollarida ma'nosi to'g'ri boshqa variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many steps come before you start writing Task 1?
Which step stops you from describing every single number?
On your question paper, what does '↑↑↑' mean?
Two maps: a village in 2000 and today. What is the most logical grouping?
qs.a: P3 — the village in 2000; P4 — the changes since then.

qs.q: Misreading the whole question can lower Task Achievement to which band?
Paraphrase with a verb: 'sales of cars'.
Paraphrase: 'tourist facilities'.
Paraphrase 'from 2000 to 2020' using the word 'period'.
Make it passive: 'the construction of a stadium'.
In a map introduction, replace 'before and after' with more formal words.
The table displays the number of students.
qs.a: The table shows the number of students.

qs.q: The given chart shows the amount of rice eaten.
qs.a: The chart shows the amount of rice eaten.

qs.q: The chart shows the number of people used the library.
qs.a: …the number of people who used the library.

qs.q: Sales rose between 2010 to 2015.
The maps show a town, which became much nicer after it was developed.
qs.a: The maps show a town prior to and following its development.

qs.q: Say the three questions every introduction answers.
Say a sentence with 'namely' about cities in Uzbekistan.
qs.a: e.g. …in three cities, namely Tashkent, Bukhara and Khiva.

qs.q: Say an introduction for a pie chart about how students spend their day.
qs.a: e.g. The pie chart shows how students use their time on a typical day.

qs.q: Explain the difference between 'redevelop' and 'refurbish'.
qs.a: redevelop = replace with new buildings; refurbish = repair and update

qs.q: Say a full introduction: two maps of central Tashkent, in 2000 and today.
qs.a: e.g. The maps show central Tashkent in 2000 and at present.

20.title: Grammar Auction: overview and highlight language
20.stage: 'Aniq va noaniq overview' bosqichidan keyin, 3-mashq bilan birga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Overview va highlight gaplaridagi tipik xatolarni topish: determiner (most of these), trend kollokatsiyasi (see / witness a trend), considerably, by far + superlative, 'gains' ning noto'g'ri ishlatilishi, shaxsiy baho (worrying).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap Band 7 overview / body gapi sifatida to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gap uchun: birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan VA xato turini aytgan jamoa (determiner / kollokatsiya / so'z shakli / shaxsiy baho) +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Only one of these cities experienced the opposite trend.
items.why: only one of + these + ko'plik ot; experience the opposite trend.

items.s: Overall, most of countries witnessed a rising trend in car ownership.
items.fix: Overall, most of these countries witnessed a rising trend in car ownership.
items.why: most of + these / the + ko'plik ot (yoki shunchaki 'most countries').

items.s: Overall, sales of e-books rose in all four countries, whereas printed book sales fell.
items.why: Ikki tendensiya + whereas, raqamsiz — aniq overview.

items.s: Overall, all five cities did a rising trend in bicycle use.
items.fix: Overall, all five cities saw a rising trend in bicycle use.
items.why: Kollokatsiya: see / experience / witness a trend — 'do' emas.

items.s: Sales in Samarkand were considerable higher than in Bukhara.
items.fix: Sales in Samarkand were considerably higher than in Bukhara.
items.why: Qiyosiy sifat oldida ravish kerak: considerably higher.

items.s: Tashkent dominated the market by a wide margin in both years.
items.why: dominate + by a wide margin — yetakchini ajratib ko'rsatish.

items.s: Overall, car use rose in every city, while bus use experienced a worrying decline.
items.fix: Overall, car use rose in every city, while bus use experienced a decline.
items.why: Overview'da shaxsiy baho (worrying) bo'lmaydi — faqat ma'lumot.

items.s: Tea and coffee sales reached 40 million and 25 million respectively.
items.why: respectively — tartib bo'yicha: tea → 40 million, coffee → 25 million.

items.s: Khiva saw by far the largest increase, with visitor numbers quadrupling to 8,000.
items.why: by far + the + superlative, keyin raqam — highlight + dalil.

items.s: Overall, energy consumption in all three regions saw marginal gains.
items.fix: Overall, energy consumption in all three regions saw marginal increases.
items.why: 'gains' faqat haqiqiy yutuq uchun (sotuv, foyda) — energiya sarfi uchun emas.

items.s: Neither of the two smallest markets changed significantly.
items.why: neither of + the + ko'plik ot; overview uchun qulay determiner.

items.s: Scooter sales in Paris were by far higher than in any other city.
items.fix: Scooter sales in Paris were far higher than in any other city.
items.why: 'by far' superlative bilan (by far the highest); comparative bilan — far / much.

20.title: Board Game: overview, umbrella terms and highlights
20.stage: Namuna tahlilidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Overview'ni tanish va raqamsiz umumlashtirish (determiner + umbrella term), trend kollokatsiyalari, qarama-qarshilik (while / whereas), noaniq overview sabablari va key feature'ni highlight qilish; mavzu bo'yicha gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, gapni tuzatadi, overview yoki highlight gap aytadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdan bittasi 'hakam' — javoblar varag'ini ushlab tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblarda boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa yoki o'yinchi 10 soniyada boshlamasa — oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Which word signals the start of an overview?
squares.a: Overall,

squares.t: Can an overview contain figures? Why?
squares.a: No — it is a general summary, with no numbers or details.

squares.t: Umbrella term: apples, grapes, melons
squares.a: fruit / types of fruit

squares.t: Say the opposite of 'a rising trend'.
squares.a: a falling / downward trend

squares.t: Complete with three verbs: 'Most cities ___ a rising trend.'
squares.a: saw / experienced / witnessed

squares.t: What does 'mixed results' mean?
squares.a: Some figures went up and others went down.

squares.t: Umbrella term: trains, planes, ships
squares.a: means of transport / modes of transport

squares.t: Make it general: 'Prices fell in Termez, Nukus and Urgench.'
squares.a: Prices fell in all three cities.

squares.t: Name three linkers that show contrast in an overview.
squares.a: while, whereas, although (also however, despite)

squares.t: Correct: 'Overall, most of cities grew.'
squares.a: Overall, most of the cities grew. / Overall, most cities grew.

squares.t: Speak for 20 seconds: a trend among young people in Uzbekistan.
squares.a: e.g. More and more students are learning English online.

squares.t: Is 'Overall, Tashkent had the highest sales.' a clear overview? Why?
squares.a: No — it gives only one feature, not the main trends.

squares.t: No overview at all: can you get Band 6 for Task Achievement?
squares.a: No — Band 6 needs an overview; without one, Band 5 at most.

squares.t: Explain 'respectively' with an example.
squares.a: e.g. Tea and coffee sales were 40 and 25 million respectively (in that order).

squares.t: Correct: 'Overall, it is worrying that car use fell.'
squares.a: Overall, car use fell. (no personal opinion)

squares.t: Why can 'the former' be a problem in an overview?
squares.a: The reader may not know what it refers to (unclear reference).

squares.t: Say a sentence with 'by far the …' about your city.
squares.a: e.g. Chorsu is by far the busiest market in Tashkent.

squares.t: Can you write 'energy use saw marginal gains'? Why?
squares.a: No — 'gains' is for real gains (sales, profit): 'energy use rose marginally'.

squares.t: Name the four causes of an unclear overview.
squares.a: only one trend, wrong language, too much detail, unclear reference

squares.t: How should a body paragraph begin?
squares.a: With its topic, e.g. 'Sales of e-bikes …' — one group per paragraph.

squares.t: Highlight it: 'Tashkent had 5,000 in 2010 and 20,000 in 2020.'
squares.a: e.g. Tashkent saw by far the biggest rise, with its figure quadrupling to 20,000.

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: what has become more popular in your family recently?
squares.a: e.g. Online shopping has become far more popular in my family; we order most things online.

squares.t: Say an overview: tea sales rose in three countries and fell in one.
squares.a: e.g. Overall, tea sales rose in most of these countries, while only one saw a fall.

squares.t: Say an overview with 'while': car use vs. cycling in a city.
squares.a: e.g. Overall, car use rose steadily, while cycling experienced the opposite trend.

20.title: Dominoes: details ↔ umbrella terms and determiners
20.stage: 'Tafsilotsiz umumlashtirish' bosqichida, 1–2-mashqdan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Tafsilotni overview uchun umumiy ifodaga aylantirish: ro'yxat → umbrella term (dairy products, renewable energy sources) va nomlar bilan gap → determiner (all four, only one of, neither, both, most of).
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. O'ng tomondagi tafsilot (ro'yxat yoki nomlar bilan gap) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi umumiy ifodaga mos kelsa — shuni ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring; har ulanishda guruh umumiy ifodani ovoz chiqarib aytadi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.
Bonus: g'olib guruh ikki umumiy ifoda va while / whereas bilan bitta overview gap tuzsa +1 ball.

pairs: Sales rose in Oslo, Bern, Rome and Lima.
Sales rose in all four cities.
Sales fell in Oslo but rose in the other three.
Only one of the four cities saw a fall.
Neither Tokyo nor Seoul changed at all.
Tea and coffee sales both went up.
Sales of both drinks saw a rising trend.
Bus use rose in two towns and fell in two.
Six of the seven schools grew.

20.title: Taboo: overview and trend language
20.stage: Keyingi dars boshida lug'at takrori yoki 'Sinfda yozish' dan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Overview va trend so'zlarini (overview, key feature, witness, umbrella term, mixed results, respectively, marginal, dominate, substantial, quadruple, by a wide margin) inglizcha tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordam: grafikdan misol aytish mumkin, so'z o'rniga 'blank' deyiladi (masalan: 'Sales in Berlin blank — from 10 to 40').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

20.title: Find someone who… has witnessed a big change
20.stage: Dars o'rtasida, 'Present + highlight' dan oldin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Trend va overview so'zlari bilan (witness, considerably, mixed results, by far, summarise) to'g'ri savol tuzish va o'z tajribasi haqida gapirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you witnessed a big change in your neighbourhood?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What changed? How much? Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni bitta overview gap bilan aytadi (masalan: 'Most of the class have ridden an e-bike, while only one …').

items.t: …has witnessed a big change in his/her neighbourhood.
items.q: Have you witnessed a big change in your neighbourhood?

items.t: …can easily summarise a film in one sentence.
items.q: Can you easily summarise a film in one sentence?

items.t: …reads the summary of an article before the details.
items.q: Do you read the summary of an article before the details?

items.t: …spends considerably more time online than he/she did two years ago.
items.q: Do you spend considerably more time online than you did two years ago?

items.t: …has ridden an electric scooter or an e-bike.
items.q: Have you ever ridden an electric scooter or an e-bike?

items.t: …thinks e-scooters should be banned from pavements.
items.q: Do you think e-scooters should be banned from pavements?

items.t: …got mixed results in his/her last set of exams.
items.q: Did you get mixed results in your last set of exams?

items.t: …is by far the youngest person in his/her family.
items.q: Are you by far the youngest person in your family?

items.t: …has noticed prices rising at his/her local bazaar this year.
items.q: Have you noticed prices rising at your local bazaar this year?

items.t: …follows a news channel that explains data with charts.
items.q: Do you follow a news channel that explains data with charts?

items.t: …writes the overview before the body paragraphs.
items.q: Do you write the overview before the body paragraphs?

items.t: …has taken part in a survey about his/her habits.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in a survey about your habits?

20.title: Speaking cards: trends, transport and the big picture
20.stage: Keyingi dars boshida yoki Speaking darsida, IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va 3 savollariga 3–4 gapli javob: tendensiyalar, shahar transporti (e-bike, skuter), umumlashtirish; darsdagi trend so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 30–40 soniya javob beradi: avval bitta umumiy gap (overview kabi), keyin sabab va misol.
Tinglovchi darsdagi so'zlarni sanaydi (a rising trend, witness, by far, considerably, mixed results, dominate…): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you prefer to get the big picture first or the details first? Why?
What trends have you noticed among teenagers in Uzbekistan recently?
Have electric scooters become popular in your city? Why or why not?
Would you rather cycle or take public transport to school or work? Why?
Which form of transport do you think will dominate cities in twenty years?
Why do some trends grow very quickly and then disappear?
Is it easy for you to summarise a long story in a few sentences?
Which sport is by far the most popular in your country? Why?
Should governments encourage people to use bicycles instead of cars? How?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of e-bikes for young people?
Has your use of social media increased or decreased over the last few years? Why?
Why might the same new product have mixed results in different cities?
Have prices in your local shops risen considerably recently? Give examples.
In your opinion, what is the key feature of a good lesson?

20.title: Sentence Race: overview and highlight sentences
20.stage: 'Present + highlight' bosqichidan keyin, e-bike namunasidan oldin (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Overview va highlight gaplarida so'z tartibini tuzish: Overall + determiner, trend kollokatsiyasi, while, considerably / far higher than, the steepest relative increase, a less consistent pattern.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gap overview uchunmi yoki body paragraph (highlight) uchunmi — to'g'ri aytsa.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Overall, all five cities saw an upward trend in tourism.
Only one of these regions experienced a drop in exports.
Tashkent's total was far higher than in any other city.
The steepest relative increase took place in Namangan.
Overall, the smartphone market had mixed results across the region.
Sales in Tashkent were considerably higher than in Fergana.
Overall, neither of the two smaller towns changed significantly.
Car sales followed a less consistent pattern.
Prices rose in most of these markets, while rents stayed stable.
It is also clear that Samarkand led the way in tourism.

20.title: Quiz Board: a clear overview
20.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa va vazifa' dan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Overview qoidalari, umbrella terms, determinerlar, trend kollokatsiyalari va highlight tilini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fix the error 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 40 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblarda boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Which one word usually signals the overview?
Should an overview include figures?
qs.a: No — it is general, with no numbers.

qs.q: What must a Band 7 overview present clearly?
qs.a: the main trends, differences or stages

qs.q: Name two of the four causes of an unclear overview.
qs.a: Two of: one trend, wrong language, too much detail, unclear reference

qs.q: What turns a 'listed' key feature into a 'highlighted' one?
qs.a: Saying why it matters (e.g. by far the biggest), then giving figures.

qs.q: Umbrella term for 'chess, draughts and backgammon'?
Which three verbs go with 'a rising trend'?
What does 'marginal' mean in 'a marginal rise'?
Complete: Sales in Oslo and Rome were 5,000 and 9,000 ___.
One verb for 'to become four times bigger'?
Most cities did a rising trend in sales.
qs.a: Most cities saw / experienced / witnessed a rising trend in sales.

qs.q: Most of cities saw a fall.
qs.a: Most of the cities / Most cities saw a fall.

qs.q: Only one of these country grew.
qs.a: Only one of these countries grew.

qs.q: Energy use in the region saw substantial gains.
qs.a: Energy use in the region rose substantially.

qs.q: Overall, the former increased, whereas the latter declined.
qs.a: Name them, e.g. Overall, e-bike sales rose, while scooter sales fell.

qs.q: Say it more strongly with 'by far': 'Samarkand had the biggest rise.'
qs.a: Samarkand had by far the biggest rise.

qs.q: Give one umbrella term for three things in your classroom.
Make it general: 'Prices rose in Andijan, Fergana and Namangan.'
qs.a: Prices rose in all three cities.

qs.q: Highlight it: 'Khiva had 2,000 visitors in 2010 and 8,000 in 2020.'
qs.a: e.g. Khiva saw a dramatic rise: visitor numbers quadrupled to 8,000.

qs.q: Say an overview with a contrast: phone calls vs. messaging over ten years.
qs.a: e.g. Overall, messaging rose, while calls saw the opposite trend.

21.title: Grammar Auction: accurate line graph sentences
21.stage: O'quvchilar 3-xatboshini yozgach, juftlik tekshiruvidan oldin: xato topish (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
21.goal: Line graph javobidagi Band 6 xatolarini topish va tuzatish: taxmin iborasi aniqligi (just under / close to), past simple va past perfect (by + yil), pasayishda 'reach', dalilsiz sabab va 'popular', uslubga mos kelmaydigan so'z.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz line graph haqidagi gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda xato bormi (taxmin iborasi, zamon, fe'l, sabab, so'z tanlash)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gap uchun: birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan VA sababini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: '58% — over emas, close to 60%').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: In 2000, just under half of all households (47%) had internet access.
items.why: 47% — 'just under half' aniq taxmin; haqiqiy raqam qavsda berilgan.

items.s: Bus use reached 12% in 2020, down from 30% in 1995.
items.fix: Bus use fell to 12% in 2020, down from 30% in 1995.
items.why: reach — yuqori darajaga yetish; pasayishda 'fell to' ishlatiladi.

items.s: In 2015, the number of visitors had risen to two million.
items.fix: By 2015, the number of visitors had risen to two million.
items.why: Past perfect ikki vaqtni bog'laydi: 'by + yil'. 'In 2015' bo'lsa — 'rose'.

items.s: Car ownership climbed to just over 60% (58%) in 2005.
items.fix: Car ownership climbed to close to 60% (58%) in 2005.
items.why: 58% — 60% dan kam: 'just over' emas, 'close to / just under 60%'.

items.s: The growth in online shopping corresponded with a decline in visits to local markets.
items.why: Ikki o'zgarish bir vaqtda — 'corresponded with': sabab da'vo qilinmagan.

items.s: Cycling became more popular than bus travel after 2012.
items.fix: Cycling became more common than bus travel after 2012.
items.why: Grafik odamlar nimani yoqtirganini ko'rsatmaydi: 'popular' emas, 'common'.

items.s: Train use doubled between 2005 and 2020 because the city built new lines.
items.fix: Train use doubled between 2005 and 2020.
items.why: Grafik sababni ko'rsatmaydi — 'because …' dalilsiz xulosa, olib tashlanadi.

items.s: Tea consumption fluctuated between 80 and 90 grams per person per week throughout the period.
items.why: fluctuate between X and Y — to'g'ri; o'lchov birligi bir marta berilgan.

items.s: Consumers ingested less sugar in 2020 than in 2000.
items.fix: Consumers ate less sugar in 2020 than in 2000.
items.why: 'ingest' — tibbiy/ilmiy so'z; oddiy matnda 'ate' yoki 'consumed'.

items.s: By 2018, online sales had overtaken sales in high-street shops.
items.why: By + yil + had overtaken — ikki vaqt bog'langan, past perfect to'g'ri.

items.s: The share of cyclists rose by six percentage points, from 4% to 10%.
items.why: Ikki foiz orasidagi farq 'percentage points' bilan beriladi (10 − 4 = 6).

items.s: Tram use slided from 25% to 17% between 1995 and 2010.
items.fix: Tram use slid from 25% to 17% between 1995 and 2010.
items.why: slide — noto'g'ri fe'l: slide – slid – slid.

21.title: Board Game: line graph language race
21.stage: Keyingi Writing darsi boshida 'Takrorlash' o'rniga, 21-dars tili takrori (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
21.goal: Line graph tilini og'zaki mashq qilish: taxmin iboralari, past simple / past perfect, tendensiya fe'llari (climb, slide, peak, overtake), percentage points, overview va guruhlash, correlation ≠ causation; qatnov mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: raqamni taxmin iborasi bilan aytish, zamon tanlash, xatoni tuzatish, overview yoki gapirish savoli.
Guruh a'zolari javob kalitidan tekshiradi. Javob noto'g'ri yoki noaniq bo'lsa (masalan, 58% uchun 'over 60%') — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar namuna: mazmuni va grammatikasi to'g'ri bo'lgan boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.
'Speaking' kataklarida kamida 3 gap bilan javob beriladi va kamida bitta dars so'zi (commute, share, decline…) ishlatiladi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi. FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Say 48% with an approximation phrase.
squares.a: just under half / nearly half

squares.t: Say 52% with an approximation phrase.
squares.a: just over half

squares.t: Say the past forms: slide, rise, fall.
squares.a: slid, rose, fell

squares.t: Give two synonyms for 'go up' that suit a line graph.
squares.a: e.g. climb, rise, increase, grow

squares.t: Say 23% with an approximation phrase.
squares.a: e.g. just under a quarter / nearly a quarter

squares.t: What is a commuter? Use the word in a sentence.
squares.a: Someone who travels regularly to work or school, e.g. Most commuters here use the metro.

squares.t: Complete: '___ 2010, bus use had fallen to 20%.'
squares.a: By 2010, bus use had fallen to 20%.

squares.t: Past simple or past perfect? 'In 2015, train use ___ (double).'
squares.a: doubled (only one time point → past simple)

squares.t: The figure is 58%. Is 'over 60%' correct? Say it better.
squares.a: No, 58% is below 60%: 'close to 60%' or 'just under 60%'.

squares.t: Speaking: How do you get to school or work? How long does it take?
squares.a: e.g. I take the metro, and it takes about 25 minutes door to door.

squares.t: Correct: After a long decline, bus use reached 12% in 2020.
squares.a: After a long decline, bus use fell to 12% in 2020.

squares.t: Use 'peaked at' in a sentence: car use, 2005, 59%.
squares.a: e.g. Car use peaked at just under 60% (59%) in 2005.

squares.t: Correct: Cycling became more popular than bus travel.
squares.a: Cycling became more common than bus travel.

squares.t: Should a line graph overview give the highest figure or the main trends?
squares.a: The main trends: what rose, what fell and what overtook what.

squares.t: Rewrite about people: 'The bus figure fell.'
squares.a: e.g. Fewer commuters travelled by bus.

squares.t: A figure rises from 4% to 20%. Describe the change in one word.
squares.a: fivefold (it rose fivefold / a fivefold increase)

squares.t: 20% → 30%: is it 'rose by 10%' or 'rose by 10 percentage points'?
squares.a: by 10 percentage points (in relative terms it is a 50% rise)

squares.t: Two lines change at the same time. 'caused' or 'corresponded with'?
squares.a: corresponded with: a graph shows correlation, not causation.

squares.t: Why is 'Citizens ingested less beef' a Band 6 sentence?
squares.a: Wrong register: 'ingested' is scientific and 'citizens' is official. Say 'People ate less beef'.

squares.t: Four lines: two rise and two fall. How do you group the body paragraphs?
squares.a: Two paragraphs: the two falling lines together, the two rising lines together.

squares.t: Why is splitting paragraphs by period (1990–2000, 2000–2010) weak?
squares.a: It repeats the same lines and makes comparison harder.

21.title: Quiz Board: line graphs — accurate and precise
21.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichidan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 ustun × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Approximate it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniya maslahatlashib, bitta vakil orqali javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ball ularga).
'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar namuna: mazmuni va grammatikasi to'g'ri bo'lgan har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

22.title: Grammar Auction: shares, forecasts and comparisons
22.stage: 5-mashqni yozgach, juftlik tekshiruvidan oldin: xato topish (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
22.goal: Pie chart / prognoz gaplaridagi Band 6 xatolarini topish: 'Other' + ot, account for / make up / constitute, shaxssiz prognoz (is projected to), By + yil → future perfect, fewer / less, albeit o'rni.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz pie chart yoki prognoz haqidagi gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato bormi ('Other', ulush fe'li, prognoz, zamon, fewer/less, albeit)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gap uchun: birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan VA qoidani aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'By 2040 → will have fallen').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The pie charts give a breakdown of electricity sources in one country in 2020, with projections for 2040.
items.why: Pie chart kirishi: 'give a breakdown of' + kelajak uchun 'projections'.

items.s: Other made up 6% of the total.
items.fix: Other sources made up 6% of the total.
items.why: 'Other' yolg'iz ot emas — unga ot qo'shiladi: other sources.

items.s: Wind power will probably reach 30% in 2040.
items.fix: Wind power is projected to reach 30% in 2040.
items.why: Prognoz — shaxssiz passiv (is projected to), 'will probably' emas.

items.s: By 2040, hydropower will fall to 5%.
items.fix: By 2040, hydropower will have fallen to 5%.
items.why: By + kelajak sana → future perfect: will have + V3.

items.s: Less students chose history in 2020 than in 2010.
items.fix: Fewer students chose history in 2020 than in 2010.
items.why: students — sanaladigan ot: less emas, fewer.

items.s: Coal accounted for just over a third (35%) of electricity production.
items.why: 35% — 'just over a third'; kasr + haqiqiy raqam qavsda — to'g'ri.

items.s: Gas made up for 40% of the total in 2020.
items.fix: Gas made up 40% of the total in 2020.
items.why: Ulushda 'make up' dan keyin 'for' yo'q (account FOR, lekin make up).

items.s: It is expected that nuclear power will remain at around 10%.
items.why: It is expected that … will — shaxssiz prognoz, to'g'ri.

items.s: Albeit from a lower base, wind power grew quickly.
items.fix: Wind power grew quickly, albeit from a lower base.
items.why: albeit gap boshida kelmaydi — gap o'rtasida, vergul bilan.

items.s: The share of solar energy is expected to more than quadruple between 2020 and 2040.
items.why: be expected to + more than quadruple — to'g'ri prognoz tili.

items.s: Supermarkets accounted for far more purchases than local markets.
items.why: far more + ot + than — to'g'ri va aniq solishtirish.

items.s: Oil constituted of only 5% of the total in 2020.
items.fix: Oil constituted only 5% of the total in 2020.
items.why: constitute + ulush: 'of' kerak emas ('consist of' bilan adashtirmang).

22.title: Board Game: pie charts, projections and comparisons
22.stage: Keyingi Writing darsi boshida 'Takrorlash' o'rniga, 22-dars tili takrori (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
22.goal: Pie chart / stacked bar tilini og'zaki mashq qilish: kasr + foiz, 'Other' qoidasi, prognoz (is expected to, It is predicted that, will have + V3), fewer / less, as many … as, albeit, respectively, guruhlash va overview.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: foizni kasrga aylantirish, xatoni tuzatish, prognoz gapi, tartib savoli yoki gapirish.
Guruh a'zolari javob kalitidan tekshiradi. Javob noto'g'ri bo'lsa (masalan, 'Less people') — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar namuna: mazmuni va grammatikasi to'g'ri bo'lgan boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.
'Speaking' kataklarida kamida 3 gap bilan javob beriladi va kamida bitta prognoz shakli ishlatiladi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi. FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Say 25% as a fraction.
squares.a: a quarter

squares.t: Say 34% as a fraction, with the real figure in brackets.
squares.a: just over a third (34%)

squares.t: Give three verbs meaning 'is X% of the total'.
squares.a: account for, make up, constitute

squares.a: less money, fewer tourists, less electricity

squares.t: Correct: Other made up 5% of the budget.
squares.a: e.g. Other costs made up 5% of the budget.

squares.t: Correct: Less people cycled to work in 2020.
squares.a: Fewer people cycled to work in 2020.

squares.t: Speaking: Where does your family usually buy food? Has it changed?
squares.a: e.g. We mostly go to the bazaar, but we order online more often now.

squares.t: Make it a forecast: 'Online sales will probably grow.'
squares.a: Online sales are expected / predicted to grow.

squares.t: Start with 'It is predicted that…': solar power, 20%, 2040.
squares.a: It is predicted that solar power will account for 20% of the total in 2040.

squares.t: Complete: 'By 2040, gas ___ (fall) to 10%.'
squares.a: will have fallen (or: is expected to have fallen)

squares.t: Say it with 'as many … as': 200 cars, 200 bikes.
squares.a: e.g. There were as many bikes as cars.

squares.t: When should you mention the 'Other' category? Give one reason.
squares.a: e.g. it is over 5%, bigger than another category, or changes a lot.

squares.t: What does a 100% stacked bar have in common with a pie chart?
squares.a: Both show a breakdown of a whole, so you describe them in the same way.

squares.t: Use 'respectively' with two figures: 45% and 18%.
squares.a: e.g. Buses and trains carried 45% and 18% of commuters respectively.

squares.t: Why is it weak to describe 2020 in one paragraph and 2040 in the next?
squares.a: You describe two pictures separately and lose the comparison of change.

squares.t: Use 'albeit' in a sentence about two growing categories.
squares.a: e.g. Wind power grew too, albeit more slowly than solar.

squares.t: What does 'lose ground' mean? Give an example.
squares.a: Become less important, e.g. Bazaars are forecast to lose ground.

squares.t: 5% → 22%: how many times larger? Say it with a verb like 'double'.
squares.a: It more than quadrupled (5 × 4 = 20).

squares.t: A student adds 35% and 24% and writes '59% used buses or trains'. Problem?
squares.a: It creates a new figure; report only the numbers given in the chart.

squares.t: Use 'in stark contrast to' to compare two categories.
squares.a: e.g. In stark contrast to coal, solar power is set to boom.

squares.t: Why is 'recovered' the wrong verb for a rise in air pollution?
squares.a: 'Recover' suggests something good; say 'rose again'.

squares.t: Speaking Part 3: Will bazaars still be important in 2040? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, for fresh produce, but their share will probably shrink as online delivery grows.

squares.t: One-sentence overview: gas stays first, solar grows most, coal falls.
squares.a: e.g. Overall, gas is set to stay dominant, while solar is expected to grow most and coal to decline.

23.title: Grammar Auction: map changes and the passive
23.stage: 'Passiv va zamonlar diapazoni' bosqichidan keyin, 1-mashq bilan birga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
23.goal: Map va plan tasvirida Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini topish va tuzatish: yordamchi fe'lsiz passiv, 'There has built', 'are planned to be', relocate to, shaxsiy baho; retain, make way for, remain intact iboralari.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar shahar, orol va bino xaritalaridagi o'zgarishlar haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi — xato turini ham aytishi kerak: passiv shakli, 'There has built', 'are planned to be', predlog yoki shaxsiy baho.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Prior to development, the island had no accommodation for visitors.
items.why: Prior to + ot — 'oldin' xatboshisini ochadi; o'tgan holat past simple'da.

items.s: A new car park built next to the library.
items.fix: A new car park has been built next to the library.
items.why: Passivda yordamchi fe'l tushib qolmasin: has been + V3.

items.s: The old cinema was demolished to make way for a shopping centre.
items.why: Past passive + make way for — nima uchun buzilganini aniq aytadi.

items.s: There has built a café opposite the main entrance.
items.fix: A café has been built opposite the main entrance.
items.why: 'There has built' — xato; ega oldinda turadi + has been + V3.

items.s: The original town hall has been retained and now houses a museum.
items.why: O'zgarmagan narsa ham key feature: has been retained (birlik ega).

items.s: The tennis courts are planned to be removed.
items.fix: The tennis courts will be removed.
items.why: Reja uchun oddiy will be + V3; 'are planned to be' bunday ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: In terms of access, a footbridge will be built across the river.
items.why: In terms of + umbrella term — mavzuni almashtiradi; future passive.

items.s: A beautiful new marina has been built on the east coast.
items.fix: A new marina has been built on the east coast.
items.why: Shaxsiy baho (beautiful) — TA pasayadi; faqat faktni yozing.

items.s: There will be two new cycle lanes along the seafront.
items.why: Mavjudlik: there will be + ko'plik ot — to'g'ri.

items.s: The primary school has been relocated at the north of the town.
items.fix: The primary school has been relocated to the north of the town.
items.why: relocate TO + yangi joy (yo'nalish predlogi), 'at' emas.

items.s: The museum will remain intact, while the car park beside it will be extended.
items.why: remain intact — o'zgarmaydi; while bilan qarama-qarshi o'zgarish.

items.s: The old market will renovate next year.
items.fix: The old market will be renovated next year.
items.why: Bozor o'zini ta'mirlamaydi — passiv kerak: will be + V3.

23.title: Board Game: describing maps and plans
23.stage: 'Sinfda yozish'dan oldin yoki keyingi dars boshida: map strategiyasi va tilini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
23.goal: Map strategiyasi (key features, overview, zamonlar diapazoni), aktivdan passivga o'tkazish, umbrella term va aniq fe'llar (widen, lengthen, relocate) hamda shahar o'zgarishi haqida og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: gapni passivga o'tkazadi, umbrella term yoki aniq fe'l aytadi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javob kalitidan tekshiradi; 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblarda boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

23.title: Dominoes: precise map verbs and umbrella terms
23.stage: 'Aniq joylashuv va fe'llar' bosqichida, 3-mashqdan oldin (12 daqiqa)
23.goal: Oddiy iborani aniq map fe'li bilan (make wider → widen, knock down → demolish) va detallar ro'yxatini umbrella term bilan (cafés, shops → amenities) ulash — overview va body uchun asosiy ko'nikma.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi oddiy ibora yoki detallar ro'yxatiga mos aniq fe'l yoki umbrella term qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping va ulang.

Birinchi tugatgan guruh 3 ta fe'lni tanlab, har birini passiv gap ichida ovoz chiqarib aytadi (masalan: The road has been widened). Ustoz tekshiradi.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Topgan jamoa shu so'z bilan xaritaga oid bitta passiv gap aytsa (masalan: The pier has been extended) — yana +1 bonus ball.
Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

23.title: Find someone who… lives in a redeveloped area
23.stage: Namuna javob (aeroport rejasi) tahlilidan oldin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
23.goal: Shahar, maktab va mahalladagi o'zgarishlar haqida present perfect va passiv bilan savol tuzish (Has your area been redeveloped? Have you ever watched a building being demolished?).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Has your area been redeveloped recently?). Zamon va passiv to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What was there before? When was it built?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va bitta topilmani passiv gap bilan sinfga aytadi (masalan: Aziz's school has been extended).

24.title: Grammar Auction: process language and the passive
24.stage: 'Jarayon grammatikasi' bosqichidan keyin, 1- va 3-mashq bilan birga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
24.goal: Process javobidagi tipik xatolarni topish va tuzatish: intransitive fe'l passivda, once + will, comprise of, last to, evolve, -ing yorliqni ko'chirish; to + infinitive, which, allowing tuzilmalarini mashq qilish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar ishlab chiqarish va hayot sikli diagrammalari haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi — xato turini ham aytishi kerak: intransitive fe'l, once + will, predlog, noto'g'ri fe'l yoki -ing yorliq.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).
