items.why: once + present perfect passive, keyingi qadam — present simple passive.

items.s: Once the glass will be crushed, it is melted in a furnace.
items.fix: Once the glass has been crushed, it is melted in a furnace.
items.why: once dan keyin will emas — present perfect passive: has been + V3.

items.s: The olives are crushed to extract the oil.
items.why: Maqsad: to + infinitive — nima uchun qilinishini ko'rsatadi.

items.s: The tadpoles are become frogs after about twelve weeks.
items.fix: The tadpoles become frogs after about twelve weeks.
items.why: become — intransitive fe'l, passivda bo'lmaydi.

items.s: The clay is shaped into bricks, which are then left to dry.
items.why: which — oldingi otga (bricks) ishora; 'is + V3' takroridan qochish.

items.s: The whole cycle comprises of four main stages.
items.fix: The whole cycle comprises four main stages.
items.why: comprise dan keyin 'of' kelmaydi: comprises four stages (lekin: consists of).

items.s: The wet pulp is pressed between rollers, allowing most of the water to be removed.
items.why: allowing sth to be + V3 — natijani bitta gapda ko'rsatadi.

items.s: The drying stage lasts to about two days.
items.fix: The drying stage lasts for about two days.
items.why: Davomiylik: last FOR (to emas).

items.s: The ripe olives fall onto nets and are then collected by hand.
items.why: fall — aktiv (intransitive); collect — passiv: are collected.

items.s: Young salmon evolve into adults while they are at sea.
items.fix: Young salmon develop into adults while they are at sea.
items.why: evolve — millionlab yillik moslashuv; hayot siklida develop / grow into.

items.s: After the leaves have been rolled, they are left to oxidise.
items.why: after + present perfect passive — tartibni First/Then siz ko'rsatadi.

items.s: The raw materials are mixed and then heating in a kiln.
items.fix: The raw materials are mixed and then heated in a kiln.
items.why: Yorliqdagi -ing ni ko'chirmang: passiv 'are … heated'.

24.title: Board Game: steps, stages and process language
24.stage: 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida: process strategiyasi va tilini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
24.goal: Step va stage farqi, overview, -ing yorliqdan passivga, maqsad/natija tuzilmalari, once + present perfect, last / take / spend va zig-zag bog'lanishni og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: yorliqni gapga aylantiradi, xatoni tuzatadi, gapni davom ettiradi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javob kalitidan tekshiradi; 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblarda boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Step or stage: one numbered action such as 'crushing'?
squares.a: a step

squares.t: Label → sentence: 'Washing (the potatoes)'.
squares.a: The potatoes are washed.

squares.t: Label → sentence: 'Grinding (wheat → flour)'.
squares.a: The wheat is ground into flour.

squares.t: Passive or not? 'Arriving (lorries → the factory)'.
squares.a: Not passive: The lorries arrive at the factory.

squares.t: Say the past participles: grind, spin, freeze.
squares.a: ground, spun, frozen

squares.t: Correct: The boiling step lasts to ten minutes.
squares.a: The boiling step lasts for ten minutes.

squares.t: Correct: The caterpillar develops in a butterfly.
squares.a: The caterpillar develops into a butterfly.

squares.t: Correct: Once the milk will be heated, it is cooled.
squares.a: Once the milk has been heated, it is cooled.

squares.t: Add a purpose: 'The water is boiled …'
squares.a: e.g. … to kill any bacteria.

squares.t: Add a result with -ing: 'The grapes are pressed, …'
squares.a: e.g. …, releasing their juice.

squares.t: Join with 'which': The logs are cut. This makes them easier to carry.
squares.a: The logs are cut, which makes them easier to carry.

squares.t: Take, last or spend? The eggs ___ about ten days to hatch.
squares.a: take

squares.t: Take, last or spend? Young salmon ___ two years in the river.
squares.a: spend

squares.t: Natural or man-made: recycling glass bottles?
squares.a: man-made (a largely mechanical process)

squares.t: Give two umbrella terms to split a frog's life cycle.
squares.a: e.g. in the water / on land

squares.t: Give two stage names for making chocolate.
squares.a: e.g. on the cocoa farm / in the factory

squares.t: Overview: 'It starts with X and ends with Y.' What is missing?
squares.a: The main stages — it gives only the first and last steps.

squares.t: Machine → verb: 'a separator'. The cream is …
squares.a: separated (from the milk)

squares.t: Describe it without its name: a 'kiln'.
squares.a: e.g. a very hot oven that bakes bricks or pots

squares.t: Zig-zag: '…, leaving a thick paste.' Start the next sentence.
squares.a: e.g. This paste is then spread onto trays.

squares.t: Why is 'First… Then… Next… Finally…' in every sentence weak?
squares.a: Mechanical linking = Band 6; use once/after, zig-zag, varied positions.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The diagram shows how paper is recycled.'
squares.a: e.g. The diagram illustrates the stages in recycling paper.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how is your favourite drink made?
squares.a: e.g. Water is boiled, and then the tea leaves are added and left to brew.

squares.t: Say an overview for making tea (two stages).
squares.a: e.g. Overall, the process falls into two stages: growing the leaves and processing them.

24.title: Dominoes: process words and their meanings
24.goal: Jarayon so'zlarini ta'rif yoki gap bilan ulash: manually, mechanically, labour-intensive, hatch, subsequently, comprise / consist of, extract / remove, step / stage, raw material.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ta'rif yoki bo'sh joyli gapga mos so'z qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping va ulang.
Diqqat: comprise va consist juftligida bo'sh joydan keyin 'of' bor-yo'qligiga qarang; extract — keraklisini, remove — keraksizini olish.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi va 3 ta so'z bilan jarayon haqida gap tuzadi (masalan: The cherries are picked manually). Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: needing a lot of human work
(of an egg) break open to let a young animal out
take out the useful part, e.g. juice or oil
take away the unwanted part, e.g. skin or stones
continue for a period of time
the basic substance a product is made from
one numbered action in a diagram
a group of several related steps
pass a liquid through a mesh to clean it

24.title: Taboo: production and life cycles
24.stage: 'Kirish' bosqichidan keyin: jarayon so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
24.goal: Jarayon va hayot sikli so'zlarini (harvest, grind, filter, extract, conveyor belt, furnace, larva, cocoon, raw material) inglizcha ta'rif bilan tushuntirish — nomini bilmagan narsani tasvirlash ko'nikmasi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Maslahat: Task 1 dagi kabi tasvirlang — ot + 1–2 sifat + nima qiladi (a hot machine that…).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

24.title: Find someone who… has seen how silk is made
24.stage: Namuna javob (coffee) tahlilidan oldin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
24.goal: Ishlab chiqarish, ovqat tayyorlash, qayta ishlash va tabiatdagi jarayonlar haqida savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you know how … is made?) — passiv va present perfect bilan.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever seen how silk is made in Margilan?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi: What happens first? What happens once it has been …?
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va bitta jarayonni 2–3 passiv gap bilan sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has visited a factory and seen a production line.
items.q: Have you ever visited a factory and seen a production line?

items.t: …has picked fruit or vegetables by hand.
items.q: Have you ever picked fruit or vegetables by hand?

items.t: …knows how bread is made from wheat.
items.q: Do you know how bread is made from wheat?

items.t: …has seen how silk is made in Margilan.
items.q: Have you ever seen how silk is made in Margilan?

items.t: …has helped to cook plov from start to finish.
items.q: Have you ever helped to cook plov from start to finish?

items.t: …sorts their rubbish so that it can be recycled.
items.q: Do you sort your rubbish so that it can be recycled?

items.t: …has baked bread or a cake in the last month.
items.q: Have you baked bread or a cake in the last month?

items.t: …has grown a plant from a seed.
items.q: Have you ever grown a plant from a seed?

items.t: …knows how long it takes for a chick to hatch.
items.q: Do you know how long it takes for a chick to hatch?

items.t: …thinks handmade products are better than machine-made ones.
items.q: Do you think handmade products are better than machine-made ones?

items.t: …has watched a video about how something is manufactured.
items.q: Have you ever watched a video about how something is manufactured?

items.t: …would like to work in food production one day.
items.q: Would you like to work in food production one day?

24.title: Speaking cards: how things are made
24.stage: 'Amaliyot' bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida — Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (12 daqiqa)
24.goal: Jarayonlar, hunarmandchilik, ishlab chiqarish va texnologiya mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga javob berish; passiv, once / after va jarayon so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi (examiner rolida).
Part 1 kartasiga 2–3 gap bilan, 'Part 3' deb boshlangan kartaga fikr + sabab + misol bilan kamida 4 gap bilan javob beriladi.
Javobda kamida bitta passiv (is made, are picked) va bitta ketma-ketlik vositasi (once / after + present perfect, subsequently) bo'lishi kerak.
Tinglovchi har bir to'g'ri passiv va ketma-ketlik vositasi uchun +1 ball beradi. Rollar almashadi; eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy cooking? Describe how you make one simple dish.
Have you ever made something by hand? How did you do it?
What products is your region of Uzbekistan famous for?
Do you prefer handmade or factory-made clothes? Why?
How is tea usually prepared in your family?
Do you recycle anything at home? What happens to it afterwards?
Describe a natural process you learnt about at school, e.g. the water cycle.
Part 3: Why are many traditional crafts disappearing?
Part 3: Should more farm work be done mechanically? Why or why not?
Part 3: Is it important for consumers to know how their food is produced?
Part 3: What are the advantages and disadvantages of replacing workers with machines?
Part 3: How has technology changed the way food is produced?
Part 3: Why do so many people enjoy watching videos of how things are made?
Part 3: Should schools teach students how everyday products are made?

24.title: Sentence Race: process sentences
24.stage: 'Coherence: zig-zag va marker o'rni' bosqichida, 5-mashqdan oldin isitish (8 daqiqa)
24.goal: Process javobi gaplarini (overview, once + present perfect passive, to + infinitive, which, hayot sikli fe'llari) to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Maslahat: katta harfli so'z gap boshida, nuqtali so'z oxirida, vergulli so'z birinchi qism oxirida turadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball; gapdagi vositani (passiv, once + present perfect, to + infinitive, which) nomlab bersa yana +1.
Jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi. Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Overall, the process falls into three main stages.
Once the cotton has been picked, the seeds are removed by machine.
The seeds are soaked to make them softer.
Within about twelve weeks, the tadpoles turn into frogs.
The milk is heated to a high temperature, which kills most bacteria.
The bricks are fired in a kiln to harden them.
Young salmon spend up to three years in freshwater rivers.
Once melted, the glass is poured into bottle-shaped moulds.
The diagram illustrates how recycled paper is produced.
The first stage of the process takes place on a farm.

24.title: Quiz Board: Writing Task 1 processes
24.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida yoki keyingi darsning boshida takror sifatida (15 daqiqa)
24.goal: Process tuzilmasi (step / stage, overview, zig-zag), jarayon so'zlari, tipik xatolar va og'zaki gap tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Language 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblarda boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What is the difference between a step and a stage?
qs.a: Step = one action; stage = a group of steps

qs.q: What four things can a full process overview include?
qs.a: Type, number of steps, 2–3 stages, the main change

qs.q: Why is 'It starts with A and ends with B' a weak overview?
qs.a: It gives only the first and last steps; no stages

qs.q: What should the first sentence of each body paragraph tell the reader?
qs.a: Which stage it describes (e.g. The first stage…)

qs.q: What is 'zig-zag' linking?
qs.a: New information at the end of one sentence starts the next

qs.q: Past participle of 'grind'?
Last or take: 'Drying ___ for about three days.'
Comprise or consist: 'The cycle ___ of four stages.'
Extract or remove: 'The juice is ___ from the oranges.'
Adjective: needing a lot of workers and effort.
The leaves are fallen to the ground.
qs.a: The leaves fall to the ground.

qs.q: Fermentation lasts to about three days.
qs.a: Fermentation lasts for about three days.

qs.q: Once the wool will be washed, it is dried.
qs.a: Once the wool has been washed, it is dried.

qs.q: The steam is condensered into water.
qs.a: The steam is condensed into water.

qs.q: The caterpillar evolves into a butterfly.
Label → sentence: 'Washing (the carrots)'.
Add a purpose: 'The fruit is dried …'
Join with -ing: The sugar is heated. This turns it brown.
qs.a: The sugar is heated, turning it brown.

qs.q: Use 'once': The potatoes are peeled. Then they are sliced.
qs.a: Once the potatoes have been peeled, they are sliced.

qs.q: Say an overview for making jam (two stages).
qs.a: e.g. Overall, it has two stages: preparing the fruit and cooking it.

25.title: Grammar Auction: one-sentence arguments
25.stage: 'Aniq bo'lmagan argumentlar' bosqichidan keyin, 2–3-mashqlardan so'ng (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
25.goal: Bir gapli argumentda (xulosa + sabab) Band 6 xatolarini topish: sabab-xulosa bog'lovchilari (because, since, so, as a result), 'The main reason why ... is that ...', so'z shakli, moslashuv va asossiz kuchli so'z.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Barcha gaplar — bir gapli argumentlar (xulosa + sabab) yoki argument tili.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap Band 7 essayga yaraydimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi (bog'lovchi, sabab-xulosa tartibi, so'z shakli, kuchli so'z)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi. To'g'ri gapda xulosa va sababni ajratib aytgan jamoa ham +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Street lighting makes parks safer at night, so local councils should invest in it.
items.why: SABAB, so + XULOSA — to'g'ri bir gapli argument; sabab xulosani qo'llaydi.

items.s: Because of sugary drinks damage teeth, they should be taxed more heavily.
items.fix: Because sugary drinks damage teeth, they should be taxed more heavily.
items.why: 'because of' + ot; ega + fe'lli gap oldidan faqat 'because' keladi.

items.s: Museums should stay open in the evening, since many working people cannot visit during the day.
items.why: XULOSA + since + SABAB — xulosa boshida, sabab unga mantiqan bog'langan.

items.s: Regular exercise reduces stress because employers should offer gym memberships.
items.fix: Regular exercise reduces stress, so employers should offer gym memberships.
items.why: Sabab va xulosa almashgan: 'because' sababdan, 'so' xulosadan oldin keladi.

items.s: The main reason why schools should start later is that teenagers need more sleep.
items.why: 'The main reason why ... is that ...' — to'g'ri tuzilma.

items.s: The main reason why cities need more parks is because residents need space to relax.
items.fix: The main reason why cities need more parks is that residents need space to relax.
items.why: 'reason ... is because' — ma'no takrori; to'g'risi: '... is that ...'.

items.s: Libraries lend books for free. As result, families spend less on books.
items.fix: Libraries lend books for free. As a result, families spend less on books.
items.why: Bog'lovchi 'As a result' — artikl 'a' tushib qolgan.

items.s: Parents should limit screen time, since too much of it can harm children's sleep.
items.why: XULOSA + since + SABAB; 'it' = screen time — referencing aniq.

items.s: Raising bus fares by ten per cent would have catastrophic effects on students.
items.fix: Raising bus fares by ten per cent would have negative effects on students.
items.why: Mavzu 'catastrophic' kabi kuchli so'zni asoslamaydi — argument ishonchsiz bo'ladi.

items.s: Historic buildings attract tourists to Samarkand, which is why the city should protect them.
items.why: 'which is why' sababdan keyin xulosani to'g'ri ulaydi.

items.s: The reasons in this paragraph does not justify the conclusion.
items.fix: The reasons in this paragraph do not justify the conclusion.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (reasons) — 'does' emas, 'do not justify'.

items.s: It is reasonable to conclude that longer library hours would help students.
items.why: 'It is reasonable to conclude that ...' + would — to'g'ri, ehtiyotkor xulosa iborasi.

25.title: Board Game: Band 6 or Band 7 argument?
25.stage: Keyingi dars boshida 25-dars takrori yoki mini-yozishdan oldin (20 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
25.goal: TR va CC dagi Band 6/Band 7 farqini eslash, argumentda xulosa va sababni topish, 'valid'ligini baholash, 5 xil muammoni nomlash va tuzatish, sabab-natija bog'lovchilari bilan og'zaki argument tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: xulosa yoki sababni topadi, muammoni nomlaydi, gapni tuzatadi yoki 30–40 soniya gapiradi.
'Name the problem' kataklarida 5 turdan biri aytiladi: sababsiz da'vo, to'qilgan dalil, zid fikr, mantiqiy sakrash, asossiz kuchli so'z.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi (javoblar varag'i guruh sardorida). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: What do TR and CC stand for?
squares.a: Task Response; Coherence and Cohesion.

squares.t: An argument = a conclusion + … ?
squares.a: a reason (or reasons) — also called a premise

squares.t: Find the conclusion: 'Parks reduce stress, so cities need more of them.'
squares.a: Cities need more parks.

squares.t: Find the reason: 'Rivers should be protected because they supply drinking water.'
squares.a: They (rivers) supply drinking water.

squares.t: Say an argument with 'because': should schools ban phones in lessons?
squares.a: e.g. Schools should ban phones in lessons because they distract pupils.

squares.t: Valid or not? 'The main road is closed, so buses may be late today.'
squares.a: Valid — a closed road is a logical reason for bus delays.

squares.t: Does writing 'I think' make your position clear?
squares.a: No — only your reasons and logic make your position clear.

squares.t: Band 6 or 7? Some main ideas are not explained or supported.
squares.a: Band 6 (TR: some ideas are inadequately developed).

squares.t: Name the problem: 'The government should ban plastic bags.'
squares.a: No reason. e.g. add '… because they pollute rivers and fields.'

squares.t: Which verb means 'give good reasons for a decision'?
squares.a: justify

squares.t: Valid or not? 'Many people buy cars because petrol is expensive.'
squares.a: Not valid — expensive petrol is not a logical reason to buy a car.

squares.t: Conclusion first: 'Fruit is cheap in summer, so families should buy more of it.'
squares.a: Families should buy more fruit in summer because it is cheap then.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should university be free? Give two reasons.
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because talent matters more than money, and the country needs graduates.

squares.t: Name the problem: 'A video I saw proved that 99% of pupils hate exams.'
squares.a: Invented evidence — use a real, logical example instead.

squares.t: Band 6 or 7? Every paragraph has one clear central idea.
squares.a: Band 7 (CC).

squares.t: Name the problem: 'Homework is useless. It is the best way to learn.'
squares.a: Contradiction — two opposite ideas in one paragraph.

squares.t: Link with 'As a result': 'Rents have risen. Many couples live with parents.'
squares.a: Rents have risen. As a result, many couples live with their parents.

squares.t: Name the problem: 'Bike lanes make city residents healthier.'
squares.a: Logical leap — explain how: more cycling → more exercise → better health.

squares.t: Finish: 'The main reason why the metro should run later is that …'
squares.a: e.g. … many people finish work late at night.

squares.t: Replace the strong word: 'Tourists are a disaster for Bukhara.'
squares.a: e.g. Too many tourists can cause problems for Bukhara.

squares.t: Why should you not copy the style of Reading passages in an essay?
squares.a: Their main idea is often hidden; the examiner should not have to infer yours.

squares.t: Use 'because …, which …': should schools have sports clubs?
squares.a: e.g. They should, because clubs keep pupils active, which improves their health.

squares.t: Band 6 or 7? A two-part question; one part gets only one sentence.
squares.a: Band 6 (TR: not all parts of the task are covered fully).

squares.t: Talk for 40 seconds: should public transport be free? Keep one clear position.
squares.a: e.g. Yes, since it cuts traffic and helps low-income families; same view to the end.

25.title: Dominoes: conclusion + reason
25.stage: 'Bir gapli argument' bosqichida, 1-mashqdan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
25.goal: Xulosa (yozuvchining fikri) ni uni mantiqan qo'llaydigan sabab (because / since / as + sabab) bilan ulab, to'liq bir gapli argument tuzish va 'valid' argumentni his qilish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida XULOSA bor — shu xulosani mantiqan qo'llaydigan SABAB qaysi toshning chap tomonida ekanini toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh har bir argumentni to'liq o'qiydi va sabab xulosani nega qo'llashini bir gapda izohlaydi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: Supermarkets should charge for plastic bags
since a small fee makes shoppers bring their own.
Museums should be free for students
because ticket prices keep many young people away.
Towns should plant trees along busy streets
as their shade keeps pavements cool in summer.
Schools should teach basic first aid
because pupils may one day need to save a life.
Sugary drinks should be taxed more heavily
since higher prices would cut children's sugar intake.
Companies should offer flexible working hours
because staff could then avoid the rush hour.
Teenagers should have a part-time job
because earning money teaches them its value.
because farmers could then sell their products online.
Hospitals should not sell fast food
because it contradicts the healthy diet they promote.
Old buildings in Bukhara should be protected
since they attract tourists and show the city's past.
Children should learn to cook at school
as cooking at home is cheaper than eating out.
Drivers should pay to enter the city centre
because the charge would reduce congestion.
Parents should read to young children
because it builds their vocabulary early.
Factories should be moved out of cities
as their smoke harms residents' lungs.

25.title: Taboo: the language of argument
25.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' dan keyin argument atamalarini kiritishda (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
25.goal: Argument atamalarini (argument, position, claim, evidence, valid, relevant, coherent, justify, contradict, infer, outweigh...) inglizcha ta'rif va misol bilan tushuntira olish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Essay'dan misol keltirib tushuntirgan o'quvchiga ustoz +1 bonus berishi mumkin.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

25.title: Find someone who… has changed their mind
25.stage: Band 6 va Band 7 farqidan keyin, harakatli tanaffus sifatida (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
25.goal: Fikr, bahs va yozish tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…?) va 'Why?' ga bir gapli argument bilan javob berish (fikr + because/since + sabab).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever changed your opinion after hearing a strong argument?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va 'Why?' deb so'raydi: javob bir gapli argument bo'lishi kerak — fikr + because/since + sabab.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eshitgan eng yaxshi 2 ta argumentni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has changed his/her opinion after hearing a strong argument.
items.q: Have you ever changed your opinion after hearing a strong argument?

items.t: …has persuaded a parent to agree to something this year.
items.q: Have you persuaded a parent to agree to something this year?

items.t: …has taken part in a debate or joined a debating club.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in a debate or joined a debating club?

items.t: …plans every essay before starting to write.
items.q: Do you plan every essay before you start writing?

items.t: …has received a Writing band score of 6.5 or higher.
items.q: Have you ever received a Writing band score of 6.5 or higher?

items.t: …checks whether news stories give real evidence.
items.q: Do you check whether news stories give real evidence?

items.t: …thinks sport should be compulsory at university.
items.q: Do you think sport should be compulsory at university?

items.t: …has noticed a fake statistic in an online post.
items.q: Have you ever noticed a fake statistic in an online post?

items.t: …has written an argumentative essay in English this month.
items.q: Have you written an argumentative essay in English this month?

items.t: …can name all four Writing assessment criteria.
items.q: Can you name all four Writing assessment criteria?

items.t: …would support free public transport in his/her city.
items.q: Would you support free public transport in your city?

items.t: …finds it easier to argue for an idea than against it.
items.q: Do you find it easier to argue for an idea than against it?

25.title: Speaking cards: state a position, give a reason
25.stage: Mini-yozishdan oldin g'oya yig'ish uchun, Speaking Part 1/3 uslubida (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
25.goal: Munozarali savollarga aniq pozitsiya + sabab bilan javob berish; 'I think' ni takrorlamasdan, pozitsiyani mantiq va bog'lovchilar (because, since, so, therefore) orqali ko'rsatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–5 gap bilan javob beradi: aniq pozitsiya + kamida 1 ta sabab (because / since / so / therefore).
'I think / In my opinion' ni takrorlash ball bermaydi — pozitsiya sabab orqali ko'rinishi kerak.
Savol bergan o'quvchi 'examiner' bo'ladi: pozitsiya aniq? +1; sabab xulosaga bog'langan? +1; zid fikr yoki asossiz kuchli so'z yo'q? +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy discussing controversial topics with friends? Why or why not?
When did someone last persuade you to change your mind? What was their reason?
Should school uniforms be compulsory? Give a clear position and two reasons.
Why do some people find it hard to accept opinions that differ from their own?
Is it better to make important decisions quickly or after careful thought? Why?
Should energy drinks be banned for people under 18? Justify your view.
Do people trust statistics too easily nowadays? Why?
What makes an argument convincing: facts, personal stories or strong emotions?
Should all university students have to study a foreign language? Why?
Some people say online news is less reliable than newspapers. Do you agree?
Should public transport in Tashkent be free? What would be the main reason?
Is it important for children to learn to disagree politely? Why?
Why do some people use very strong words, like 'disaster', when they argue?
Does social media help or harm public debate? Explain your reasons.

25.title: Sentence Race: clear arguments
25.stage: Namuna essay tahlilidan keyin, mini-yozishdan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
25.goal: Bir gapli argumentlar (so / since / as / which is why) va Band 7 qoidalarini ifodalovchi gaplarni so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzib yig'ish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf, vergul va nuqta tartibga yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball. Gapdagi xulosa va sababni (yoki Band 7 qoidasini) aytsa — yana +1. Keyin keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Bazaars help farmers earn more, so they deserve support.
Every school needs a library because reading develops imagination.
As Samarkand's monuments attract tourists, the city should protect them.
It is reasonable to conclude that free transport would reduce traffic.
Phrases like 'I think' cannot replace clear reasons.
Without evidence, a claim cannot persuade examiners.
Strong words such as 'disaster' can make an argument less convincing.
Since exams cause stress, schools should teach relaxation techniques.
Each body paragraph should focus on one central idea.
Cars pollute the air, which is why cities should limit them.

25.title: Quiz Board: Band 7 arguments
25.stage: Dars oxirida, uyga vazifadan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
25.goal: TR/CC mezonlari, argument tuzilishi (xulosa + sabab), argumentdagi 5 muammo va sabab-natija bog'lovchilarini o'yin shaklida takrorlash; og'zaki bir gapli argument aytish.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fix the argument 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar — namuna: argumentda aniq xulosa va unga bog'langan sabab bo'lsa, boshqa variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What do the letters TR stand for?
Which criterion checks linking, referencing and paragraphing?
Band 6 or 7: the position is clear from the introduction to the conclusion.
Band 6 or 7: the reader has to guess how two sentences are connected.
Name the three typical Band 6 problems in Task Response.
qs.a: Parts not fully answered; unclear position; ideas not developed

qs.q: An argument is a conclusion plus …?
Find the conclusion: 'Trains are safer than cars, so people should use them more.'
Find the reason: 'Zoos should close since animals suffer in small cages.'
Which two linkers introduce a conclusion: because, so, since, therefore?
Name the five reasons why an argument can be unclear.
qs.a: No reason; invented evidence; contradiction; logical leap; wording

qs.q: Fix: 'The main reason is because it is cheap.'
qs.a: The main reason is that it is cheap.

qs.q: Fix: 'As result, fewer people drive to work.'
qs.a: As a result, fewer people drive to work.

qs.q: Fix the strong word: 'Longer school days would be catastrophic for pupils.'
qs.a: e.g. Longer school days could have a negative effect on pupils.

qs.q: What is wrong with this: 'A study proved that 98% of pupils hate homework'?
qs.a: Invented evidence — use a real, logical example.

qs.q: Fill the logical leap: 'Trees in schoolyards improve grades.'
qs.a: e.g. Trees keep classrooms cool, so pupils concentrate better.

qs.q: Give a one-sentence argument with 'because' about homework.
qs.a: e.g. Homework is useful because it helps pupils remember lessons.

qs.q: Give a one-sentence argument with 'so' about city parks.
qs.a: e.g. Parks give children space to play, so every district needs one.

qs.q: Start with 'The main reason why …': why do people learn English?
qs.a: e.g. The main reason why people learn English is that it opens doors.

qs.q: Use 'provided that': should students work part-time?
qs.a: e.g. They can, provided that their grades do not suffer.

qs.q: Use 'because …, which …' to argue that cafés should offer free Wi-Fi.
qs.a: e.g. … because Wi-Fi attracts students, which increases sales.

26.title: Grammar Auction: cause, effect and prediction
26.stage: 'Birlashtirish, referencing' bosqichidan keyin, 3–4-mashqlardan so'ng (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
26.goal: Sabab-oqibat fe'llari (cause, lead to, result in / result from, put pressure on, exceed), shart gaplar (If / When + modal), 'Without' va ishonch darajasidagi Band 6 xatolarini topish va tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Barcha gaplar — sabab-oqibat, bashorat yoki qarama-qarshilik argumentlari.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi (predlog, fe'l shakli, If-gap, haddan oshgan ishonch)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi. To'g'ri gapdagi argument turini (+, →, bashorat, qarama-qarshilik) aytgan jamoa ham +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Traffic jams increase air pollution, which in turn leads to breathing problems.
items.why: Sabab-oqibat zanjiri: causes → which in turn leads to — to'g'ri.

items.s: Heavy rain has resulted from serious floods in the valley.
items.fix: Heavy rain has resulted in serious floods in the valley.
items.why: result in + natija; result from + sabab. Bu yerda yo'nalish teskari.

items.s: Unhealthy diets can lead to gain weight.
items.fix: Unhealthy diets can lead to weight gain.
items.why: 'lead to' dagi 'to' — predlog: undan keyin ot (weight gain) yoki V-ing keladi.

items.s: If tuition were free, more young people from villages would probably go to university.
items.why: If + past → would probably: ehtimoli kamroq harakat, taxminan 75% ishonch.

items.s: If the council will open more nurseries, more mothers will return to work.
items.fix: If the council opens more nurseries, more mothers will return to work.
items.why: If-qismida 'will' ishlatilmaydi: If + present, ... will.

items.s: Without regular maintenance, old buses may become unsafe.
items.why: Without + ot → may: qarama-qarshilik argumenti, taxminan 50% ishonch.

items.s: Exam season puts pressure to final-year students.
items.fix: Exam season puts pressure on final-year students.
items.why: Birikma: put pressure ON somebody.

items.s: More importantly, regular sport teaches children how to work in a team.
items.why: More importantly — sababni kuchaytiruvchi urg'u; gap to'g'ri.

items.s: The number of applicants exceeds than the number of places.
items.fix: The number of applicants exceeds the number of places.
items.why: 'exceed' o'timli fe'l — undan keyin 'than' kerak emas.

items.s: Building one new hospital will solve all the health problems in the region.
items.fix: Building one new hospital could reduce the health problems in the region.
items.why: Asossiz 100% bashorat; ehtiyotkor modal kerak (could reduce).

items.s: Closing village schools can result in long journeys, which is likely to reduce attendance.
items.why: result in + 'which is likely to' — zanjir va ishonch darajasi to'g'ri.

items.s: Many sports injuries are result from skipping the warm-up.
items.fix: Many sports injuries result from skipping the warm-up.
items.why: 'result from' — fe'l; 'are' ortiqcha (yoki: are the result of).

26.title: Board Game: four ways to build an argument
26.stage: 27-dars boshida yoki shu dars oxirida 26-dars takrori sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
26.goal: To'rt argument turini (+, →, If/When bashorat, If ... not / Without) tanish va og'zaki qo'llash; sabab-natijani aylantirish, ishonch darajasini tanlash, 'it' xatosini tuzatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: argument turini aytadi, gapni aylantiradi, tuzatadi yoki 30–40 soniya gapiradi.
'Talk' kataklarida kamida bitta zanjir (→) yoki bashorat (If / When + modal) ishlatilishi shart.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi (javoblar varag'i guruh sardorida). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name the four argument types from this lesson.
squares.a: Addition (+), cause and effect (→), predicting results (If/When), opposite (If … not / Without)

squares.t: Which symbol means 'cause and effect' in an essay plan?
squares.a: → (an arrow)

squares.t: Give two linkers for adding reasons.
squares.a: e.g. Firstly, In addition, Similarly, also

squares.t: Say a phrase that makes a reason sound stronger.
squares.a: More importantly / Even more importantly / What is more

squares.t: Rewrite with 'result in': 'Cheap fuel causes more traffic.'
squares.a: Cheap fuel results in more traffic.

squares.t: Rewrite with 'result from': 'Stress can cause headaches.'
squares.a: Headaches can result from stress.

squares.t: How sure are you with 'will', 'is likely to' and 'may'?
squares.a: about 100% / about 75% / about 50%

squares.t: Correct: 'If taxes will rise, people will spend less.'
squares.a: If taxes rise, people will spend less.

squares.t: Finish the chain: cheaper bus fares → more passengers → … → …
squares.a: e.g. → fewer cars on the road → less congestion

squares.t: Make it less certain: 'This will end unemployment.'
squares.a: e.g. This could reduce unemployment in the region.

squares.t: Use 'Without': why should cities fund sports centres?
squares.a: e.g. Without sports centres, many teenagers may spend all day indoors.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how does traffic affect your city? Use 'in turn'.
squares.a: e.g. Traffic slows buses, which in turn makes people late for work.

squares.t: Which action is more certain to happen: 'When + present' or 'If + past'?
squares.a: When + present — it happens regularly.

squares.t: Use 'If … not …, then …' about recycling.
squares.a: e.g. If people do not recycle, then cities will need more landfill sites.

squares.t: Why is 'In addition, it means…' risky at the end of a paragraph?
squares.a: 'It' points to the last noun, which may not be the idea you mean.

squares.t: Paraphrase 'a lack of housing' to refer back to it.
squares.a: e.g. this shortage of homes / the housing problem

squares.t: Say a sentence with 'a knock-on effect' about tourism.
squares.a: e.g. A tourism boom creates hotel jobs, which has a knock-on effect on local shops.

squares.t: Rewrite with 'the result of': 'Noise often causes poor sleep.'
squares.a: Poor sleep is often the result of noise.

squares.t: Which type? 'Without subsidies, many farmers could lose their land.'
squares.a: Opposite (Without … → negative result)

squares.t: Why should you mix long and short sentences?
squares.a: The text is easier to read and less repetitive.

squares.t: Use 'exacerbate' in a sentence about rising prices.
squares.a: e.g. Rising food prices exacerbate poverty in rural areas.

squares.t: Should the state step in to control rents? Give a → chain.
squares.a: e.g. Yes: high rents → families move out → workers are harder to find.

squares.t: Combine + and →: why should schools serve free lunches?
squares.a: e.g. Pupils eat better, which in turn improves focus. What is more, parents save money.

squares.t: Talk for 40 seconds: should cars be banned from city centres? Use 3 argument types.
squares.a: e.g. a clear position + an addition (+), a → chain and an If/Without result

26.title: Dominoes: turn cause and effect around
26.stage: 'Birlashtirish, referencing' bosqichida, 4-mashq bilan birga (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
26.goal: Bir sabab-natija fikrini turli tuzilmada ifodalash: cause / lead to / result in ↔ be caused by / result from / be the result of / as a result of — ma'no o'zgarmasligini tekshirish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap qaysi toshning chap tomonida BOSHQA tuzilma bilan, lekin AYNAN shu ma'noda yozilganini toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh har juftni o'qiydi va qaysi qism SABAB, qaysi qism NATIJA ekanini aytadi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: Heavy rain often causes floods in spring.
Spring floods are often the result of heavy rain.
Too much screen time can lead to poor sleep.
Poor sleep can result from too much screen time.
Poor planning often leads to exam stress.
Exam stress often results from poor planning.
The new metro line has cut journey times.
Journeys are shorter as a result of the new line.
Soil erosion is caused by the loss of forests.
Online shopping reduces sales in local shops.
Local shops sell less as people buy online.
High fuel prices put pressure on taxi drivers.
Taxi drivers struggle because fuel is so expensive.
Many jobs in Samarkand are the result of tourism.
Cheap fast food contributes to obesity.
Obesity is partly caused by cheap fast food.
Traffic noise can result in poor concentration.
Poor concentration can be caused by traffic noise.
Poverty gets worse when food prices rise.
Regular exercise leads to better mental health.
Better mental health results from regular exercise.
Good street lighting reduces crime at night.
Night crime falls where streets are well lit.
Migration to cities leaves many villages empty.
Many villages are empty because people move to cities.

26.title: Taboo: cause, effect and consequences
26.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' dan keyin sabab-oqibat so'zlari uchun (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
26.goal: Sabab-oqibat va urg'u iboralarini (lead to, in turn, be likely to, exceed, put pressure on, step in, knock-on effect, exacerbate, provided that) va essay mavzusidagi so'zlarni inglizcha tushuntira olish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'z yoki iborani o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — uning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Tushuntirishda kichik sabab-oqibat misolini (A → B) keltirgan o'quvchiga ustoz +1 bonus berishi mumkin.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

26.title: Find someone who… would use the bus if it were free
26.stage: 'Natijani bashorat qilish' (3.3) bosqichidan keyin, harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
26.goal: Sabab-oqibat va bashorat mavzusida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Would you … if …? Do you … when …? Have you ever … because of …?) va javobni zanjir (→) bilan kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Would you use the bus every day if it were free?). If-gapda 'will' ishlatilmaydi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va 'What would happen then?' deb so'raydi: javob kamida 2 bo'g'inli zanjir bo'lishi kerak (A → B → C).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq zanjirni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …would use the bus every day if it were free.
items.q: Would you use the bus every day if it were free?

items.t: …gets stressed when he/she has too much homework.
items.q: Do you get stressed when you have too much homework?

items.t: …has been late because of a traffic jam this month.
items.q: Have you been late because of a traffic jam this month?

items.t: …thinks rents in Tashkent are likely to rise next year.
items.q: Do you think rents in Tashkent are likely to rise next year?

items.t: …sleeps badly if he/she uses a phone late at night.
items.q: Do you sleep badly if you use your phone late at night?

items.t: …would move to another city if he/she got a good job offer.
items.q: Would you move to another city if you got a good job offer?

items.t: …has changed a habit because of its effect on his/her health.
items.q: Have you ever changed a habit because of its effect on your health?

items.t: …thinks life in villages will change a lot in the next ten years.
items.q: Do you think life in villages will change a lot in the next ten years?

items.t: …would find it hard to study without the internet.
items.q: Would you find it hard to study without the internet?

items.t: …feels more productive when he/she exercises in the morning.
items.q: Do you feel more productive when you exercise in the morning?

items.t: …has seen a new road or metro line change his/her area.
items.q: Have you seen a new road or metro line change your area?

items.t: …would support higher taxes if they paid for free transport.
items.q: Would you support higher taxes if they paid for free transport?

26.title: Speaking cards: causes, effects and predictions
26.stage: 'Qarama-qarshilik' (4.1) bosqichida yoki mini-yozuvdan oldin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
26.goal: Speaking Part 1/3 savollariga sabab-oqibat zanjiri, ehtiyotkor bashorat (will / is likely to / may) va 'Without ...' bilan kengaytirilgan javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–5 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 2 xil argument turini ishlatadi (masalan: → zanjir + If/Without natijasi).
Savol bergan o'quvchi 'examiner' bo'ladi: zanjir bormi? +1; ishonch darajasi to'g'ri tanlanganmi (will / is likely to / may)? +1; 'More importantly' yoki 'in turn' bormi? +1.
Har natijaga 'will' deyilsa — ball berilmaydi: ishonch asosli bo'lishi kerak.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: What causes traffic jams in your city, and what effects do they have?
How would your daily life change if public transport were free?
Why do many young people move from villages to big cities? What are the effects?
What might happen to small shops if online shopping keeps growing?
Should the government step in when rents rise too quickly? Why?
How does a lack of sleep affect students' results? Describe the chain.
If schools banned phones completely, would pupils learn more? Why?
What would happen to your city without parks and green spaces?
Do the benefits of tourism outweigh its problems in Samarkand or Bukhara?
How can one bad habit have a knock-on effect on the rest of your day?
Is technology likely to create more jobs than it destroys? Why?
What happens to a family when both parents work very long hours?
Which is more important for health: diet or exercise? Give reasons.
What will cities look like in 30 years? How sure are you?

26.title: Sentence Race: chains, predictions and 'Without'
26.stage: 'Namuna essay tahlili' dan keyin, mini-yozuvdan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
26.goal: To'rt argument turini ko'rsatadigan gaplarni (in turn, If + past → would, Without ..., More importantly, result in / result from, provided that) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzib yig'ish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf, vergul va nuqta tartibga yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball. Argument turini (+, →, bashorat, qarama-qarshilik) to'g'ri aytsa — yana +1. Keyin keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: This, in turn, reduces the number of road accidents.
If parking were more expensive, more people would take the metro.
Without a bus service, many villagers may struggle to reach work.
More importantly, cheaper housing would keep young families in the city.
Junk food can lead to obesity, which puts pressure on hospitals.
When winters are colder, heating bills tend to rise.
Many health problems are the result of an inactive lifestyle.
If people do not recycle, landfill sites will keep growing.
In addition, this shortage of teachers means that classes remain large.
This policy could reduce street crime, provided that the police support it.

26.title: Quiz Board: argument types and confidence
26.stage: Dars oxirida, uyga vazifadan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
26.goal: Argument turlarini tanish, ishonch darajasini (will / is likely to / may) tanlash, sabab-natijani aylantirish, 'it' xatosini tuzatish va og'zaki murakkab argument aytishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Turn it around 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar — namuna: kerakli ibora to'g'ri ishlatilgan va mantiq aniq bo'lsa, boshqa variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Which argument type uses 'Firstly' and 'In addition'?
Which symbol shows cause and effect in an essay plan?
Which type? 'Without vaccines, some diseases may spread faster.'
Which type? 'If rents fell, more graduates would stay in the city.'
Which type? 'Shops closed, which in turn left the high street empty.'
How sure is 'will'?
How sure are 'may', 'might' and 'could'?
Which action is more likely: 'If + present' or 'If + past'?
Make it more careful: 'This will solve all traffic problems.'
qs.a: e.g. This could significantly reduce traffic.

qs.q: What does 'When + present' show about an action?
What is the opposite direction of 'result in'?
Rewrite with 'lead to': 'Stress is often caused by debt.'
Rewrite with 'result from': 'Pollution can cause asthma.'
Fix: 'Long commutes can lead to feel tired.'
qs.a: Long commutes can lead to tiredness / to feeling tired.

qs.q: Fix the reference: 'Fuel prices rose. This pushed up the cost of bread. In addition, it hurt farmers.'
qs.a: Replace 'it' with a paraphrase, e.g. 'the rise in fuel prices'.

qs.q: Use 'as a result' about heavy snow.
qs.a: e.g. It snowed heavily. As a result, many schools closed.

qs.q: Use 'more importantly' about learning to cook.
qs.a: e.g. It saves money. More importantly, it keeps you healthy.

qs.q: Make a three-step chain about fewer cars in the city.
qs.a: e.g. Fewer cars → less noise → better sleep for residents.

qs.q: Use 'Without …' about school sports clubs.
qs.a: e.g. Without sports clubs, many pupils may get little exercise.

qs.q: Use 'is likely to': what would a new metro line do for your city?
qs.a: e.g. A new metro line is likely to reduce traffic in the centre.

27.title: Language Auction: explaining and supporting ideas
27.stage: 'Boshqa usullar (6.3)' dan keyin, namuna essay tahlilidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: Tushuntirish va dalil gaplarida Band 5–6 xatolarini topish va tuzatish: in other words, evidence (sanalmaydi), tend to + fe'l, relevant to, rents mean, 'all' bilan haddan tashqari umumlashtirish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Bu gaplar — essaydagi ta'rif, kontekst, cheklangan fikr va dalil gaplari. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.

Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart (ro'yxatni o'quvchilarga oldindan aytmang): in other word, evidences, tend to + -ing, relevant with, rents means yoki 'all' bilan umumlashtirish.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: By success, I mean having work you enjoy and time for your family.
items.why: Ta'rif: By X, I mean + ot/-ing — kalit atama aniqlashtirilgan.

items.s: In other word, most young families cannot afford a flat in the capital.
items.fix: In other words, most young families cannot afford a flat in the capital.
items.why: Doimiy ibora: in other words (ko'plikda).

items.s: Living alone can be stressful for some young people.
items.why: Modal (can) + cheklov (for some) — fikr hamma uchun emas, aniq va ehtiyotkor.

items.s: This claim is not supported by any evidences.
items.fix: This claim is not supported by any evidence.
items.why: evidence — sanalmaydigan ot: -s olmaydi.

items.s: In Uzbekistan, where many families live with grandparents, childcare is often shared.
items.why: Perspektiva: In my country, where ... — examinerga kontekst berilgan.

items.s: Young adults tend to buying expensive phones on credit.
items.fix: Young adults tend to buy expensive phones on credit.
items.why: tend to + fe'lning oddiy shakli (buy), -ing emas.

items.s: Many pensioners cannot use banking apps. Thus, banks should keep some local branches open.
items.why: Dalil → Thus, xulosa: xulosa dalildan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelib chiqadi.

items.s: Every example in your essay should be relevant with the main idea.
items.fix: Every example in your essay should be relevant to the main idea.
items.why: relevant + to (with emas).

items.s: Rising rents means that many young couples cannot move out.
items.fix: Rising rents mean that many young couples cannot move out.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (rents) → mean; bu yerda 'mean' natijani (→) bildiradi.

items.s: To illustrate this, consider the number of students who now work part-time.
items.why: To illustrate this — umumiy fikrdan keyin aniq holat (dalil) kiritiladi.

items.s: Living in a big city makes all young people more ambitious.
items.fix: Living in a big city makes many young people more ambitious.
items.why: 'all' — haddan tashqari umumlashtirish; hamma uchun to'g'ri emas, cheklov kerak (many).

items.s: This is particularly true in fast-growing cities such as Tashkent.
items.why: this is particularly true in + joy — fikr qayerda to'g'ri ekani ko'rsatilgan.

27.title: Board Game: explain it, prove it
27.stage: 28-dars boshida — 27-dars takrori sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: Fakt va fikrni ajratish, fikrni modal/cheklov bilan yumshatish, kontekst va ta'rif berish, In other words / Thus / For example ni to'g'ri ishlatish va Band 6 misol xatolarini og'zaki topish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni inglizcha bajaradi: to'liq gap aytadi yoki xato turini nomlaydi (invented statistic, repetition, trivial example).
'Talk for … seconds' kataklarida o'yinchi kamida bitta haqiqiy, aniq misol keltiradi — to'qilgan foiz yoki raqam aytilsa, javob qabul qilinmaydi.
Guruh javobni ustozdagi javoblar varag'i bilan tekshiradi ('e.g.' — namuna, boshqa to'g'ri javob ham bo'ladi). Javob noto'g'ri bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Fact or opinion? 'Samarkand has more hotels than it did ten years ago.'
squares.a: Fact — it can be checked (verified) with official figures.

squares.t: Fact or opinion? 'Online lessons are boring.'
squares.a: Opinion — it can only be discussed, not checked.

squares.t: Soften it: 'Social media makes teenagers unhappy.'
squares.a: e.g. Social media can make some teenagers feel unhappy.

squares.t: Define a key term: 'By a good school, I mean …'
squares.a: e.g. By a good school, I mean one with caring, well-qualified teachers.

squares.t: Give context about families. Start with 'In my country, where …'
squares.a: e.g. In my country, where families are large, grandparents often help with childcare.

squares.t: 'Bread prices have risen. This means that families spend more on food.' = or →?
squares.a: → (result): the second sentence is a consequence of the first.

squares.t: Rephrase with 'In other words': 'Many villages lack doctors.'
squares.a: e.g. In other words, people in rural areas have poor access to healthcare.

squares.t: What does 'jump to a conclusion' mean? Give a quick example.
squares.a: To decide too fast without evidence, e.g. 'He failed once, so he is lazy.'

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: Is living alone good for young people?
squares.a: e.g. It can build independence; for instance, you learn to cook and budget.

squares.t: Name the problem: 'For example, 83% of students hate homework.'
squares.a: Invented statistic — it sounds made up and destroys trust.

squares.t: Name the problem: 'Parks are useful. For example, people can use parks.'
squares.a: Not an example — it only repeats the idea in other words.

squares.t: Name the problem: 'My phone broke once, so smartphones are useless.'
squares.a: Trivial example → huge conclusion (overgeneralising).

squares.t: Evidence first, then the general idea. Which linker joins them?
squares.a: Thus, … (evidence → Thus, general conclusion)

squares.t: General idea first, then a specific case. Which linker?
squares.a: For example, … / For instance, …

squares.t: Add a conclusion with 'Thus': 'Many students have part-time jobs.'
squares.a: e.g. Thus, universities should offer more evening and online classes.

squares.t: Say a sentence with 'tend to': young people / shopping online
squares.a: e.g. Young people tend to shop online more than their parents.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: explain your city's biggest problem to a foreign examiner.
squares.a: e.g. In Tashkent, where many people drive to work, traffic jams are common.

squares.t: What does 'go off on a tangent' mean in an essay?
squares.a: To drift away from the question and write about something irrelevant.

squares.t: Complete: 'By a healthy lifestyle, I mean …'
squares.a: e.g. … eating well, sleeping enough and exercising regularly.

squares.t: Which is stronger: a made-up statistic or a familiar local example? Why?
squares.a: A familiar, relevant example — readers can check it and it proves the idea.

squares.t: The question says 'travel'; an essay discusses only cars. What went wrong?
squares.a: The writer misread the question; part of it is ignored, so Task Response falls.

squares.t: Band 7 vs Band 8: how are the main ideas different?
squares.a: Band 8: relevant, extended and supported; Band 7: may overgeneralise, or support may lack focus.

squares.t: Replace the fake number: 'Sport helps teens. 64% of athletes get top marks.'
squares.a: e.g. For instance, team sports teach teenagers discipline and time management.

squares.t: Talk for 40 seconds: Should schools teach money management? Give one real example.
squares.a: e.g. Yes; for instance, many young people pay in instalments without reading contracts.

27.title: Dominoes: general idea and specific evidence
27.stage: 'Boshqa usullar (6.3)' bosqichida, 4-mashqdan oldin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: Umumiy g'oyani (doira) uni isbotlaydigan aniq dalil (to'rtburchak) bilan ulash: dalil fikrga bevosita bog'liq, aniq va dolzarb bo'lishi kerak.
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi umumiy g'oya (claim) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi aniq dalilga mos kelishini toping.
Har ulashda guruh ovoz chiqarib 'Claim. For example, evidence.' shaklida gapni aytadi va dalil g'oyani haqiqatan isbotlayaptimi — tekshiradi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.
Bonus: ikki juftlikni teskari tartibda — 'Evidence. Thus, claim.' — qayta aytgan guruh +1 ball oladi.

pairs: Air pollution can harm children's health.
More children near busy roads suffer from asthma.
In football, nobody wins a match alone.
In many Uzbek homes, grandmothers look after toddlers.
Sea turtles often swallow plastic bags.
Visitors to Rishtan watch potters at work.
Online courses can widen access to education.
Village pupils can join lectures by top professors.
Pupils without home internet can study there for free.
Rising rents can push workers out of city centres.
Many staff now commute from distant suburbs.
Reading for pleasure can build vocabulary.
Readers meet new words in context every day.
Mobile banking can be risky for older people.
Scammers often phone pensioners asking for card codes.
Local markets can keep traditions alive.
At Chorsu Bazaar, bread is still baked in clay ovens.
Social media can spread false information.
Fake health tips often go viral on Telegram.
Learning to cook can save money.
Home-made lunches cost far less than café meals.

27.title: Taboo: evidence and explanation words
27.stage: 'Misollar: uch xato (6.1–6.2)' dan keyin — lug'atni mustahkamlash (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: Tushuntirish va dalil lug'atini (evidence, claim, context, perspective, verify, overgeneralise, go off on a tangent …) inglizcha ta'riflab berish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Darsdagi usullardan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi: 'It means …', 'In other words …', 'For example, in an essay …'.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

27.title: Find someone who… has checked the facts
27.stage: 'Shoshilinch xulosa (5.3)' dan keyin, harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: Present perfect va 'Do you tend to …?' savollarini tuzish; 'Yes' javobidan keyin aniq dalil so'rash (When? What happened?) — fikrni misol bilan asoslash odatini shakllantirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever checked a news story before sharing it?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta DALIL savolini beradi: 'When was that? What exactly happened?' — javob aniq holat bo'lishi kerak.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni 'For instance, …' bilan sinfga aytib beradi.

items.q: Have you ever jumped to a conclusion about someone and been wrong?

items.t: …has read a news story that turned out to be fake.
items.q: Have you ever read a news story that turned out to be fake?

items.t: …has checked a statistic that seemed too good to be true.
items.q: Have you ever checked a statistic that seemed too good to be true?

items.t: …has used statistics in a school presentation.
items.q: Have you ever used statistics in a school presentation?

items.t: …has had to explain a word to a younger brother or sister.
items.q: Have you ever had to explain a word to a younger brother or sister?

items.t: …has written an essay that went off on a tangent.
items.q: Have you ever written an essay that went off on a tangent?

items.t: …tends to read reviews before buying something online.
items.q: Do you tend to read reviews before buying something online?

items.t: …has been misunderstood because the listener lacked context.

items.q: Have you ever argued with a friend about what success means?

27.title: Speaking cards: facts, opinions and evidence
27.stage: 'Mini-yozuv'dan oldin — og'zaki isitish sifatida (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga javobda fikrni kontekst, ta'rif va aniq misol bilan asoslash (In my country, where … / By …, I mean … / For instance …).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–5 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + tushuntirish (In other words / This means) + bitta haqiqiy misol (For instance …).
Tinglovchi tekshiradi: misol haqiqiy va aniqmi yoki to'qilgan raqam / takrormi? Haqiqiy misol +2 ball, ta'rif yoki kontekst iborasi +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

27.goal: Ta'rif, perspektiva, cheklangan fikr, In other words, Thus va For instance gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.

27.goal: Tushuntirish qoidalari, dalil lug'ati, tipik xatolar va og'zaki ta'rif / qayta aytish / kontekst berishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fix the error 300').

qs.q: Fact or opinion: 'Bukhara is the most beautiful city in Uzbekistan.'
Which linker comes after the evidence to give the general conclusion?

qs.q: Information that shows a claim is true (noun).
To check that something is true (verb).
Background facts: where, when and for whom.
To say something is true of all cases after seeing only a few (verb).

qs.a: e.g. Too much gaming can make some children less active.

qs.q: Define 'a good teacher' with 'By …, I mean …'.
qs.a: e.g. By a good teacher, I mean someone patient and clear.

qs.q: Soften it: 'Online shopping is dangerous.'
qs.a: e.g. Online shopping can be risky for some users.

qs.q: Evidence → Thus: 'Many pupils cannot swim.' Add the conclusion.
qs.a: e.g. Thus, schools should offer swimming lessons.

qs.q: Rephrase with 'In other words': 'City buses are overcrowded.'
qs.a: e.g. In other words, there are too many passengers for too few buses.

qs.q: Give context about your city: 'In …, where …, …'.
qs.a: e.g. In Tashkent, where rents are high, many students share flats.

28.title: Language Auction: concede and refute
28.stage: 'Concede va refute tili (7.2)' dan keyin, Band 6.5 muammolaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Concede va refute gaplarida Band 5–6 xatolarini topish va tuzatish: Admittedly that, Although … but, outweigh than, some truth on, not necessary, 'It is thought that' — qarshi fikrni aniq odamlarga biriktirish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Bu gaplar — counterargument xatboshisidan olingan tan olish (concede) va rad etish (refute) gaplari. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.

Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart (ro'yxatni o'quvchilarga oldindan aytmang): Admittedly that, Although … but, outweigh than, truth on, not necessary yoki 'It is thought' (kimning fikri?).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Admittedly that school uniforms can be expensive for large families.
items.fix: Admittedly, school uniforms can be expensive for large families.
items.why: Admittedly + vergul + gap; 'that' faqat 'It is true that' dan keyin keladi.

items.s: Critics of zoos claim that animals suffer in small enclosures.
items.why: Qarshi fikr aniq guruhga (critics of zoos) biriktirilgan.

items.s: Although cars are convenient, but they pollute city air.
items.fix: Although cars are convenient, they pollute city air.
items.why: Although bilan 'but' birga ishlatilmaydi — bitta bog'lovchi yetarli.

items.s: It is true that some remote workers feel isolated at home.
items.why: Concede: It is true that + to'liq gap — qarshi fikrning to'g'ri qismi tan olingan.

items.s: The benefits of cycle lanes clearly outweigh than the costs.
items.fix: The benefits of cycle lanes clearly outweigh the costs.
items.why: outweigh — o'timli fe'l: 'than' olmaydi.

items.s: Having said that, a ban on phones would be almost impossible to enforce.
items.why: Refute: Having said that + sabab — qarshi fikr nega ishontirmasligi ko'rsatilgan.

items.s: There is some truth on this claim, but it ignores the wider benefits.
items.fix: There is some truth in this claim, but it ignores the wider benefits.
items.why: Doimiy ibora: there is some truth IN … (on emas).

items.s: A higher salary does not necessary mean a happier life.
items.fix: A higher salary does not necessarily mean a happier life.
items.why: Fe'lni ravish aniqlaydi: necessarily (necessary — sifat).

items.s: It is thought that exams cause unnecessary stress.
items.fix: Some people argue that exams cause unnecessary stress.
items.why: Grammatik to'g'ri, lekin kimning fikri noma'lum: qarshi fikrni odamlarga biriktiring (Some people argue).

items.s: This is an argument against badly run zoos, not against zoos themselves.
items.why: Refute: muammo g'oyaning o'zida emas, uning yomon bajarilishida.

items.s: I concede that some tests are badly designed; nevertheless, they remain a fair way to compare students.
items.why: Concede (I concede that) + refute (nevertheless) + sabab — pozitsiya aniq.

items.s: While online learning can feel isolating, it gives village students access to top teachers.
items.why: While + qarshi fikr, asosiy gap — yozuvchi pozitsiyasi: concede va refute bir gapda.

28.title: Board Game: concede, refute, decide
28.stage: 29-dars boshida — 28-dars takrori sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Counterargument qismlarini (position, concede, refute) og'zaki ajratish, savol turiga qarab yondashuvni (A/B/C) tanlash va concede / refute iboralari bilan gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni inglizcha bajaradi: to'liq gap aytadi yoki qisqa sabab bilan javob beradi.
'Talk for … seconds' kataklarida o'yinchi qarshi fikrni albatta boshqalarga biriktiradi (Some people argue …) va uni rad etadi (Having said that / Nevertheless + sabab).
Guruh javobni ustozdagi javoblar varag'i bilan tekshiradi ('e.g.' — namuna, boshqa to'g'ri javob ham bo'ladi). Javob noto'g'ri bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: What is a counterargument? Explain in one sentence.
squares.a: An opposing view that other people might hold against your position.

squares.t: Concede or refute? 'It is true that uniforms cost money.'
squares.a: Concede — it admits that part of the opposing view is true.

squares.t: Concede or refute? 'However, uniforms save money in the long run.'
squares.a: Refute — it shows why the opposing view is weak.

squares.t: Say two verbs that mean 'admit that something is true'.
squares.a: concede, acknowledge (also: accept, grant)

squares.t: Say three phrases for conceding.
squares.a: Admittedly, … / It is true that … / I concede that … / There is some truth in …

squares.t: Say three phrases for refuting.
squares.a: Having said that, … / Nevertheless, … / However, …

squares.t: Which question type lets you choose approach A, B or C?
squares.a: To what extent do you agree or disagree? (GT: Do you agree or disagree?)

squares.t: 'Discuss both views and give your opinion.' Can you write about one side only?
squares.a: No — both views must be discussed, plus your own opinion.

squares.t: Attribute the view to people: 'It is thought that zoos are cruel.'
squares.a: e.g. Critics of zoos claim that they are cruel.

squares.t: What must come right after a refuting linker?
squares.a: A reason — why the opposing view does not convince you.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: Should phones be banned in schools? Concede one point.
squares.a: e.g. Admittedly, phones distract some pupils. Nevertheless, they are useful for research.

squares.t: Which approach does the book call the safest route to Band 7?
squares.a: A — discuss both sides, then reach a conclusion.

squares.t: What is the main risk of approach B (your side only)?
squares.a: Ignoring part of the question and repeating the same ideas.

squares.t: The writer supports uniforms: 'In contrast, uniforms are unfair.' Why is it weak?
squares.a: It sounds like the writer's own view, so the position becomes unclear.

squares.t: Give an opposing view: 'University education should be free for all.'
squares.a: e.g. Critics claim that free universities would cost taxpayers too much.

squares.t: Now refute it: 'Free universities cost taxpayers too much.'
squares.a: e.g. However, graduates earn more and pay more tax over their careers.

squares.t: Refute 'Free buses cost too much': 'This argument overlooks the fact that …'
squares.a: e.g. … fewer cars mean cleaner air and lower road-repair costs.

squares.t: Where should a counterargument paragraph end?
squares.a: With the writer's own position — the last word is yours.

squares.t: Use 'an argument against X, not against Y' about exams.
squares.a: e.g. Stress is an argument against badly designed exams, not against exams.

squares.t: 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' What must you cover?
squares.a: Both advantages and disadvantages, then say which is greater.

squares.t: Should every body paragraph include a counterargument? Why?
squares.a: No — only where it strengthens your argument; mechanical use repeats ideas.

squares.t: Complete: 'There is some truth in this view, but …' (view: games waste time)
squares.a: e.g. … moderate gaming can also improve problem-solving skills.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: Is working from home positive or negative? Cover both sides.
squares.a: e.g. It saves travel time; admittedly, it can be lonely, but video calls help.

squares.t: Talk for 40 seconds: Should energy drinks be banned for teenagers? Concede + refute.
squares.a: e.g. It is true that a ban limits choice; nevertheless, teenagers' health matters more.

28.title: Dominoes: concede and refute
28.stage: 'Concede va refute tili (7.2)' bosqichida, 2-mashqdan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Qarshi fikrni tan olish qismini (Admittedly / It is true that / Critics claim / Although) uning mantiqiy rad etilishi (however / nevertheless / yet + sabab) bilan ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi qarshi fikr (concede) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi rad etishga (refute) mos kelishini toping — mavzu ham, grammatika ham mos bo'lishi shart.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib. Bonus: istalgan juftlikka 'Thus, I believe that …' bilan pozitsiya gapini qo'shgan guruh +1 ball oladi.

pairs: Admittedly, cycle lanes take space from cars;
however, safe cycle routes reduce traffic overall.
It is true that exams can be stressful;
nevertheless, exams reward steady, regular study.
Critics claim that zoos are cruel to animals,
yet modern zoos protect many endangered species.
Some argue that uniforms limit self-expression;
however, uniforms stop pupils competing over brands.
Opponents of a sugar tax say it hurts the poor,
yet poorer families gain most from healthier diets.
it cannot replace advice from real shop staff.
While tourism can raise local prices,
it also creates jobs for village guides and cooks.
There is some truth in the idea that games waste time,
but some video games develop problem-solving skills.
Critics claim that AI tools make students lazy;
however, AI can explain hard topics step by step.
Opponents of a four-day week fear lower output;
in fact, rested employees often work more efficiently.
Admittedly, free public transport is costly;
nevertheless, free buses help the low-paid get to work.
Opponents of homework say children need rest,
yet one short daily task leaves plenty of time to play.
