Critics say space research wastes public money;
however, space research has improved weather forecasts.
Admittedly, a third language adds to pupils' workload;
however, multilingual graduates find jobs more easily.

28.title: Taboo: argument words
28.stage: 'Band 6.5 muammolari (7.3)' dan keyin — lug'atni mustahkamlash (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Counterargument lug'atini (concede, refute, acknowledge, opposing view, valid, outweigh, abolish, contradict …) inglizcha ta'riflab berish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Tushuntirishda essaydan misol berish mumkin: 'In an essay, you use this word when …'.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

28.title: Find someone who… has changed his or her mind
28.stage: 'Counterargument nima? (7.1)' dan keyin, harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Present perfect, 'Do you think / believe …?' va 'Would you …?' savollarini tuzish; 'Yes' javobidan keyin qarshi fikrni so'rash (What would someone who disagrees say?).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever taken part in a debate competition?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va qarshi fikr savolini beradi: 'What would someone who disagrees with you say?'
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va bitta javobni 'Some people argue that …, but …' shaklida sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has changed his/her mind after hearing the other side of an argument.
items.q: Have you ever changed your mind after hearing the other side of an argument?

items.t: …has taken part in a debate competition.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in a debate competition?

items.t: …has persuaded a parent to change a decision.
items.q: Have you ever persuaded one of your parents to change a decision?

items.t: …finds it easy to admit that he/she is wrong.
items.q: Do you find it easy to admit that you are wrong?

items.t: …has argued against a popular opinion in class.
items.q: Have you ever argued against a popular opinion in class?

items.t: …has turned down an offer after weighing up the pros and cons.
items.q: Have you ever turned down an offer after weighing up the pros and cons?

items.t: …thinks homework should be abolished.
items.q: Do you think homework should be abolished?

items.t: …has written an online review of a product or a café.
items.q: Have you ever written an online review of a product or a café?

items.t: …has had to defend a decision to his/her family.
items.q: Have you ever had to defend a decision to your family?

items.t: …believes the benefits of social media outweigh the drawbacks.
items.q: Do you believe the benefits of social media outweigh the drawbacks?

items.t: …has played devil's advocate in a discussion.
items.q: Have you ever played devil's advocate in a discussion?

items.t: …would move abroad for a better-paid job.
items.q: Would you move abroad for a better-paid job?

28.title: Speaking cards: both sides of the argument
28.stage: 'Namuna essay tahlili'dan keyin — og'zaki concede + refute mashqi (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga javobda qarshi fikrni tan olish va rad etish (Admittedly … / Having said that …) hamda pozitsiyani oxirigacha aniq saqlash.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 4–5 gap bilan javob beradi: pozitsiya → qarshi fikr (Some people argue …) → tan olish → rad etish + sabab → pozitsiyaga qaytish.
Tinglovchi ball beradi: qarshi fikr odamlarga biriktirilsa +1, rad etishdan keyin sabab aytilsa +1, oxirgi gap javob beruvchining pozitsiyasi bo'lsa +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy discussing topics with people who disagree with you? Why?
When did you last change your mind about something important?
Is admitting that the other side has a point a sign of weakness or strength?
Should schools teach students how to debate? Why or why not?
Why do people on social media rarely listen to opposing views?
Some say homework should be abolished. What would opponents of this idea say?
Do the benefits of working from home outweigh the drawbacks? Consider both sides.
How do you usually persuade your parents to agree with you?
Is it ever right to refuse to listen to the other side of an argument?
Should fast-food adverts be banned on TV? Mention one opposing view.
What makes an argument convincing: facts, emotions or personal experience?
Why do some people find it hard to say 'I was wrong'?
Should cars be banned from city centres? Present both sides.
Do older and younger generations argue in different ways? How?
Describe a decision you made even though others disagreed with it.
Should university education be free for everyone? What might critics say?

28.title: Sentence Race: concede and refute
28.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa'dan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Qarshi fikrni biriktirish, tan olish, rad etish va pozitsiya gaplarida (Opponents of …, Admittedly, Having said that, This argument overlooks …) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf va tinish belgilari yordam beradi.

Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball; gap turini (C — qarshi fikr, CON — tan olish, R — rad etish, P — pozitsiya) to'g'ri aytsa yana +1 ball (Although / There is some truth … but gaplarida ikkala qism bor: CON + R).
Keyingi konvert beriladi. Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Admittedly, some pupils find long tasks tiring.
Opponents of the ban claim that it would be impossible to enforce.
Having said that, most of these problems can be solved cheaply.
There is some truth in this argument, but it overlooks the costs.
This argument overlooks the fact that many families cannot afford tutors.
Although tourism raises prices, it creates jobs for local people.
Longer school days do not necessarily mean better results.
Nevertheless, I believe that city centres should be closed to cars.
It is true that exams put a lot of pressure on students.
Some people argue that zoos are cruel to animals.

28.title: Quiz Board: counterarguments
28.stage: Dars oxirida umumiy takror (vaqt qolsa) yoki keyingi takror darsida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Savol turi va yondashuv (A/B/C), concede va refute farqi, tipik xatolar va og'zaki counterargument tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Concede or refute? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' savollarida namunadan boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Which question type lets you choose approach A, B or C?
qs.a: To what extent do you agree or disagree?

qs.q: 'Discuss both views and give your own opinion': what must you cover?
Which approach does the author call the safest route to Band 7?
qs.a: Approach A: both sides, then a conclusion

qs.q: 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' One side or both?
qs.a: Both sides, then say which is greater

qs.q: Describe approach C in one sentence.
qs.a: Your side + an opposing view that you then refute

qs.q: 'Admittedly, uniforms cost money.'
'Nevertheless, uniforms reduce pressure to buy brands.'
'There is some truth in this view …'
'This argument overlooks the fact that …'
'Critics claim that uniforms are unfair.' Concede, refute or neither?
qs.a: Neither: it presents the counterargument itself

qs.q: Some people argues that zoos are cruel.
qs.a: Some people argue that zoos are cruel.

qs.q: Although it is cheap, but it is slow.
qs.a: Although it is cheap, it is slow.

qs.q: The benefits outweigh than the costs.
Having saying that, the plan is useful.
qs.a: Having said that, the plan is useful.

qs.q: Attribute the view: 'It is thought that tests are unfair.'
qs.a: e.g. Some students argue that tests are unfair.

qs.q: Concede with 'It is true that …': fast food is cheap.
qs.a: It is true that fast food is cheap.

qs.q: Refute 'fast food is cheap' with 'Having said that, …'.
qs.a: e.g. Having said that, it can lead to costly health problems.

qs.q: Attribute a view to a group: phones should be banned in class.
qs.a: e.g. Some teachers argue that phones should be banned in class.

qs.q: Use 'does not necessarily mean': a higher price / a better phone.
qs.a: A higher price does not necessarily mean a better phone.

qs.q: Concede + refute in ONE sentence starting with 'While …'.
qs.a: e.g. While tests cause stress, they motivate students to revise.

29.title: Grammar Auction: clear body-paragraph sentences
29.stage: 'Markaziy mavzu va oxirgi gap' bosqichidan keyin, 8.3 dan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
29.goal: Body paragraph gaplaridagi tipik xatolarni topish: noaniq 'they', noto'g'ri bog'lovchi, dalildan katta xulosa va dars iboralari (encourage sb to, lead to, play a crucial role in, a larger share of).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bu gap Band 7 xatboshiga yaroqlimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi (olmosh, bog'lovchi, ibora, ortiqcha da'vo)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gap uchun: birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan VA sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan, 'they — kim? otni qaytaramiz') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Parents play a crucial role in teaching children good habits.
items.why: play a crucial role IN + -ing — to'g'ri ibora; aniq markaziy mavzu.

items.s: Low fares encourage commuters leave their cars at home.
items.fix: Low fares encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
items.why: encourage sb TO do sth — 'to' tushib qolgan.

items.s: Coaches train young players, and they learn to handle pressure.
items.fix: Coaches train young players, and the players learn to handle pressure.
items.why: 'they' — murabbiylarmi yoki o'yinchilarmi? Noaniq joyda otni qaytaring.

items.s: Poor sleep can lead to weaker performance at school.
items.why: lead to + ot; 'can' isbotlab bo'lmaydigan da'voni yumshatadi.

items.s: Public transport deserves a larger share for government funding.
items.fix: Public transport deserves a larger share of government funding.
items.why: Ibora: deserve a larger share OF sth.

items.s: As a result, fewer cars enter the city centre each morning.
items.why: As a result — natija bog'lovchisi, oldingi gapdagi sababga ulanadi.

items.s: More frequent trains can lead to reduce congestion on the roads.
items.fix: More frequent trains can lead to less congestion on the roads.
items.why: lead to + OT (fe'l emas): lead to less congestion yoki can reduce congestion.

items.s: From this point of view, a longer school day seems reasonable.
items.why: Qarshi fikrni o'zingizniki qilmasdan tan olish iborasi — to'g'ri.

items.s: Cycle lanes make streets safer; however, cyclists no longer have to share the road with lorries.
items.fix: Cycle lanes make streets safer because cyclists no longer have to share the road with lorries.
items.why: however — zidlik bildiradi; bu yerda izoh (sabab) kerak: because.

items.s: This problem is especially serious in large cities, where congestion costs millions every year.
items.why: 'This problem' — olmosh + ot: aniq referencing.

items.s: Therefore, regular exercise always guarantees higher exam results.
items.fix: Therefore, regular exercise can lead to higher exam results.
items.why: 'always guarantees' — isbotlab bo'lmaydigan mutlaq da'vo (overclaim); modal bilan yumshating: can lead to.

items.s: Rural buses are often infrequent, so many families depend on a car.
items.why: infrequent — kam qatnaydigan; sabab → natija 'so' bilan to'g'ri.

29.title: Board Game: Point, Explain, Expand, Link
29.stage: 'Development: da'vo va izoh (8.3)' dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
29.goal: PEEL tuzilmasi, aniq referencing, uzun gapni bo'lish, da'voni 'qanday? nega?' bilan rivojlantirish, modal bilan yumshatish va transport / ta'lim mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, gapni tuzatadi, da'voni rivojlantiradi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdan bittasi 'hakam' — javoblar varag'ini ushlab tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mantiqan to'g'ri boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa yoki o'yinchi 10 soniyada boshlamasa — oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: What do the letters P-E-E-L stand for?
squares.a: Point, Explain, Expand, Link.

squares.t: How many central topics should one body paragraph have?
squares.a: One clear central topic.

squares.t: Finish the phrase: play a crucial role ___ …
squares.a: in (e.g. play a crucial role in shaping behaviour)

squares.t: Which noun does 'they' usually refer back to?
squares.a: The last plural noun mentioned before it.

squares.t: Fix the pronoun: 'Doctors advise patients, and they often feel more confident.'
squares.a: …and the patients often feel more confident.

squares.t: Say the opposite: frequent buses → ___ buses
squares.a: infrequent buses

squares.t: Develop with 'because': 'Car-free days improve city life.'
squares.a: e.g. …because streets become quieter and the air gets cleaner.

squares.t: Give a cohesive device that introduces a result.
squares.a: As a result / Consequently / This means that / In turn

squares.t: Correct: 'Parents should encourage children read every day.'
squares.a: Parents should encourage children to read every day.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: how do you get to school or work?
squares.a: e.g. I usually take the metro, because it is fast and cheap…

squares.t: What is wrong with a last sentence that claims more than the evidence?
squares.a: It overclaims: the last sentence must match the evidence in the paragraph.

squares.t: Soften with a modal: 'Social media causes poor sleep.'
squares.a: Social media can / may cause poor sleep.

squares.t: Split: 'Parks encourage exercise, which improves health, which saves money.'
squares.a: e.g. Parks encourage exercise, which improves health. In turn, this can cut medical costs.

squares.t: Make the reference clearer: 'Traffic is growing. This is serious.'
squares.a: e.g. …This problem is serious. / This increase is serious.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'lead to'
squares.a: result in / cause / bring about

squares.t: Which two questions should you ask about every claim?
squares.a: How? Why? (Is the explanation convincing?)

squares.t: Say a topic sentence for a paragraph on why cities need better public transport.
squares.a: e.g. Better public transport is the key to reducing congestion in big cities.

squares.t: Relevant? 'Libraries help students because library buildings are often old.'
squares.a: No — the building's age is off the point. Better: …because libraries offer free books.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should schools teach life skills such as cooking?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because pupils who can cook are less likely to rely on fast food…

squares.t: What should the last sentence (L) of a paragraph do?
squares.a: Sum up what the paragraph has shown and link it back to the question.

squares.t: Finish: 'Salary is only part of the ___ when you choose a job.'
squares.a: picture (also: story)

squares.t: Give an 'Expand' sentence for: 'Fast metro lines save commuters time.'
squares.a: e.g. As a result, workers arrive less stressed and more productive.

squares.t: Why is it useful to read your paragraph aloud when you check it?
squares.a: Where you hesitate, there is usually an unclear pronoun or an overlong sentence.

squares.t: Say a mini-paragraph (P, E, L): Is cycling good for cities?
squares.a: e.g. Cycling helps cities. Bikes need less space, so traffic eases. Thus, cycling deserves support.

29.title: Dominoes: claim ↔ explanation
29.stage: 'Development: da'vo va izoh (8.3)' bosqichida, 4-mashqdan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
29.goal: Har da'voni unga mos izoh ('qanday? nega?') bilan ulash: because / as / since bilan da'vo → izoh zanjiri.
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida DA'VO (claim) yozilgan — shu da'voni aniq tushuntiradigan IZOHni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Har ulanishda guruh izoh da'voga qanday javob berishini aytadi: 'Why? — because…'. Mantiqsiz ulanish qabul qilinmaydi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: because helpers see other people's problems first-hand.
Night buses make city centres safer,
since late workers no longer walk home alone.
as children happily eat vegetables they grew.
because library staff run free CV workshops.
as many drivers leave their cars at home.
because visitors create jobs for local people.
since people exercise more when parks are nearby.
Working from home can cause isolation,
because employees rarely see their colleagues.
as readers absorb new vocabulary and structures.
because old materials are used to make new goods.
since pupils must organise their own time.
Late-night phone use harms exam results,
because tired students struggle to concentrate.
Learning a foreign language widens job options,
as many employers need bilingual staff.
because players must think carefully before each move.

29.title: Taboo: paragraph language
29.stage: Namuna essaydagi lug'at ishidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
29.goal: Xatboshi tili (topic sentence, claim, support, referencing, cohesive device, develop) va ta'sir so'zlarini (reduce, encourage, lead to, congestion, sustainable) inglizcha tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordam: misol gap aytish mumkin, so'z o'rniga 'blank' deyiladi (masalan: 'Good teachers blank pupils to ask questions').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

29.title: Find someone who… reads his/her writing aloud
29.stage: Dars boshida, 'Takrorlash' dan keyin harakatli isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
29.goal: Hayotiy tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Present Perfect / Present Simple) va dars so'zlarini ishlatish: paragraph, feedback, congestion, encourage, lead to, public transport.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever rewritten an essay paragraph after getting feedback?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va 'Why?' yoki 'How?' bilan bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi — javob da'vo + izoh bo'lishi kerak.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni bitta PEEL gap juftligi bilan sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has rewritten an essay paragraph after getting feedback.
items.q: Have you ever rewritten an essay paragraph after getting feedback?

items.t: …reads his/her writing aloud to check it.
items.q: Do you read your writing aloud to check it?

items.t: …plans every paragraph before writing an essay.
items.q: Do you plan every paragraph before you write an essay?

items.t: …has been stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour.
items.q: Have you ever been stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour?

items.t: …uses public transport more often than a car.
items.q: Do you use public transport more often than a car?

items.t: …thinks public transport in his/her city deserves more funding.
items.q: Do you think public transport in your city deserves more funding?

items.t: …has learnt a practical life skill at school.
items.q: Have you ever learnt a practical life skill at school?

items.t: …has had a teacher who changed the way he/she thinks.
items.q: Have you ever had a teacher who changed the way you think?

items.t: …has noticed that poor sleep led to a lower test score.
items.q: Have you ever noticed that poor sleep led to a lower test score?

items.t: …has been encouraged by a friend to try a new sport.
items.q: Has a friend ever encouraged you to try a new sport?

items.t: …has taken an online course that was worth the time.
items.q: Have you ever taken an online course that was worth the time?

items.t: …can explain the PEEL structure without notes.
items.q: Can you explain the PEEL structure without notes?

29.title: Speaking cards: transport, schools and life skills
29.stage: 'Diktogloss (5-mashq)' dan keyin qolgan vaqtda yoki keyingi Speaking darsida (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
29.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va 3 savollariga PEEL tartibida javob: aniq fikr → izoh → misol/natija → xulosa; transport, maktab va hayotiy ko'nikmalar so'zlari.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 30–40 soniya javob beradi: birinchi gap — aniq fikr (Point), keyin sabab (Explain), misol yoki natija (Expand) va qisqa xulosa (Link).
Tinglovchi PEEL qismlarini barmoq bilan sanaydi: har bir qism +1 ball (ko'pi bilan 4); dars iborasi (lead to, encourage, play a crucial role in…) uchun yana +1.
Agar javobda noaniq 'they' bo'lsa, tinglovchi 'Who?' deb so'raydi — javob beruvchi otni aytib tuzatadi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: How do you usually get around your city? Why do you prefer that option?
Is public transport in your town frequent and affordable? Give an example.
Should governments spend more on roads or on public transport? Why?
What can cities do to reduce congestion during rush hour?
Would cheaper fares encourage people in your city to stop driving to work? Why?
Apart from knowledge, what should schools impart to young people?
Do schools play a bigger role than parents in shaping behaviour? Why or why not?
Should schools teach life skills such as cooking and managing money?
How can late-night phone use affect students' performance at school?
Do you prefer studying online or in a classroom? Explain your reasons.
Are exam results only part of the picture when we judge a school? Why?
Which is more sustainable for a big city: new metro lines or new motorways?
What makes an explanation convincing when you argue a point?
Why do people in rural areas often depend on private cars?

29.title: Sentence Race: PEEL sentences
29.stage: 'Referencing va uzun gaplar (8.2)' dan keyin qisqa jamoaviy musobaqa (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
29.goal: Xatboshi gaplarida so'z tartibini tuzish: topic sentence, natija bog'lovchisi, referencing (this problem, these children), modal bilan yumshatilgan da'vo va L-gap.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gap PEEL ning qaysi qismi bo'lishi mumkinligini aytsa (Point, Explain, Expand yoki Link).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Schools play a crucial role in shaping children's behaviour.
As a result, many drivers leave their cars at home.
Cheap fares encourage students to travel by bus.
These delays cost businesses millions every year.
Late-night gaming can lead to lower exam results.
Therefore, cycle lanes deserve a larger share of funding.
Every claim in a paragraph needs a clear explanation.
A single tram can carry more passengers than fifty cars.
However, these teenagers may find it harder to focus in class.
This problem is most serious in the capital.

29.title: Quiz Board: building a Band 7 paragraph
29.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa va vazifa' dan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
29.goal: PEEL qoidalari, progression va development, referencing, dars iboralari va xatboshi xatolarini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fix the error 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 40 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblarda mantiqan to'g'ri boshqa variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What does the 'P' in PEEL stand for?
The first sentence of a body paragraph is often called the …?
Progression is judged under which criterion: Task Response or Coherence and Cohesion?
Development of each idea is judged under which criterion?
An idea is only loosely related to the question. Explain it at length or cut it?
qs.a: Cut it at the planning stage — it moves you away from the question.

qs.q: Complete: Schools play a crucial role ___ shaping character.
One word: buses that do not come very often are …
One word: heavy traffic that blocks city roads.
Formal verb beginning with 'imp-': Good teachers ___ knowledge to their pupils.
Complete: Exam grades are only part of the ___.
Teachers should encourage pupils ask questions.
Better buses lead to reduce traffic.
qs.a: Better buses lead to less traffic. / Better buses reduce traffic.

qs.q: Who feels exhausted? 'Managers give workers extra tasks, and they feel exhausted.'
The paragraph shows that art lessons reduce stress. Fix the L: 'So art is the most vital subject.'
qs.a: e.g. Therefore, art lessons can help pupils manage stress.

qs.q: What is missing from this 'argument'? 'Free museums improve education.'
qs.a: An explanation: e.g. …because more families can afford to visit.

qs.q: Say a topic sentence about why reading for pleasure matters.
qs.a: e.g. Reading for pleasure can greatly improve a student's writing.

qs.q: Give two cohesive devices that introduce a result.
qs.a: As a result / Consequently / This means that / In turn

qs.q: Develop the claim with 'because': 'Learning to swim is essential for children.'
qs.a: e.g. …because it can save their lives in an emergency.

qs.q: Soften with a modal: 'Fast food makes children overweight.'
qs.a: Fast food can / may make children overweight.

qs.q: Say a 4-sentence PEEL paragraph: Should cities build more cycle lanes?
qs.a: Point → Explain → Expand (result / example) → Link to the question

30.title: Grammar Auction: introductions and conclusions
30.stage: 'Xulosa (kitob 9.3)' bosqichidan keyin, namuna essay tahlilidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
30.goal: Kirish, thesis va xulosa gaplaridagi tipik xatolarni topish: discuss about, the view what, am agree, consistent to, address to, 'I will now prove' o'rniga shaxssiz thesis.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bu gap Band 7 kirish / xulosaga yaroqlimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gap uchun: birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan VA sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan, 'discuss — predlogsiz') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The cost of university education has become a major concern for many families.
items.why: Kirish 1-gap: umumiy mavzu + fokus (kim?) — kontekst beradi.

items.s: Many people discuss about whether teenagers should have part-time jobs.
items.fix: Many people discuss whether teenagers should have part-time jobs.
items.why: discuss + to'ldiruvchi; 'about' ortiqcha.

items.s: The view what homework should be banned is gaining support.
items.fix: The view that homework should be banned is gaining support.
items.why: Fikrga murojaat: The view THAT … ('what' emas).

items.s: This essay will argue that the benefits of free university education outweigh its costs.
items.why: Shaxssiz, bitta gapli thesis — pozitsiya aniq.

items.s: In conclusion, I am agree that free public transport would benefit most cities.
items.fix: In conclusion, I agree that free public transport would benefit most cities.
items.why: agree — fe'l; 'am' ortiqcha.

items.s: In my view, zoos still have value, provided that the animals are well cared for.
items.why: Qisqa, bitta gapli thesis — pozitsiya aniq; 'provided that' shart bildiradi.

items.s: Your thesis should be consistent to the argument in the body paragraphs.
items.fix: Your thesis should be consistent with the argument in the body paragraphs.
items.why: consistent WITH — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: In conclusion, cities offer better jobs and services, whereas the countryside offers a calmer life.
items.why: Xulosa 1-gap: ikkala tomonning asosiy fikri yig'ilgan.

items.s: The final sentence should address to the exact question in the task.
items.fix: The final sentence should address the exact question in the task.
items.why: address the question — predlogsiz.

items.s: While some argue that footballers are overpaid, others believe such salaries are justified.
items.why: Kirish 2-gap: masalaning ikki tomoni; 'such salaries' — aniq referencing.

items.s: I will now prove that university education should be free for everyone.
items.fix: This essay will argue that university education should be free for everyone.
items.why: 'I will now prove' — yozish jarayoni haqida; shaxssiz: This essay will argue that…

items.s: The opening sentence should set the context rather than repeat the question.
items.why: set the context — kontekst berish; rather than + fe'l.

30.title: Board Game: introduction, body, conclusion
30.stage: 'Namuna essay tahlili' dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
30.goal: Essay ramkasi: kirishning 3 qismi (kontekst, masala, thesis), paraphrase va 'tarjima' farqi, body 'xarita' gaplari, ≥ 2 gapli xulosa va mavzu bo'yicha gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, gapni tuzatadi, kirish / xulosa gapini tuzadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdan bittasi 'hakam' — javoblar varag'ini ushlab tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan topshiriqlarda savolga mos boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa yoki o'yinchi 10 soniyada boshlamasa — oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name the three main parts of a Task 2 essay.
squares.a: Introduction, body paragraphs, conclusion.

squares.t: Which two things does an introduction tell the reader?
squares.a: The topic and focus (context) and the main issue to be discussed.

squares.t: When should you write the introduction: before or after planning?
squares.a: After planning the whole argument.

squares.t: How long should a thesis statement be?
squares.a: One short sentence.

squares.t: Correct: 'We discussed about school uniforms in class.'
squares.a: We discussed school uniforms in class.

squares.t: Why is 'This is a controversial topic' a weak first sentence?
squares.a: It is memorised and vague — it says nothing about the actual issue.

squares.t: Paraphrase naturally: 'Some people think the government should fund sports clubs.'
squares.a: e.g. Some people believe that sports clubs should receive public money.

squares.t: Is 'must' a good synonym for 'should' in a paraphrase? Why?
squares.a: No — 'must' is much stronger, so the meaning changes.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: do you enjoy writing essays? Why or why not?
squares.a: e.g. Not really, because planning takes time, but I like…

squares.t: Give an impersonal way to state your position in the introduction.
squares.a: This essay will argue that… (not 'I will now prove…').

squares.t: What is wrong with: 'In this essay I will discuss both views'?
squares.a: It repeats the task; the examiner wants to know WHAT you will argue.

squares.t: Which two sentences of each body paragraph form the 'map' of the argument?
squares.a: The first and the last sentences.

squares.t: Finish the idiom: Weak paragraphs often go off on a ___.
squares.a: tangent

squares.t: What often goes wrong in the second body paragraph?
squares.a: It becomes weaker, repeats paragraph 1 or loses the thread of the argument.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: who should teach children good behaviour?
squares.a: e.g. Parents lay the foundations, but schools can reinforce them…

squares.t: How many sentences should a conclusion have at least? What do they do?
squares.a: Two: a summary of the main points + a clear answer to the question.

squares.t: Should you add a new idea in the conclusion? Why?
squares.a: No — a new idea cannot be developed there, so it weakens Task Response.

squares.t: Give two phrases to start a conclusion.
squares.a: In conclusion, … / To sum up, … / On balance, …

squares.t: Use in a sentence: 'lay the foundations'.
squares.a: e.g. Primary school lays the foundations for lifelong learning.

squares.t: Say a first sentence for: 'Should university education be free?'
squares.a: e.g. How higher education should be funded is a question many governments face.

squares.t: Verb starting with 're-' meaning 'make stronger': Schools ___ good habits.
squares.a: reinforce

squares.t: Give a one-sentence thesis for: 'Is city life better than rural life?'
squares.a: e.g. In my view, cities offer young people more opportunities, despite higher costs.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: is childhood the happiest time of life?
squares.a: e.g. Not necessarily. Children have fewer worries, but adults have more freedom…

squares.t: Say a two-sentence conclusion for: 'Should homework be banned?'
squares.a: e.g. To sum up, homework builds habits but adds stress. Therefore, it should be limited, not banned.

30.title: Dominoes: task wording ↔ natural paraphrase
30.stage: 'Kirish: 5 muammo (9.1)' bosqichida, 2-mashq (paraphrase) dan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
30.goal: Savol gapidagi fikrni kirish uchun tabiiy paraphrase bilan moslash: aktiv → passiv, fe'l → ot, ma'noni saqlab strukturani o'zgartirish (so'zma-so'z 'tarjima' emas).
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida savoldagi fikr yozilgan — xuddi shu ma'noni kirish uslubida beradigan paraphrase'ni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Har ulanishda guruh qaysi usul ishlatilganini aytadi: passiv, fe'l → ot (noun phrase) yoki tabiiy sinonim. Ma'nosi o'zgargan ulanish qabul qilinmaydi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: schools should teach children to cook
children should be taught to cook at school
the government should fund the arts
public money should be spent on the arts
young people spend too much time online
the excessive amount of time young people spend online
cities should build more cycle lanes
the construction of more cycle lanes in cities
good manners should be taught by parents
the damage that tourism causes to historic sites
museums and galleries should not charge
free admission to museums and galleries
the growing number of people who work from home
students should not pay tuition fees
the long hours children spend in front of the TV
the declining popularity of printed books
junk food adverts should be banned
a ban on advertising unhealthy food
sports stars earn too much money
the excessive salaries of sports stars

30.title: Taboo: the language of essay structure
30.stage: Keyingi dars boshida lug'at takrori yoki Kahoot'dan keyin qolgan vaqtda (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
30.goal: Essay qismlari tilini (introduction, issue, focus, thesis statement, position, summarise, outline, address the question, frame, go off on a tangent) inglizcha tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordam: essaydan misol gap aytish mumkin, so'z o'rniga 'blank' deyiladi (masalan: 'The conclusion blank the main points').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

30.title: Find someone who… has changed position in a debate
30.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' savolidan keyin harakatli isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
30.goal: Hayotiy tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Present Perfect / Past Simple / Present Simple) va dars so'zlarini ishlatish: position, thread of the argument, go off on a tangent, conclusion.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever changed your position during a debate?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Why? What happened?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni 2 gapli 'xulosa' bilan aytadi (umumiy natija + o'z fikri).

items.t: …writes the introduction only after planning the whole essay.
items.q: Do you write the introduction only after planning the whole essay?

items.t: …has started an essay with 'This is a controversial topic'.
items.q: Have you ever started an essay with 'This is a controversial topic'?

items.t: …has lost the thread of an argument while writing.
items.q: Have you ever lost the thread of an argument while writing?

items.t: …has visited a museum that was free to enter.
items.q: Have you ever visited a museum that was free to enter?

items.t: …learnt to manage money from his/her parents.
items.q: Did you learn to manage money from your parents?

items.t: …has had a part-time job while studying.
items.q: Have you ever had a part-time job while studying?

items.t: …thinks schools should teach good manners.
items.q: Do you think schools should teach good manners?

items.t: …has changed his/her position during a debate.
items.q: Have you ever changed your position during a debate?

items.t: …has gone off on a tangent in a speaking exam.
items.q: Have you ever gone off on a tangent in a speaking exam?

items.t: …always checks that his/her conclusion answers the question.
items.q: Do you always check that your conclusion answers the question?

items.t: …has read a model Band 8 or 9 essay this month.
items.q: Have you read a model Band 8 or 9 essay this month?

items.t: …would prefer to study at a university abroad.
items.q: Would you prefer to study at a university abroad?

30.title: Speaking cards: state your position
30.stage: Keyingi Speaking darsida yoki uy vazifasidan oldin og'zaki mini-essay (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
30.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va 3 savollariga essay ramkasi bilan javob: aniq pozitsiya, 1–2 sabab va qisqa yakun; ta'lim, tarbiya va yoshlar mavzusidagi so'zlar.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 40 soniya javob beradi: 1-gap — aniq pozitsiya (In my view, …), keyin 1–2 sabab va oxirida savolga qaytuvchi yakun (So, overall, …).
Tinglovchi ball beradi: aniq pozitsiya +1, har bir sabab +1, yakun gapi +1. Javob mavzudan chetga chiqsa (go off on a tangent) — 1 ball kamayadi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Who taught you more about good manners: your family or your school?
Should parents or teachers be mainly responsible for children's behaviour? Why?
Do you think schools should teach children how to manage money?
Should entry to museums in your city be free? Give your position and one reason.
Are the teenage years the happiest time of life? Why or why not?
What responsibilities do adults have that teenagers do not?
Should university education be free in Uzbekistan? Why?
Is it better for teenagers to have part-time jobs or to focus on their studies?
When you disagree with someone, how do you make your position clear?
Do you usually plan before you speak or write? How?
Why do some people find it hard to stay on topic in a discussion?
Should schools reinforce the values children learn at home, or teach new ones?
How has the way children learn good behaviour changed in recent years?
In your view, which is more important at school: exam results or life skills?

30.title: Sentence Race: frame sentences
30.stage: 'Namuna essay tahlili' boshida ramka gaplarini takrorlash uchun (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
30.goal: Kirish, thesis, body va xulosa gaplarida so'z tartibini tuzish: This essay will argue that…, In my view, …, reinforce, In conclusion, I believe that…
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gap essayning qaysi qismiga tegishli ekanini aytsa (kirish, thesis, body, xulosa yoki umumiy qoida).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: This essay will argue that homework should be limited.
In my view, online lessons cannot fully replace the classroom.
How cities should reduce traffic is a question that affects millions.
In conclusion, I believe that schools should teach money management.
Each body paragraph should focus on one central topic.
Never introduce new ideas in the conclusion.
Schools can reinforce the values that parents teach at home.
Your conclusion should give a clear answer to the question.
The last sentence of each paragraph should link back to the question.

30.title: Quiz Board: frame your essay
30.stage: Dars oxirida, Kahoot o'rniga yoki uy vazifasidan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
30.goal: Kirish, body va xulosa qoidalari, essay tuzilmasi lug'ati, tipik xatolar va og'zaki kirish / xulosa tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Structure 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 40 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblarda savolga mos boshqa variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many sentences should a thesis statement be?
Which two sentences of a body paragraph build the argument map?
qs.a: The first and the last sentences.

qs.q: What must the last sentence of the conclusion do?
qs.a: Answer the question clearly (state your position).

qs.q: What problems does a long 'mini-argument' introduction cause?
qs.a: Repetition in the body and confusing paragraphing (lower CC).

qs.q: Name two of today's five introduction problems.
qs.a: Any 2: misreading, vague opener, 'translation', mini-argument, echoing

qs.q: Complete: A good opening sentence should set the ___.
A single sentence stating your position is a thesis ___.
Idiom for moving away from the main topic: go off on a ___.
One verb: the conclusion ___ the main points (gives them briefly).
Complete: Do not lose the ___ of the argument in paragraph 2.
Many people discuss about this issue.
The view what exams are unfair is common.
qs.a: The view that exams are unfair is common.

qs.q: Your conclusion must address to the question.
qs.a: Your conclusion must address the question.

qs.q: Introduction: 'I will now prove that zoos should be closed.'
qs.a: This essay will argue that zoos should be closed.

qs.q: Conclusion: 'In short, homework is useful. In future, AI will do all homework.' What is wrong?
qs.a: A new idea (AI) in the conclusion — remove it.

qs.q: Say an impersonal thesis: 'Should school uniforms be compulsory?'
qs.a: e.g. This essay will argue that uniforms should be compulsory.

qs.q: Paraphrase naturally: 'Some people think cities should ban cars.'
qs.a: e.g. Some people believe that cars should be banned from cities.

qs.q: Say an opening sentence (context) for an essay on working from home.
qs.a: e.g. Where people work has changed dramatically in the last decade.

qs.q: Say a two-sentence conclusion: Are exams the best way to assess students?
qs.a: e.g. In short, exams are fair but narrow. Other methods work better.

qs.q: Say a full introduction (3 sentences): Should children learn a second language early?
qs.a: Context + the issue (both views) + a one-sentence thesis

31.title: Band 7 Auction: linkers, hedging and precise words
31.stage: Band 6 xatolari bosqichida, 4–5-mashqlardan keyin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolganlari — takrorga
31.goal: Task 2 gaplarida Band 6 xatolarini topish va tuzatish: noto'g'ri bog'lovchi (Having said that, Namely), qat'iy bashorat (will → are likely to), outweigh / in spite of / stand up to, sinonim takrori.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.

Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar Task 2 mavzularida: gap year, chet elda o'qish, uydan ishlash, uy vazifasi). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap Band 7 uchun to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va mezonni aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'CC — Having said that qarama-qarshilik bildiradi') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: On balance, the benefits of a gap year outweigh its drawbacks.
items.why: outweigh + to'ldiruvchi (than yo'q); On balance — xulosadagi tabiiy ibora.

items.s: The advantages of remote work outweigh than its disadvantages.
items.fix: The advantages of remote work outweigh its disadvantages.
items.why: outweigh o'zi solishtiradi — 'than' qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: Working from home saves travel time. Having said that, it cuts office costs.
items.fix: Working from home saves travel time. In addition, it cuts office costs.
items.why: Having said that — qarama-qarshilik; bu yerda qo'shish kerak: In addition (CC).

items.s: Homesickness can interfere with a student's ability to concentrate.
items.why: interfere WITH — to'g'ri predlog; can — ehtiyotkor da'vo.

items.s: In spite of it is expensive, a gap year can be worthwhile.
items.fix: Although it is expensive, a gap year can be worthwhile.
items.why: in spite of + ot (the cost); ega va fe'lli gapdan oldin — although.

items.s: Studying abroad pays off, provided that students choose their course carefully.
items.why: provided that + present simple — shart ('will' kerak emas).

items.s: Students who take a gap year will certainly become more mature.
items.fix: Students who take a gap year are likely to become more mature.
items.why: Dalilsiz qat'iy bashorat; Band 7: are likely to / may (ehtiyotkor modal).

items.s: Primary school children are likely to benefit more from play than from homework.
items.why: be likely to — ehtiyotkor bashorat; more from … than from — parallel tuzilma.

items.s: Many students work part-time abroad. Namely, they learn to manage money.
items.fix: Many students work part-time abroad. As a result, they learn to manage money.
items.why: Namely — aniqlashtirish yoki ro'yxat uchun; natija uchun As a result (CC).

items.s: Without evidence, this argument will not stand up scrutiny.
items.fix: Without evidence, this argument will not stand up to scrutiny.
items.why: stand up TO scrutiny — predlog tushib qolgan (LR).

items.s: Online courses are cheap and inexpensive for most learners.
items.fix: Online courses are inexpensive for most learners.
items.why: cheap = inexpensive — bir xil ma'no, takror (LR); bitta aniq so'z yetarli.

items.s: For most school leavers, the experience more than makes up for the delay.
items.why: more than make up FOR — ortig'i bilan qoplaydi; to'g'ri ibora.

31.title: Board Game: Think – Plan – Write – Check
31.stage: Xulosa va uy vazifasidan oldin yoki keyingi dars boshida T.P.W.C takrori (20 daqiqa)
31.goal: T.P.W.C bosqichlari, shaxsiy g'oyani umumiylashtirish, umbrella term, 'Yes, BUT…' (concede + refute), Band 6 bog'lovchi va lug'at xatolarini tuzatish hamda Task 2 mavzularida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, gapni tuzatadi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi (ustozda javoblar kaliti bor). Ochiq topshiriqda javob namunadan farq qilishi mumkin — ma'no, grammatika va uslub to'g'ri bo'lsa qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki to'liq bo'lmasa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: What do the letters T.P.W.C stand for?
squares.a: Think – Plan – Write – Check.

squares.t: About how many minutes should you spend planning a Task 2 essay?
squares.a: About 8–10 minutes of the 40.

squares.t: What is the minimum word count for Task 2? Is 300 words a problem?
squares.a: No. At least 250 words; there is no upper limit, but 260–320 is ideal.

squares.t: Brainstorming or planning: which one turns ideas into an argument?
squares.a: Planning: it groups, orders and links ideas; brainstorming only collects them.

squares.t: Name the four things you note in the THINK box of the planner.
squares.a: General topic, focus, issue, themes (+ your initial position).

squares.t: Give an umbrella term for: doctors, nurses, hospitals, medicine.
squares.a: healthcare / the health system

squares.t: Turn into a question: 'Homework is necessary for young children.'
squares.a: e.g. Is homework really necessary for young children?

squares.t: Name three themes for the topic 'working from home'.
squares.a: e.g. money and time, family life, productivity, loneliness

squares.t: Make it general: 'I would miss my mum's cooking.'
squares.a: e.g. Students abroad often miss home comforts, which can lead to homesickness.

squares.t: Fix the linker: 'Online study is cheap. Having said that, it is flexible.'
squares.a: …In addition / Moreover, it is flexible.

squares.t: Say it simply and precisely: 'a plethora of multifarious advantages'.
squares.a: many different advantages

squares.t: Hedge it: 'Students will fail their first exams.'
squares.a: e.g. Students may / are likely to struggle in their first exams.

squares.t: 'Yes, BUT…': Studying abroad is expensive.
squares.a: e.g. Although it is costly, scholarships and part-time jobs can cover much of it.

squares.t: In a two-sided plan, which side usually comes first?
squares.a: The weaker side; the side that supports your position comes second.

squares.t: What must the last sentence of a body paragraph do?
squares.a: Show what the paragraph has proved and link it back to the question.

squares.t: Your plan does not support your initial position. What do you do?
squares.a: Change your position and thesis so that they match the argument.

squares.t: When do we use 'namely'? Give a short example.
squares.a: To name things exactly, e.g. 'two themes, namely money and family'.

squares.t: Concede and refute in one sentence: homework takes time away from play.
squares.a: e.g. Admittedly, homework reduces playtime; however, short tasks build good habits.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should school leavers take a gap year?
squares.a: e.g. On balance, yes, provided that the year is well planned, because…

squares.t: Why do 500-word essays often score only Band 6?
squares.a: Repetition, irrelevant ideas, an unclear position and no time left to check.

squares.t: Why should main points come from evidence, not the other way round?
squares.a: Otherwise you state an opinion and invent an example; it will not stand up to scrutiny.

squares.t: CHECK stage: name three things you look for.
squares.a: e.g. unnecessary commas, word count, spelling, linkers, a consistent position

squares.t: Make it natural: 'Technology has a big significance for education.'
squares.a: e.g. Technology plays an important role in education.

squares.t: Talk for 40 seconds: working from home — positive or negative?
squares.a: e.g. Although it can be isolating, I believe it is largely positive because…

31.title: Paraphrase Dominoes: planning and argument language
31.stage: Plan bosqichidan keyin ('Yes, BUT…' — 3-mashqdan so'ng) lug'atni mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa)
31.goal: Dars lug'atini (concede, refute, outweigh, on balance, provided that, stand up to scrutiny…) inglizcha ta'rif va paraphrase bilan ulash — Task 2 da takrorsiz, aniq so'z tanlash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z yoki ibora qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi ta'rifga mos kelishini toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Har ibora faqat bitta ta'rifga mos keladi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
Bonus: guruh 3 ta iborani gap year yoki uydan ishlash haqidagi Task 2 gapida ishlatsa, har biri +1 ball. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: note down ideas quickly without judging them
admit that the opposing view has a point
prove that a claim is wrong
be greater or more important than
an early version of a piece of writing
a general word that covers a whole group
with a clear aim in mind

31.title: Taboo: planning and argument words
31.stage: Dars boshida (Kirish bosqichi) isinish sifatida yoki keyingi dars boshida (10 daqiqa)
31.goal: Reja va argument so'zlarini (brainstorm, draft, concede, refute, outweigh, umbrella term, thesis statement…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish — paraphrase ko'nikmasi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib. Ustoz 2–3 eng yaxshi ta'rifni doskaga yozadi — ular essayda takrordan qochish uchun ham kerak.

31.title: Find someone who… always plans before writing
31.stage: Write + Check bosqichidan keyin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida
31.goal: Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Would you…? savollarini to'g'ri tuzib, reja va essay yozish tajribasi hamda Task 2 mavzulari (gap year, chet elda o'qish, uydan ishlash) haqida suhbatlashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi (Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Would you…?) va sinfdoshidan so'raydi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? How did it go? What did you learn?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; hamma savol va javob faqat inglizcha.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni umumiy fikrga aylantirib aytadi (I → young people); ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …has written a full Task 2 essay in under 40 minutes.
items.q: Have you ever written a full Task 2 essay in under 40 minutes?

items.t: …always makes a plan before writing an essay.
items.q: Do you always make a plan before you write an essay?

items.t: …has changed their opinion halfway through an essay.
items.q: Have you ever changed your opinion halfway through an essay?

items.t: …has run out of time before writing a conclusion.
items.q: Have you ever run out of time before writing a conclusion?

items.t: …would consider taking a gap year before university.
items.q: Would you consider taking a gap year before university?

items.t: …knows someone who has studied abroad.
items.q: Do you know anyone who has studied abroad?

items.t: …has worked or volunteered during the summer holidays.
items.q: Have you ever worked or volunteered during the summer holidays?

items.t: …has had to manage their own budget for a month.
items.q: Have you ever had to manage your own budget for a month?

items.t: …would rather work from home than in an office.
items.q: Would you rather work from home than in an office?

items.t: …has already decided what to study at university.
items.q: Have you already decided what to study at university?

items.t: …believes homework is useful for young children.
items.q: Do you believe homework is useful for young children?

items.t: …reads their essays aloud to check them.
items.q: Do you read your essays aloud to check them?

31.title: Speaking cards: decisions, plans and both sides
31.stage: THINK bosqichidan keyin (1-mashqdan so'ng) — savolni tahlil qilib og'zaki javob berish (12 daqiqa)
31.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga T.P.W.C mantig'ida javob berish: pozitsiya + sabab + 'Yes, BUT…' (concede + refute); gap year, chet elda o'qish, uydan ishlash, uy vazifasi mavzulari.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. A o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
B o'quvchi 10 soniya o'ylaydi (THINK: masala nima? qaysi temalar?), keyin javob beradi: Part 1 savoliga 2–3 gap, Part 3 savoliga 4–5 gap.
Part 3 javobida pozitsiya, sabab yoki misol va 'Yes, BUT…' (Admittedly…, however…) bo'lishi kerak.
A o'quvchi ball beradi: aniq pozitsiya +1, sabab yoki misol +1, concede + refute +1.
Har 3 kartadan keyin rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2 ta eng yaxshi javobni sinfga aytdiradi.

cards: Do you usually plan things carefully, or do you prefer to be spontaneous? Why?
How do you prepare before you write something important?
Do you prefer writing by hand or typing? Why?
Would you like to take a year off before university? What would you do?
What are the main drawbacks of studying abroad for young people?
Should universities focus mainly on subjects that help students find jobs?
Is working from home a positive or a negative development? Why?
Should children at primary school be given homework? Why or why not?
Is it better to make important decisions quickly or to take time to reflect?
How can young people become more independent before they leave home?
Do the advantages of living away from your family outweigh the disadvantages?
What skills can people learn outside the classroom that school cannot teach?
Why do some people find it hard to admit that the other side has a point?
In your country, do young people choose their degrees under pressure? Why?
Why do some people change their minds after hearing both sides of an argument?

31.title: Sentence Race: thesis, topic and concession sentences
31.stage: Namuna (reja → essay) bosqichidan keyin tezkor mashq (8 daqiqa)
31.goal: Task 2 dagi asosiy gap turlarini to'g'ri tartibda tuzish: thesis (On balance…, provided that), topic sentence, concede + refute (Admittedly…, Although…), ehtiyotkor da'vo (may) va paragrafning oxirgi gapi.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf — gap boshi, nuqta — gap oxiri, vergul o'z so'zi bilan qoladi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, +1 ball oladi va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Jamoa gap turini ham aytsa (thesis, topic sentence, concession, last sentence, hedged claim) — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: On balance, a well-planned gap year benefits most school leavers.
Admittedly, homework can reduce the time children have for play.
Although studying abroad is costly, scholarships can reduce the financial burden.
There are several reasons why remote work benefits employers.
Brainstorming produces a list of ideas, not an argument.
In my view, the benefits are greater, provided that students plan carefully.
It is true that working from home saves time, but some employees feel isolated.
Longer working hours may lead to poorer health.
For many families, then, homework is a source of stress.
Every body paragraph should end by linking back to the question.

31.title: Quiz Board: T.P.W.C and Band 6 → Band 7
31.stage: Kahoot o'rniga yoki keyingi dars boshida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takrorga
31.goal: T.P.W.C bosqichlari, reja va argument lug'ati, Band 6 xatolarini tuzatish (bog'lovchi, hedging, takror) va og'zaki 'Say it!' topshiriqlarini jamoaviy o'yinda takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 bo'lim × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fix the Band 6 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' bo'limida javob namunadan farq qilishi mumkin — ma'no, grammatika va uslub to'g'ri bo'lsa ball beriladi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What does the 'P' in T.P.W.C stand for?
Brainstorming or planning: which one groups and orders ideas?
Name the four items in the THINK part of the planner.
In a two-sided plan, which side usually comes second?
qs.a: The side that supports your own position

qs.q: Your plan contradicts your initial position. What should you do?
qs.a: Change your position (and thesis) to match the argument

qs.q: A disadvantage; starts with 'dr' (8 letters).
To accept that a counterargument is partly true.
To show that an argument or claim is false.
A general word for a whole group, e.g. 'healthcare'.
Idiom with 'scrutiny': to stay convincing when examined closely.
Hedge it: 'Prices will rise.'
qs.a: Prices are likely to / may rise.

qs.q: Fix the linker: 'Rent is high. Namely, many students share flats.'
qs.a: As a result / Consequently, many students share flats.

qs.q: Correct: 'The pros outweigh than the cons.'
Correct: 'In spite of it is risky, it is worth trying.'
qs.a: Although it is risky, … / In spite of the risk, …

qs.q: Make it precise: 'It is a crucial, vital and essential skill.'
qs.a: It is an essential / a vital skill.

qs.q: Give an umbrella term for: laptops, phones and tablets.
Make it general: 'I'd get bored working at home all day.'
qs.a: e.g. Working from home can feel isolating and monotonous.

qs.q: Turn into a question: 'Social media harms teenagers.'
qs.a: e.g. Does social media do teenagers more harm than good?

qs.q: 'Yes, BUT…': Working from home can be lonely.
qs.a: e.g. Although it can be lonely, it gives people more family time.

qs.q: Say a one-sentence thesis: gap years — good or bad?
qs.a: e.g. On balance, gap years do more good than harm if well planned.

32.title: Final Auction: Writing Task 1 and Task 2 sentences
32.stage: Javoblar varaqasi tahlilidan keyin Writing xatolari ustida yoki keyingi darsda (15 daqiqa); ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
32.goal: Butun kurs bo'yicha Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini topish: tendensiya fe'llari (rise / raise), account for, passiv (was built), prognoz (will + V1), bog'lovchi, evidence, effect / affect.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (Task 1: grafik, xarita, jarayon; Task 2 va Unit 3–8 mavzulari). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'passiv — 23-dars') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Overall, car use rose steadily, whereas the number of cyclists fell.
items.why: Overview: Overall + asosiy tendensiyalar; whereas — qarama-qarshilik (18–20-darslar).

items.s: Coal accounted 40% of total energy production.
items.fix: Coal accounted for 40% of total energy production.
items.why: account FOR — predlogsiz ishlatilmaydi (22-dars).

items.s: In 2010, a new car park was build next to the library.
items.fix: In 2010, a new car park was built next to the library.
items.why: Passiv: was + V3 — build → built (23-dars, map).

items.s: Once the leaves have been dried, they are packed into boxes.
items.why: Process: once + present perfect passive, keyin present passive (24-dars).

items.s: The number of visitors raised sharply between 2005 and 2015.
items.fix: The number of visitors rose sharply between 2005 and 2015.
items.why: rise — o'timsiz fe'l (rose); raise to'ldiruvchi talab qiladi (21-dars).

items.s: Sales reached a peak of just under 500 units in 2019.
items.why: reach a peak of + taxminiy raqam (just under) — 21-dars.

items.s: It is predicted that the figure will to double by 2040.
items.fix: It is predicted that the figure will double by 2040.
items.why: will + V1 — 'to' qo'shilmaydi (22-dars, prognoz tili).

items.s: Admittedly, space exploration is expensive; nevertheless, it drives innovation.
items.why: Concede (Admittedly) + refute (nevertheless) — 28-dars.

items.s: Pollinator numbers have fallen. Having said that, crop yields have dropped.
items.fix: Pollinator numbers have fallen. As a result, crop yields have dropped.
items.why: Bu natija, qarama-qarshilik emas: As a result (26- va 31-darslar, CC).

items.s: Archaeologists have found evidences of early farming in the region.
items.fix: Archaeologists have found evidence of early farming in the region.
items.why: evidence — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi (Unit 5).

items.s: The findings suggest that regular exercise may improve memory.
items.why: Ehtiyotkor da'vo: suggest + may (Unit 3, 26-dars).

items.s: The discovery had a significant affect on how we view early humans.
items.fix: The discovery had a significant effect on how we view early humans.
items.why: effect — ot (have an effect on); affect — fe'l.

32.title: Board Game: Final review — Units 1–8 and Writing
32.stage: 'Xom ball — band jadvali' bosqichida (jadval doskada turganda) yoki keyingi dars boshida butun kurs takrori (20 daqiqa)
32.goal: Mock formati, xom ball → band jadvali, olti xato sababi, Unit 1–8 savol turlari strategiyasi, paraphrase, Writing Task 1 va Task 2 tili hamda kurs mavzularida gapirishni og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; xom ball → band jadvali (Listening va Academic Reading) doskada tursin. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi (ustozda javoblar kaliti bor). Ochiq topshiriqda ma'no va grammatika to'g'ri bo'lsa javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki to'liq bo'lmasa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi va bu mavzu qaysi darsda bo'lganini aytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.
materials: Xom ball → band jadvali (Listening va Academic Reading) doskada yoki har guruhda

squares.t: How long is each part of the mock: Listening, Reading, Writing?
squares.a: Listening 30, Reading 60, Writing 60 minutes — 150 in total.

squares.t: Do you lose marks for a wrong answer? So what should you do?
squares.a: No — so never leave an answer blank.

squares.t: Listening: 32 correct answers. Which band?
Academic Reading: 32 correct answers. Which band?
squares.a: 7.0 (the two tables are different)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'plummet'.
squares.a: fall sharply / drop dramatically

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'extinct'.
squares.a: no longer in existence / having died out

squares.t: YES/NO/NOT GIVEN vs TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN: what is the difference?
squares.a: Y/N/NG checks the writer's views or claims; T/F/NG checks facts.

squares.t: You wrote 'fossil'; the answer was 'fossils'. Which reason (1–6)?
squares.a: Reason 2: heard it, but wrote it wrongly (plural -s).

squares.t: Matching headings: why read the whole paragraph, not just line 1?
squares.a: The main idea may come later; the first line may only introduce the topic.

squares.t: Section 4: how do signpost phrases (e.g. 'Moving on to…') help you?
squares.a: They show the speaker is starting the next heading, so you know which gap you are on.

squares.t: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'the stone tools' a correct answer?
squares.a: No — three words score 0; write 'stone tools'.

squares.t: Task 1: what must an overview include, and what must it leave out?
squares.a: The main trends / key features; no detailed figures.

squares.t: Say it in Task 1 style: 'became four times bigger'.
squares.a: quadrupled / rose fourfold

squares.t: Map: describe a change with the passive (trees → car park).
squares.a: e.g. The trees were cut down to make way for a car park.

squares.t: Process: what is the difference between a stage and a step?
squares.a: A step is one numbered action; a stage is a larger phase made of several steps.

squares.t: Task 2: what do the letters T.P.W.C stand for?
squares.a: Think, Plan, Write, Check.

squares.t: Concede and refute: 'Space research is too expensive.'
squares.a: e.g. Admittedly, it is costly; however, it leads to useful new technology.

squares.t: Name the four Writing criteria.
squares.a: Task Achievement/Response, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range & Accuracy

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: which unit topic did you enjoy most, and why?
squares.a: e.g. Unit 8 (space): I enjoyed learning how amateurs help astronomers.

squares.t: You changed B to C, but B was correct. Which reason? What's the rule?
squares.a: Reason 6; never change an answer without clear evidence.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should governments fund space exploration?
squares.a: e.g. On balance, yes: it fosters innovation, although problems on Earth matter too.

squares.t: Your Listening target is 23+, but you got 20. Band now? How many more?
squares.a: 5.5; three more correct answers for 6.0.

squares.t: Why group your mistakes by question type, not just count them?
squares.a: It shows the pattern and which unit or lesson to go back to.

squares.t: Say two lines of your two-week plan (lesson, amount, day).
squares.a: e.g. Lesson 14, Practice 1–3, one a day, Mon–Wed; Lesson 17 notes on Thursday.

32.title: Paraphrase Dominoes: Units 5–8 and Task 1 language
32.stage: 'Javoblar varaqasi: Reading' dan oldin paraphrase'ni eslash (12 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida
32.goal: Unit 5–8 va Writing Task 1 so'z va iboralarini (excavate, plummet, overhaul, catch on, mitigate, account for…) IELTS uslubidagi paraphrase bilan ulash — mockdagi 1-sabab ('topa olmadim') davosi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z yoki ibora qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrase bilan bir xil ma'noda — toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Har ibora faqat bitta to'g'ri paraphrase'ga ega.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
Bonus: guruh iboraning qaysi unit yoki Writing darsidan ekanini aytsa +1 ball (ko'pi bilan 3). To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: adapt wild animals or plants for human use
moving from place to place to live
far too costly for most people
suitable for people to live in
make up (a certain proportion of a total)

32.title: Taboo: topic words from Units 5–8 and the exam
32.stage: Natija tushishini kutayotganda yoki keyingi dars boshida isinish (10 daqiqa)
32.goal: Unit 5–8 mavzu so'zlarini (arxeologiya, texnologiya, tabiat, koinot) va imtihon atamalarini (distractor, overview, raw score) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish — paraphrase ko'nikmasi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib. Ustoz har so'z qaysi unitdan ekanini so'raydi — to'g'ri aytgan jamoaga +1.

32.title: Find someone who… answered every question
32.stage: 'Natijani ochish' dan keyin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida
32.goal: Did you…? / Have you…? / Do you…? / Are you going to…? / Would you…? savollarini to'g'ri tuzib, yakuniy mock tajribasi, kurs davomidagi o'qish va kelajak rejalari haqida suhbatlashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi (Did you…? / Have you…? / Are you going to…? / Would you…?) va sinfdoshidan so'raydi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? Which section? What will you do next?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; hamma savol va javob faqat inglizcha.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng foydali 2 maslahatni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

32.title: Speaking cards: exams, Units 5–8 and the future
32.stage: Mockda Speaking bo'lmagani uchun — ikki haftalik reja yozilgandan keyin yoki keyingi darsda Part 1/3 mashqi (12 daqiqa)
32.goal: Unit 5–8 mavzularida (arxeologiya, texnologiya, tabiat, koinot), imtihon va o'qish tajribasi haqida IELTS Speaking Part 1 (qisqa) va Part 3 (fikr + sabab + misol + concede) javoblarini mashq qilish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. A o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
B o'quvchi javob beradi: Part 1 uslubidagi savolga 2–3 gap, Part 3 uslubidagi savolga 4–5 gap (fikr + sabab + misol).
A o'quvchi javobdagi kurs so'zlarini (excavate, sustainable, catch on, thrive, mitigate…) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball; concede + refute ishlatilsa yana +1.
Har 3 kartadan keyin rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 eng yaxshi javobni sinfga aytdiradi.

32.title: Sentence Race: exam rules and Writing models
32.stage: 'Olti sabab' bosqichidan keyin qoidalar va Writing namunalarini tezkor takrorlash (8 daqiqa)
32.goal: Imtihon qoidalari (bo'sh javob, javobni o'zgartirish, band) va Writing namuna gaplarida (overview, past perfect, map passivi, process, concede) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf — gap boshi, nuqta — gap oxiri, vergul o'z so'zi bilan qoladi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, +1 ball oladi va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Jamoa gap qaysi darsga tegishli ekanini aytsa (masalan: 'map — 23-dars', 'olti sabab — 32-dars') — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.
